source_flaws: Secondary docs report redaction/tool-name portability issues already addressed in current bodies; read canonical source before accepting their unfixed-status claims.
docs/codebase-design says no shipped import rule, but beta config exists; wizard docs claim time estimates removed from current template.
Architecture report requires remote CDN scripts and loose Mermaid security despite self-contained wording.
Git guardrail is substring regex, not normalized shell/Git parsing; wizard raw env serialization does not safely encode arbitrary values.
HEAD-only code-review conflicts with implement review-before-commit; research/review leaf prompts lack recursion guard; final integration fix lacks explicit bounded convergence.
Teaching root-relative paths can conflate installed-skill references and target workspace; quiz position randomization and explicit prior-level assessment are absent.

source_flaw_evidence.claim: The commentary claims redaction is missing; the frozen canonical body explicitly requires it. Unfixed-status anecdotes are not reliable current-state evidence.
The design commentary says no lint rule is shipped, but the frozen beta source ships path-depth dependency rules. Read canonical artifacts before trusting secondary summaries.
Wizard commentary claims time-remaining display; the current library only announces stage index/total. The source changelog records removal of time estimates.

The purported self-contained architecture report loads Tailwind and Mermaid remotely, with Mermaid securityLevel loose. Its template alone does not establish offline renderability or safe handling of arbitrary labels.

The Git hook matches substrings rather than parsed Git invocations; global flags/whitespace can evade intended patterns and quoted prose can false-match. Wizard raw KEY=VALUE serialization does not encode arbitrary multiline values.

Teaching copy distinguishes runtime input from source references with the same relative-path notation, and requires equal option lengths without a quiz-position randomizer. These instructions are not evidence of assessed prior knowledge or long-term learning efficacy.

source_flaw_evidence.claim: Static inspection: trigger runtime failures are converted to false, so negative cases can pass without a valid host run; first-tool stopping misses later activation.
Static inspection: default SKILL output layout puts grades directly under with_skill, but aggregator only accepts run-* children and skips absent grades; empty results still generate a report.
Static inspection: the candidate-selection set is repeatedly used to choose the best version, so its so-called test score is validation; no fresh final test is implemented.
Static inspection: feedback submission emits every run with empty text even if unseen, and HTTP failure statuses are treated as saved; empty feedback cannot prove human approval.
Static inspection: JSON is inserted raw into an HTML script; later DOM escaping does not protect the enclosing script boundary.
Static inspection: the PDF bounding-box checker prints failures with zero exit status and mixes image pixels with font points; a green exit alone is not artifact correctness.

Prompt-audit prose treats many style/model-era heuristics as documented high-confidence fixes; naming the repository’s own table is not empirical evidence that the change improves this task. Numeric output limits and tool-name guidance can remain explicit product contracts.

Static inspection: GIF optimization drops frames without preserving dwell time, while readiness passes only dimension checks; variable frame delays are not summed. The emitted metadata and ready label do not establish complete artifact validity.

The art guide requires fixed Regenerate/Reset/Download actions, but its literal fixed template has only Reset and several implementation stubs. The template is a starting scaffold, not evidence those actions work.

Hillclimb default uses its named test set every round to select the best variant, so that set is validation. Passing only train paths to an analyzer is a prompt-level restriction; the guide does not provide a structural access boundary, and baseline failure review occurs before the split.

Cost-hillclimb cites self-described internal programs and workload-specific monotonicity, savings and team-superiority numbers without locatable raw experiments; those are unverified source claims, while the registered and reversible comparison procedure can be extracted independently.

Static inspection: lite report can replace observed serving identity with summary metadata and collapses mixed rows to the mostcommon model; it clips case prompts to600chars. Leaf nofollow protections do not bind ancestor read paths, while directory-race residuals remain explicitly acknowledged.

Static inspection: scaffold commits a result row before trace/reference writes; a post-row failure cannot be repaired by ordinary resume because the completed key is already skipped. Serving identity and usage/grade presence are not enforced when callback fields are missing, and error accounting retains only available final-attempt usage.

ELI10: The job library already knows how to retry a failed job later; you just tell it how long to wait. The plan instead rebuilds that waiting-and-rescheduling machinery by hand inside each worker. Hand-rolled schedulers are where jobs get lost (worker dies mid-sleep), retried in lockstep (no jitter, thundering herd), or retried forever (no attempt cap or dead-letter path).

notes: All13 skill bodies and their material variants read in full, including long image-generation procedures, code skeletons/appendices and all research text. Supporting source and three rendered examples inspected; branding assets excluded after content-role inspection.
MIT locally scoped. Stars, sponsor/model/pricing claims, subjective luxury quality and statistical laziness efficacy do not establish method quality.

Source flaws: mock RNG called true execution, invented dates/organic metrics, source-unsupported causal/efficacy statistics, contradictory hard style bans, unbounded image/refinement loops and capability descriptions mistaken for execution.
v2 explicitly adds factual/mock number disclosure, contextual constraints and reduced motion relative to v1. No purported block implementation files exist, only schema.

source_flaw_evidence.claim: The GPT variant calls simulated Python output true randomization. Mock output cannot establish tool execution or randomness.

The redesign variant asks for randomized dates and invented organic-looking metrics. Taste v2 instead requires actual source data or mock labels for precise-looking figures; these variants are materially different.

Research text presents percentage improvements, seasonal causality and strong model/provider explanations, while its reference list lacks direct study links or reproducible experiment metadata. The audit does not admit these efficacy claims.
The static design example explicitly marks motion as later code-phase intent. A static mockup therefore is not evidence that runtime animation exists or achieves the claimed performance.
Taste v2 declares a block-library schema and future file layout, but the frozen tree contains no block implementation files. The contract is an authoring method, not a shipped component library.

Long image workflows repeat an unbounded generate/refine-until-strong rule. Readable units and artifact count are useful contracts; fixed image counts and fresh-generation-over-crop are source preferences, not demonstrated fidelity or efficiency gains.

name.zh: 行动前公开关键假设

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Make uncertain requirements and competing interpretations explicit before an irreversible choice.
en.scenario: Implement an export request whose audience, fields and delivery destination are unspecified.
en.mechanism: Inspect what is known, list the consequential unknowns, present plausible interpretations and resolve only the decisions that change the implementation.
en.bad: Assume all records, every field and a public file destination without telling the user.
en.good: State the unresolved export scope and sensitive-field choice; offer concrete supported interpretations; use the selected scope in implementation.
en.why: The decision-maker sees choices that would otherwise be silently invented.
en.expected: The resulting requirement record names chosen scope, fields and destination, with assumptions distinguished from facts.
en.boundaries: Explore discoverable facts first; trivial settled details do not require an interview.

zh.description: 在作出难以撤回的选择前，明确不确定需求和不同解释。
zh.scenario: 实现一个尚未明确受众、字段及交付位置的导出请求。
zh.mechanism: 检查已知信息，列出关键未知项，呈现合理解释，仅解决会改变实现的决策。
zh.bad: 不告知用户就假定导出全部记录、所有字段和公开文件。
zh.good: 指出导出范围与敏感字段尚未确定，给出具体可行解释，并按选定范围实现。
zh.why: 决策者能看到原本可能被默默虚构的选择。
zh.expected: 需求记录注明范围、字段和位置，并区分假设与事实。
zh.boundaries: 先探索可查事实；已明确的琐碎细节无需反复询问。

name.zh: 只实现当前需求所需的复杂度

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Defer speculative features and abstractions until a concrete requirement justifies them.
en.scenario: Add one percentage-discount calculation to an existing service.
en.mechanism: Implement the actual calculation with its required input rules, and introduce strategy/configuration layers only when a real use case needs them.
en.bad: Add multiple strategy classes, plugin configuration and notifications for one requested percentage calculation.
en.good: Add a small percentage calculation with required validation; leave other discount modes outside this task.
en.why: The implementation complexity has a traceable reason.
en.expected: Every introduced feature or abstraction corresponds to a present requirement.
en.boundaries: Necessary safety, validation and existing architectural contracts still apply; fewer lines alone is not success.

zh.description: 在具体需求证明必要之前，延后推测性的功能与抽象。
zh.scenario: 给现有服务增加一个百分比折扣计算。
zh.mechanism: 实现真实计算与必要输入规则；只有实际用例需要时才引入策略或配置层。
zh.bad: 为单一百分比计算增加多种策略类、插件配置与通知。
zh.good: 增加小范围百分比计算及必要验证，其他折扣模式留在任务之外。
zh.why: 实现的复杂度有可追溯理由。
zh.expected: 新增功能和抽象均对应当前需求。
zh.boundaries: 必要安全、验证和既有架构契约仍须遵守；代码少不等于成功。

name.zh: 让局部编辑逐行对应请求

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Bound authorized edits to the requested behavior and only clean up orphans created by those edits.
en.scenario: Fix empty-email handling in a validator with unrelated username logic.
en.mechanism: Change the email defect, retain surrounding style and behavior, remove only newly unused code and report unrelated findings separately.
en.bad: Fix email handling while reformatting the whole file and tightening username policy.
en.good: Change the empty-email path; keep username rules and formatting; remove only the import made unused by this fix.
en.why: The diff preserves nearby behavior outside the authorized change.
en.expected: Every changed line is explained by the request or a direct consequence of the fix.
en.boundaries: Necessary cross-file changes are allowed when causally required; this is a bounded-write rule, not a read-only prohibition.

zh.description: 将已授权编辑限定在请求行为内，只清理本次编辑产生的孤立代码。
zh.scenario: 修复包含无关用户名逻辑的验证器中空邮件处理。
zh.mechanism: 修改邮件缺陷，保留周边风格和行为，仅删除新增无用代码，并单独报告无关发现。
zh.bad: 修复邮件时顺便格式化全文并加强用户名规则。
zh.good: 只改空邮件路径，保留用户名规则与格式，仅移除因本次修复不再使用的导入。
zh.why: 差异保留授权变更范围之外的相邻行为。
zh.expected: 每条修改都能由请求或修复的直接结果解释。
zh.boundaries: 因果上必要的跨文件修改允许进行；这是有界写入规则，不是只读禁止。

name.zh: 把任务改写为可观察目标

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Translate vague actions into observable success criteria and verify each meaningful step.
en.scenario: Fix sessions remaining active after a password change.
en.mechanism: State the invalidation behavior, reproduce it with a failing oracle, implement the change and verify that the same oracle plus relevant regressions pass.
en.bad: Review and improve authentication with no named failing behavior or check.
en.good: Specify old-session rejection after password change; demonstrate failure first; implement invalidation; run that check and relevant session regressions.
en.why: The loop terminates on evidence of the desired behavior rather than a narrative of activity.
en.expected: The verification records show the stated defect before the change and the intended behavior after it.
en.boundaries: The oracle must detect the defect; source tie-order examples checking only scores do not establish tied-identity order.

zh.description: 把模糊动作转成可观察成功条件，并验证有意义的步骤。
zh.scenario: 修复修改密码后旧会话仍然有效的问题。
zh.mechanism: 明确会话失效行为，用失败判据复现，再实现修改并验证原判据及相关回归通过。
zh.bad: 没有指明失败行为或检查，就泛泛审查和改善认证。
zh.good: 指定改密码后旧会话被拒绝，先展示失败，再实现失效逻辑，运行该检查和相关会话回归。
zh.why: 循环依据目标行为的证据结束，而非活动叙述。
zh.expected: 验证记录展示修复前的缺陷与修复后的预期行为。
zh.boundaries: 判据必须检出缺陷；来源中仅检查分数的同分排序示例不能验证身份次序。

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Transfer binding global values without paraphrasing their meaning.

en.mechanism: Exact values preserve constraints that vague summaries silently change.
en.bad: Tell each worker to use the old and latest runtimes.

en.expected: Every task consumes the same recorded target list.
en.boundaries: Do not copy unrelated instructions blindly; identify the authoritative revision and applicable scope.

zh.description: 传递全局约束值，不通过改述改变含义。
zh.scenario: 计划要求多个任务统一使用 net472 与 net8.0。
zh.mechanism: 准确值保留模糊摘要可能悄悄改变的约束。
zh.bad: 告诉每位工作者使用旧版和最新版运行时。
zh.good: 规格全局约束：targets=[net472, net8.0]；保留公共签名。每个任务简报复制此块或引用固定产物。按准确目标评审，不推断“最新”。
zh.why: 准确值保留模糊摘要可能悄悄改变的约束。
zh.expected: 每个任务消费同一已记目标列表。
zh.boundaries: 不盲目复制无关指令；明确权威版本与适用范围。

name.en: Reviewer Does Not Re-Run the Implementer's Tests
name.zh: 评审不重跑实现者的测试

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Reuse valid test evidence and run focused checks when a concrete doubt remains.
en.scenario: A reviewer receives a full test run tied to the reviewed commit.
en.mechanism: Evidence identity avoids redundant work without forbidding necessary independent checks.
en.bad: Always rerun the whole suite, or never run any test at all.
en.good: Verify reported command, revision, environment and scope match this diff. Reuse matching results. If a cache-miss path is not covered, run its focused fixture or recommend it; new code invalidates prior evidence for affected paths.
en.why: Evidence identity avoids redundant work without forbidding necessary independent checks.
en.expected: Reused evidence names the same revision; a new doubt has a specific check.
en.boundaries: Re-run when revision, environment or scope changed; reviewer evidence reuse is not a universal ban on tests.

zh.description: 复用有效测试证据，有具体疑点时做聚焦检查。
zh.scenario: 评审者收到与被评审提交绑定的完整测试结果。
zh.mechanism: 证据身份避免重复工作，但不禁止必要独立检查。
zh.bad: 永远重跑全套测试，或绝不运行任何测试。
zh.good: 核查报告命令、版本、环境和范围是否匹配 diff；匹配则复用。缓存未命中路径未覆盖时运行聚焦夹具或建议运行；新增代码使受影响路径旧证据失效。
zh.why: 证据身份避免重复工作，但不禁止必要独立检查。
zh.expected: 复用证据指向同版本，新疑点对应具体检查。
zh.boundaries: 版本、环境或范围变化时重新运行；复用证据不等于通用禁测。

name.zh: 不预判的评审派发

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Give reviewers neutral evidence and scope without prescribing their verdict.
en.scenario: Dispatch a reviewer for a plan containing duplicated logic.
en.mechanism: A neutral brief prevents the coordinator from grading its own implementation through dispatch cues.
en.bad: Review this diff, but do not flag the duplication because the plan chose it.
en.good: Review the fixed diff against requirements and quality rubric. Here are the plan and report paths. Treat justifications as claims; return evidence-based findings with actual severity, including plan-mandated defects.
en.why: A neutral brief prevents the coordinator from grading its own implementation through dispatch cues.
en.expected: The reviewer may report any in-scope supported finding.
en.boundaries: State genuine constraints and facts; neutrality does not mean hiding known evidence from reviewers.

zh.description: 给评审者中立证据与范围，不预先规定结论。
zh.scenario: 为含重复逻辑的计划派发评审。
zh.mechanism: 中立简报避免协调者通过派发暗示给自己的实现评分。
zh.bad: 评审此 diff，但计划选择了重复逻辑，所以不要报它。
zh.good: 按要求和质量量规评审固定 diff；提供计划与报告路径。理由视为待核主张，按实际严重度返回有证据的发现，包括计划要求的缺陷。
zh.why: 中立简报避免协调者通过派发暗示给自己的实现评分。
zh.expected: 评审可报告范围内任意有依据的问题。
zh.boundaries: 说明真实约束与事实；中立不等于对评审隐藏已知证据。

name.en: Plan-Mandated Defect Is Still a Finding
name.zh: 计划强制的缺陷仍是问题

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Report an implemented requirement that is itself defective without hiding the conflict.
en.scenario: A plan requires a test that asserts only that a mock was called.
en.mechanism: Spec compliance and quality are separate claims; one cannot erase the other.
en.bad: The plan asked for the mock assertion, so mark quality approved.
en.good: Report two axes: spec satisfied, quality gap because the test cannot catch the requested behavior. Cite the plan and test; label plan-mandated and explain the missing regression signal for the owner to adjudicate.
en.why: Spec compliance and quality are separate claims; one cannot erase the other.
en.expected: The report retains both the satisfied requirement and its concrete defect.
en.boundaries: The owner resolves the spec conflict; reviewers must not silently rewrite approved scope.

zh.description: 实现要求本身有缺陷时，报告问题及冲突。
zh.scenario: 计划要求测试只断言 mock 被调用。
zh.mechanism: 符合规格和质量是不同主张，不能相互抹去。
zh.bad: 计划要求 mock 断言，所以质量通过。
zh.good: 分别报告：满足规格，但测试捕捉不到所需行为，存在质量缺口。引用计划与测试，标记 plan-mandated，解释缺失回归信号，供负责人裁决。
zh.why: 符合规格和质量是不同主张，不能相互抹去。
zh.expected: 报告同时保留已满足要求及其具体缺陷。
zh.boundaries: 负责人裁决规格冲突；评审不能静默改写已批准范围。

name.en: Batch Remediation: One Fixer for All Findings
name.zh: 批量修复：一个修复者处理全部问题

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Repair related findings as one owned change wave before scoped re-review.
en.scenario: Final review finds three related null-handling defects in one module.
en.mechanism: One owner can resolve interacting edits without competing patches.
en.bad: Spawn one fixer per finding to edit the same file concurrently.
en.good: Give one fixer the complete finding list, fixed base revision and owned module. Require evidence for each fix and one combined validation run; review the resulting fix diff against all three findings.
en.why: One owner can resolve interacting edits without competing patches.
en.expected: The fix report maps every finding to a change and covering check.
en.boundaries: Separate truly independent ownership areas when batching would hide unrelated risks.

zh.description: 把相关发现交给一个负责人统一修复，再限定范围复评。
zh.scenario: 终评发现同一模块三个相关 null 处理缺陷。
zh.mechanism: 同一负责人能处理交互修改，避免补丁冲突。
zh.bad: 每个发现派一个修复者，并发编辑同一文件。
zh.good: 把完整问题列表、固定基线版本和模块归属交给一位修复者。每项修复需证据，统一验证一次；按三个问题复评最终修复 diff。
zh.why: 同一负责人能处理交互修改，避免补丁冲突。
zh.expected: 修复报告把每个发现对应到修改与覆盖检查。
zh.boundaries: 真正独立的归属领域可分开，避免批次掩盖无关风险。

name.zh: 以评审门定任务粒度

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Size a task as a unit that can receive a coherent review verdict.
en.scenario: Split a feature into parser changes and UI changes.
en.mechanism: Reviewable behavior supplies a boundary more useful than raw line counts.
en.bad: Create one task per line, or one task for the entire product.
en.good: Parser task owns its input contract, parsing behavior and tests. UI task consumes that contract and owns interaction tests. Each has one acceptance verdict; keep coupled signature changes together rather than splitting them across uncoordinated tasks.
en.why: Reviewable behavior supplies a boundary more useful than raw line counts.
en.expected: A reviewer can accept or reject each task using its own criteria.
en.boundaries: Large cross-cutting changes may need integration tasks; task size is a judgment, not a universal file limit.

zh.description: 把任务划为可形成一致评审结论的单元。
zh.scenario: 把功能拆成解析器和 UI 改动。
zh.mechanism: 可评审行为比原始行数更适合划边界。
zh.bad: 每行创建一个任务，或整个产品只创建一个任务。
zh.good: 解析器任务拥有输入契约、解析行为与测试；UI 任务消费契约并拥有交互测试。各有一个验收结论；耦合签名改动放一起，不拆成失协调任务。
zh.why: 可评审行为比原始行数更适合划边界。
zh.expected: 评审可按各自标准接受或拒绝每个任务。
zh.boundaries: 大型横切改动可能需集成任务；任务大小是判断，不是通用文件上限。

name.zh: 任务级接口契约块

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Declare each task's consumed and produced interfaces before separate execution.
en.scenario: One worker adds clearLayers while another wires its caller.
en.mechanism: A shared contract exposes inter-task drift before integration.
en.bad: Implement the cleaner; the caller can guess its signature later.
en.good: Task A produces clearLayers(layerIds: string[]): Promise<void>. Task B consumes exactly that exported signature and awaits it. Both briefs cite the same interface artifact; validate import, argument and return compatibility.
en.why: A shared contract exposes inter-task drift before integration.
en.expected: The consumer compiles against the producer's exact exported interface.
en.boundaries: An interface contract must be versioned and updated for agreed changes, not frozen against all evolution.

zh.description: 独立执行前声明每个任务消费与产出的接口。
zh.scenario: 一个工作者实现 clearLayers，另一个连接调用方。
zh.mechanism: 共同契约在集成前显露任务间漂移。
zh.bad: 实现清理器，调用方之后再猜签名。
zh.good: 任务 A 产出 clearLayers(layerIds: string[]): Promise<void>；任务 B 消费同一导出签名并 await。两个简报引用同一接口产物，验证 import、参数和返回兼容。
zh.why: 共同契约在集成前显露任务间漂移。
zh.expected: 消费方针对产出方准确导出接口编译。
zh.boundaries: 接口契约须版本化，获准变化时更新，不禁止全部演进。

name.zh: 成本优化模型路由

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Select a model using measured task requirements and an explicit escalation path.
en.scenario: Route mechanical renaming and concurrency review under a cost budget.
en.mechanism: Selection follows task evidence rather than a universal prestige or price ranking.
en.bad: Use the cheapest model for all tasks and trust its confident answers.
en.good: Rename task: choose the model that passes the rename fixture. Concurrency review: choose a model that passes the relevant review cases. Set the requested model explicitly only when the host permits it; escalate failed quality checks and record actual usage.
en.why: Selection follows task evidence rather than a universal prestige or price ranking.
en.expected: Cost reports use observed tokens and the chosen model's applicable rates.
en.boundaries: Model overrides must obey the host and user policy; prices and capability vary.

zh.description: 按测得的任务要求选模型，并定义升级路径。
zh.scenario: 在成本预算内分派机械改名与并发评审。
zh.mechanism: 选择依任务证据，不依通用名气或价格排名。
zh.bad: 所有任务都用最便宜模型，相信其自信回答。
zh.good: 改名任务选能通过改名夹具的模型；并发评审选能通过对应案例的模型。宿主允许时才显式指定；质量检查失败则升级，并记录实际用量。
zh.why: 选择依任务证据，不依通用名气或价格排名。
zh.expected: 成本报告使用实际 token 与所选模型的适用费率。
zh.boundaries: 模型覆盖须遵守宿主与用户规则；价格和能力会变化。

name.zh: 最大迭代次数防循环

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Bound repair loops and preserve the unresolved state when the budget expires.
en.scenario: A build keeps failing after attempted dependency repairs.
en.mechanism: An explicit budget prevents unlimited retry and retains diagnostic history.
en.bad: Keep changing dependencies until the build eventually passes.
en.good: Allow three repair attempts. Each records error signature, hypothesis, change and covering check. If the same signature persists or the cap is reached, stop, preserve the diff and report remaining errors as blocked.
en.why: An explicit budget prevents unlimited retry and retains diagnostic history.
en.expected: Attempts never exceed three, and exhaustion is not marked complete.
en.boundaries: Choose limits for the task; a universal attempt count does not guarantee convergence.

zh.description: 限制修复循环，预算用尽时保留未解决状态。
zh.scenario: 依赖修复后构建持续失败。
zh.mechanism: 明确预算阻止无限重试，并保存诊断历史。
zh.bad: 持续改依赖，直到构建终于通过。
zh.good: 允许三次修复尝试；每次记录错误签名、假设、改动和覆盖检查。相同签名持续或达到上限时停止，保留 diff，把剩余错误报告为 blocked。
zh.why: 明确预算阻止无限重试，并保存诊断历史。
zh.expected: 尝试不超过三次，预算耗尽不标为完成。
zh.boundaries: 按任务选上限；通用尝试次数不能保证收敛。

name.zh: 交接上下文协议

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Write a self-contained brief with task, constraints and artifact pointers.
en.scenario: Hand a reviewer an isolated database-migration check.
en.mechanism: The brief transfers binding context without forwarding abandoned conversation.
en.bad: Based on everything earlier, review the migration and tell me what you think.
en.good: Task: assess migration 0042.sql at commit A. Table has 50M rows; adding NOT NULL is the concern. Read docs/db-contract.md. Return locking risk, evidence locations and missing facts; do not execute the migration.
en.why: The brief transfers binding context without forwarding abandoned conversation.
en.expected: The reviewer can explain its exact target, constraints and output without parent history.
en.boundaries: Inspect the cited artifacts; a concise brief can still omit a critical dependency.

zh.description: 写出含任务、约束与产物路径的独立简报。
zh.scenario: 把独立数据库迁移检查交给评审者。
zh.mechanism: 简报传递有效约束，不转发已弃用对话。
zh.bad: 根据前面所有内容，评审迁移并说说看法。
zh.good: 任务：检查提交 A 的 0042.sql。表有 5000 万行，关注新增 NOT NULL。读取 docs/db-contract.md，返回锁定风险、证据位置与缺失事实；不执行迁移。
zh.why: 简报传递有效约束，不转发已弃用对话。
zh.expected: 评审无需父对话即可说清目标、约束与输出。
zh.boundaries: 检查引用产物；简报简短仍可能漏掉关键依赖。

name.zh: 连续执行强制令

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Continue approved work across task boundaries while surfacing real blockers.
en.scenario: Execute an approved local catalog cleanup in several independent tasks.
en.mechanism: Task completion is not a new permission boundary within an already approved scope.
en.bad: After each completed task, stop and ask whether to continue.
en.good: Complete each authorized task, record progress and start the next. Pause only for a missing required decision, changed scope or a declared approval boundary. At the end report completed tasks, validation and unresolved work.
en.why: Task completion is not a new permission boundary within an already approved scope.
en.expected: All authorized tasks proceed without repetitive continuation questions.
en.boundaries: Continue within approved scope; missing required answers and new irreversible effects remain real boundaries.

zh.description: 跨任务边界持续执行获准工作，同时报告真实阻碍。
zh.scenario: 执行已批准的本地目录清理，包含多个独立任务。
zh.mechanism: 已批准范围内，任务完成不产生新的授权边界。
zh.bad: 每完成一个任务就停止询问是否继续。
zh.good: 完成每个已授权任务，记录进度并开始下一个。仅在缺少必需决定、范围变化或声明的授权边界暂停。结束报告完成任务、验证与未决工作。
zh.why: 已批准范围内，任务完成不产生新的授权边界。
zh.expected: 全部获准任务推进，不重复询问是否继续。
zh.boundaries: 在已批准范围内继续；缺必需回答和新增不可逆影响仍是实际边界。

name.zh: 防合理化借口表

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Pair recurring excuses with the concrete action that repairs their evidence gap.
en.scenario: An agent repeatedly skips the null-input regression check.
en.mechanism: Named failure cues connect a familiar shortcut to its missing check.
en.bad: Never skip verification; be disciplined.
en.good: Excuse: 'The change is tiny' → run the null fixture; small size does not test behavior. Excuse: 'It worked last time' → verify this revision. If the check cannot run, report the gap rather than a passing claim.
en.why: Named failure cues connect a familiar shortcut to its missing check.
en.expected: Both shortcuts lead to the same revision-specific verification requirement.
en.boundaries: Do not invent universal costs or insist every trivial edit needs a full suite.

zh.description: 把常见借口与能修复证据缺口的具体行动成对列出。
zh.scenario: agent 反复跳过 null 输入回归检查。
zh.mechanism: 具名失败线索把熟悉捷径连接到缺失检查。
zh.bad: 绝不跳过验证，要有纪律。
zh.good: 借口“改动很小”→ 运行 null 夹具，大小不验证行为。借口“上次成功”→ 验证当前版本。不能运行时报告缺口，不声称通过。
zh.why: 具名失败线索把熟悉捷径连接到缺失检查。
zh.expected: 两种捷径都回到针对版本的验证要求。
zh.boundaries: 不编造通用成本，也不坚持每个微小修改都需全套测试。

name.zh: 从所属计划的账本恢复执行

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Bind progress to a specific plan identity and recover from persisted completion evidence after context loss.
en.scenario: Resume a multi-task implementation session after compaction while a sibling plan also has scratch files.
en.mechanism: Match the ledger’s plan identity, trust its commit-backed completed tasks, resume the first incomplete task or saved fix round, and leave sibling ledgers alone.
en.bad: Read any progress.md found nearby and redispatch every task from memory.
en.good: Open the ledger whose first line names this plan; verify recorded commits; resume the recorded incomplete task and round without touching another plan’s workspace.
en.why: A named ownership boundary prevents both duplicate work and cross-plan state confusion.
en.expected: Resumed execution starts at the ledger’s first incomplete state and recorded commits remain inspectable.
en.boundaries: Validate stale/corrupted ledger entries against repository evidence; a scratch ledger is not a substitute for durable version history.

zh.description: 将进度绑定到具体计划身份，上下文丢失后依据持久化完成证据恢复。
zh.scenario: 压缩后恢复多任务实现会话，旁边还有另一个计划的临时文件。
zh.mechanism: 匹配账本计划身份，核对提交支持的完成任务，恢复首个未完成任务或修复轮次，保留其他计划账本。
zh.bad: 随便读取附近 progress.md，并凭记忆重新派发全部任务。
zh.good: 打开首行标明本计划的账本，核验记录提交，从未完成任务及轮次继续，不触碰其他计划工作区。
zh.why: 具名归属边界避免重复工作和跨计划状态混淆。
zh.expected: 恢复执行从账本首个未完成状态开始，历史提交可检查。
zh.boundaries: 对陈旧或损坏账本核对仓库证据；临时账本不能替代持久版本历史。

sources.section: restart only recorded complete task boundaries

name.zh: 实现前核对任务间接口

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Make cross-task consistency checks explicit with producer/consumer evidence.
en.scenario: Execute a plan where one task creates parseRecord and another consumes parseRow.
en.mechanism: List task pairs sharing files/interfaces, compare produced and consumed names/types/values, record conflicts and resolve them before dispatch.
en.bad: Say the plan is consistent after skimming it without checking any task pairs.
en.good: Record the producer parseRecord and consumer parseRow mismatch in a table; settle the intended name against the spec and propagate it into both task briefs.
en.why: A pairwise artifact exposes dependencies that isolated task reading can miss.
en.expected: Each shared interface has a checked producer/consumer row and conflicts have a traceable resolution.
en.boundaries: The scan cannot predict all integration failures; retain implementation tests and review gates.

zh.description: 用生产者与消费者证据明确检查跨任务一致性。
zh.scenario: 执行一个前项创建 parseRecord、后项调用 parseRow 的计划。
zh.mechanism: 列出共享文件或接口的任务对，比较名称、类型与值，记录冲突并在派发前解决。
zh.bad: 略读后宣称计划一致，却未检查任何任务对。
zh.good: 在表中记录 parseRecord 与 parseRow 不匹配，依据规格确定名称，并同步到两份任务说明。
zh.why: 成对检查产物暴露单任务阅读容易遗漏的依赖。
zh.expected: 每个共享接口都有已检查的生产/消费行，冲突有可追溯解决。
zh.boundaries: 扫描不能预测全部集成失败；仍保留实现测试和评审关口。

name.en: Record reversible decisions with their rationale and cost
name.zh: 记录可逆决策的理由与代价

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Record an authorized implementation decision, its evidence and cost if wrong, then include it in the final handoff.
en.scenario: An approved plan has two inconsistent internal names but the binding spec settles the behavior.
en.mechanism: Resolve within authorized reversible scope using the spec, record the ruling and its rework cost, carry it to affected briefs and expose it in the final report.
en.bad: Silently choose a name and delete the scratch record before the user can review the decision.
en.good: Record the selected name, spec basis and affected callers; update relevant briefs; include this ruling and its correction cost in the final report.
en.why: The decision remains reviewable after implementation and scratch cleanup.
en.expected: Every recorded ruling appears in the final handoff with its rationale and impact.
en.boundaries: Do not turn this into permission for security-sensitive, destructive or externally visible actions outside the user’s authorization.

zh.description: 记录已授权实现决策、依据及判断错误的代价，并纳入最终交接。
zh.scenario: 批准的计划有两个不一致内部名称，但绑定规格已明确行为。
zh.mechanism: 在已授权可逆范围内按规格解决，记录判断及返工代价，同步相关说明并在最终报告披露。
zh.bad: 默默选名称，用户查看之前就删掉临时记录。
zh.good: 记录名称、规格依据和受影响调用，同步说明，最终报告列出该决策和修正代价。
zh.why: 实现及清理临时文件后，决策仍可审核。
zh.expected: 每个记录的判断都在最终交接中出现，并说明理由与影响。
zh.boundaries: 不得据此进行超出用户授权的安全敏感、破坏性或外部可见操作。

name.zh: 证据链 / 工作量证明

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Link conclusions to observed evidence and record missing coverage.
en.scenario: Explain why requests returned 503 during a database outage.
en.mechanism: A trace separates observed facts from interpretation and uncertainty.
en.bad: The database probably failed; mark the root cause confirmed.
en.good: Claim: DB disconnect caused 503. Evidence: request r17 log at 12:04 reports db_disconnect; handler.ts:42 maps that error to 503. List unavailable database metrics and label cause provisional until alternate paths are excluded.
en.why: A trace separates observed facts from interpretation and uncertainty.
en.expected: A reviewer can inspect both cited artifacts and the missing-input list.
en.boundaries: Evidence supports only the stated scope; perceived confidence is not a calibrated probability.

zh.description: 把结论连接到实际证据，并记录覆盖缺口。
zh.scenario: 解释数据库中断期间请求为何返回 503。
zh.mechanism: 证据链区分观察事实、解释与不确定性。
zh.bad: 数据库大概故障了，把根因标为已确认。
zh.good: 主张：数据库断连导致 503。证据：12:04 的请求 r17 日志含 db_disconnect，handler.ts:42 将其映射到 503。列出缺失数据库指标；排除其他路径前将原因标为暂定。
zh.why: 证据链区分观察事实、解释与不确定性。
zh.expected: 评审可检查两个引用产物与缺失输入清单。
zh.boundaries: 证据只支持所声明范围；主观置信度不是校准概率。

name.zh: 双轴完成判据（可判定 + 穷尽）

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Define completion as both a checkable predicate and accounted coverage.
en.scenario: Audit every catalog entry, including merged and removed items.
en.mechanism: A predicate prevents premature success while an inventory bounds what must be checked.
en.bad: Finish when the blog looks improved and there are enough examples.
en.good: Done means every original ID has one active/merged/removed decision; every active entry has bilingual fields; references validate; no unreviewed entry remains. Run the coverage checker and list any excluded pages explicitly.
en.why: A predicate prevents premature success while an inventory bounds what must be checked.
en.expected: The final report includes zero unreviewed IDs and the validator result.
en.boundaries: An exhaustive inventory is limited to the declared corpus; do not imply worldwide completeness.

zh.description: 完成须同时具有可判定条件与已解释覆盖范围。
zh.scenario: 审核每个目录项，包括合并和撤下项。
zh.mechanism: 判定条件防止过早成功，清单界定必须检查的范围。
zh.bad: 博客看起来改善、示例够多就完成。
zh.good: 完成意味着每个原 ID 有且仅有一个 active/merged/removed 决定，所有有效项有双语字段，引用有效，没有未审项。运行覆盖检查，明确列出排除页面。
zh.why: 判定条件防止过早成功，清单界定必须检查的范围。
zh.expected: 最终报告含零未审 ID 与校验结果。
zh.boundaries: 穷尽清单仅限声明语料，不暗示全球全部覆盖。

name.zh: 以证据约束的验证规则

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Frame one binding verification rule and specify its authorized exceptions.
en.scenario: A patch may be declared passing only after its covering check runs.
en.mechanism: The named rule binds a success claim to evidence rather than rhetorical strength.
en.bad: Try to verify the patch if there is time.
en.good: Verification rule: before claiming this patch passes, run the agreed covering check and inspect its result. If execution is unavailable, report unverified plus the blocked check; never replace observed output with confidence.
en.why: The named rule binds a success claim to evidence rather than rhetorical strength.
en.expected: No passing claim appears without the matching recorded check.
en.boundaries: Respect higher-priority instructions and agreed task scope; verification rules need relevant checks.

zh.description: 把一个必需验证规则突出呈现，并说明授权例外。
zh.scenario: 补丁只有执行覆盖检查后才能声明通过。
zh.mechanism: 具名规则把成功主张绑定证据，不靠语气强弱。
zh.bad: 有时间就尽量验证补丁。
zh.good: 验证规则：声称补丁通过前运行约定覆盖检查并检查结果。无法执行时报告 unverified 与被阻检查，不以自信代替观察输出。
zh.why: 具名规则把成功主张绑定证据，不靠语气强弱。
zh.expected: 没有对应检查记录时不出现通过主张。
zh.boundaries: 遵守更高优先级指令和约定范围；验证规则须对应相关检查。

name.zh: 进入时声明技能协议

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Name the selected skill and briefly state its purpose before applying it.
en.scenario: Begin a task for which a relevant skill has been selected.
en.mechanism: Name the selected skill and briefly state its purpose before applying it.
en.bad: Start the skill's workflow silently and leave the user guessing why steps occur.
en.good: Name the selected skill and briefly state its purpose before applying it.
en.why: The required behavior is explicit instead of relying on an unsupported assumption.
en.expected: The user can connect the announced method to the subsequent task behavior.
en.boundaries: Announcements should be concise and should not substitute for actual work.

zh.description: 应用前说明技能名称及简短用途。
zh.scenario: 开始一项已选定相关技能的任务。
zh.mechanism: 应用前说明技能名称及简短用途。
zh.bad: 静默启动技能流程，让用户猜测步骤缘由。
zh.good: 应用前说明技能名称及简短用途。
zh.why: 所需行为被明确写出，而非依赖未证实的假设。
zh.expected: 用户能把宣布的方法与后续任务行为联系。
zh.boundaries: 说明应简短，不能代替实际工作。

name.zh: 按宿主条件加载参考文件

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Identify the actual harness and read only its named adaptation reference before tool use.
en.scenario: Adapt a skill to the current supported execution harness.
en.mechanism: Identify the actual harness and read only its named adaptation reference before tool use.
en.bad: Load every harness guide or use remembered tool mappings.
en.good: Identify the actual harness and read only its named adaptation reference before tool use.
en.why: The required behavior is explicit instead of relying on an unsupported assumption.
en.expected: The loaded reference matches the execution surface and its tool contract.
en.boundaries: If the harness is unsupported, report the gap rather than inventing equivalent capabilities.

zh.description: 识别真实环境，只阅读对应具名适配参考后再用工具。
zh.scenario: 把技能适配到当前受支持执行环境。
zh.mechanism: 识别真实环境，只阅读对应具名适配参考后再用工具。
zh.bad: 加载全部环境指南，或凭记忆映射工具。
zh.good: 识别真实环境，只阅读对应具名适配参考后再用工具。
zh.why: 所需行为被明确写出，而非依赖未证实的假设。
zh.expected: 加载参考与执行环境及工具契约相符。
zh.boundaries: 环境不支持时报告缺口，不虚构等价能力。

name.zh: 汇总前确认计数器语义

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Determine whether metrics are increments or cumulative observations before aggregating them.
en.scenario: Compute token usage between observations 100, 140 and 200 from a cumulative counter.
en.mechanism: Record semantics, units and interval boundaries; difference cumulative values for the interval and preserve missing observations as unknown.
en.bad: Add 100+140+200 and report 440 tokens used during that interval.
en.good: For the interval after the 100 baseline, report 200-100=100 tokens; do not assign unobserved per-turn values when an intermediate record is missing.
en.why: Cumulative samples repeat earlier usage and cannot be summed as independent increments.
en.expected: The calculation names the counter type, unit, baseline and supported interval total.
en.boundaries: Counter resets and parent/child attribution require explicit handling; missing data is not zero. For cumulative usage snapshots, aggregate final cumulative totals once per declared invocation rather than summing each repeated snapshot as a new interval.

zh.description: 先确定指标是增量还是累计观察，再进行聚合。
zh.scenario: 根据累计计数器的 100、140、200 三次观察，计算观察间 token 使用量。
zh.mechanism: 记录语义、单位和区间边界；对累计值做差，并将缺失观察保留为未知。
zh.bad: 将 100+140+200 相加，报告该区间用了 440 token。
zh.good: 以 100 为区间起点，报告 200-100=100；中间记录缺失时，不虚构逐轮用量。
zh.why: 累计采样重复包含先前用量，不能当独立增量相加。
zh.expected: 计算注明计数器类型、单位、基线与有证据区间总量。
zh.boundaries: 计数器重置和父子会话归属需单独处理；缺失数据不是零。 对于累计用量快照，每个声明调用只汇总一次最终累计总量，不把每次重复快照都当成新区间相加。

sources.section: Usage, timing boundaries and separate judge spend

name.en: Identify the actor before inferring intent
name.zh: 判断意图前确认记录发出者

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Separate human requests from parent-agent dispatches, injected text and tool results.
en.scenario: Audit whether a human requested an external action from a child-agent transcript.
en.mechanism: Establish record meanings and parent/child relationships, then attribute intent only to records proven to be human-typed.
en.bad: Treat every role=user message inside the child transcript as direct human permission.
en.good: Identify the role=user record as a parent dispatch; locate the actual human request in the parent history before stating authorization.
en.why: A serialized role label does not uniquely identify the originating actor.
en.expected: The report records actor provenance and the source of any claimed human instruction.
en.boundaries: When the human record is unavailable, report the limitation rather than inventing intent.

zh.description: 区分人类请求、父代理派发、注入文本和工具结果。
zh.scenario: 依据子代理记录审核人类是否请求了一个外部动作。
zh.mechanism: 先确认记录语义及父子关系，只把证明为人类输入的记录用于意图归因。
zh.bad: 把子记录中每个 role=user 消息都当成人类直接授权。
zh.good: 确认该 user 记录是父代理派发，先在父记录中找到真实人类请求，再陈述授权。
zh.why: 序列化角色标签不能唯一确定原始发出者。
zh.expected: 报告记录发出者来源，以及声称人类指令的具体依据。
zh.boundaries: 人类记录不可用时说明限制，不虚构意图。

name.en: Qualify observations by when they were captured
name.zh: 按采集时间区分来源状态

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Distinguish historical evidence, unverified snapshots, current observations and unknown state.
en.scenario: Determine which skill version influenced a session recorded last month.
en.mechanism: Use captured bodies/archives for historical claims, current checkout for present observations, and label unresolved version fields explicitly.
en.bad: Use today’s HEAD as proof of the version loaded last month.
en.good: Cite the captured skill body and its hash for last month; label today’s checkout separately; leave uncaptured installation version unknown.
en.why: Current state cannot authenticate past state, and one captured file cannot prove an entire installation.
en.expected: Every version field has a time/provenance label and supporting location.
en.boundaries: Preserved copies may be valid evidence even if original paths are gone; verify their provenance. Keep retrieved_at distinct from the source observation time; a response received today does not make cached or undated evidence current.

zh.description: 区分历史证据、未验证快照、当前观察与未知状态。
zh.scenario: 确定上个月记录会话受到哪个技能版本影响。
zh.mechanism: 历史主张使用捕获正文或归档，当前观察使用现有检出，未解决版本字段明确标注。
zh.bad: 用今天 HEAD 证明上个月加载的版本。
zh.good: 用捕获的技能正文及哈希支持上个月情况，今天检出单独标注，未捕获安装版本保持未知。
zh.why: 当前状态不能认证过去状态，单个文件也不能证明整个安装。
zh.expected: 每个版本字段有时间和来源标签及支持位置。
zh.boundaries: 原路径消失时，保留副本仍可能是证据，但需验证来源。 区分 retrieved_at 与来源观察时间；今天收到的响应不会让缓存或无日期证据自动成为当前事实。

name.en: Preserve linkage with stable redaction placeholders
name.zh: 用稳定遮蔽占位符保留关联

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Use consistent substitutions across an export while retaining safe identity and evidence structure.
en.scenario: Redact the same private account in a report and its supporting transcript.
en.mechanism: Map the value to one stable placeholder in every copy, preserve source markers and log only placeholder/category/count.
en.bad: Replace one occurrence with ACCOUNT-1 and another with REDACTED, while storing the secret replacement map in the bundle.
en.good: Use ORG-1 consistently in report and transcript; keep original line markers; write only ORG-1/category/count to the log.
en.why: Stable anonymous identity preserves relationships without exposing the original value.
en.expected: Citations and cross-file relationships remain checkable and the export contains no plaintext mapping.
en.boundaries: If privacy removes evidence support, report the limitation instead of retaining secrets. When redaction collapses distinct keys to one label, retain each observation with a stable opaque identity or collision suffix. Redact structured values before encoding or truncation.

zh.description: 在导出中一致替换敏感值，同时保留安全身份与证据结构。
zh.scenario: 遮蔽报告及支持记录中同一个私有账号。
zh.mechanism: 在各副本中映射到同一占位符，保留来源标记，日志只写占位符、类别和数量。
zh.bad: 一处替成 ACCOUNT-1，另一处替成 REDACTED，还把真实替换映射放进导出包。
zh.good: 报告及记录都使用 ORG-1，保留原行标记，日志仅记 ORG-1、类别和数量。
zh.why: 稳定匿名身份保留关联而不暴露原值。
zh.expected: 引用和跨文件关系仍可检查，导出没有明文映射。
zh.boundaries: 隐私处理移除支持证据时报告限制，不为证据保留秘密。 若脱敏让不同键变成同一标签，用稳定不透明身份或冲突后缀保留每项观察。应在编码或截断前对结构化值脱敏。

name.en: Check privacy and evidence usefulness separately
name.zh: 分别检查导出隐私与证据可用性

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Verify that an export is scrubbed and independently verify that its remaining evidence still supports its claims.
en.scenario: Deliver a redacted failure-analysis archive.
en.mechanism: Audit all exported files for sensitive values, then resolve each finding to included evidence; reconcile files and verify the final archive matches the reviewed set.
en.bad: Treat a CLEAN privacy result as proof every exported diagnosis remains supported.
en.good: Record privacy CLEAN and evidence limited for a claim whose tool-result body was withheld; state that limitation and archive exactly the reviewed files.
en.why: Removing secrets and preserving proof are different objectives.
en.expected: The handoff states separate privacy and evidence outcomes and names unsupported findings.
en.boundaries: A privacy audit is not exhaustive certification; edits after review require affected checks again.

zh.description: 确认导出已遮蔽，并独立确认剩余证据仍支持主张。
zh.scenario: 交付一个经过遮蔽的失败分析压缩包。
zh.mechanism: 审核全部导出文件的敏感值，再把各发现对应到随包证据，协调文件并验证压缩包与审核集合一致。
zh.bad: 把隐私 CLEAN 当成全部导出诊断仍有支持的证明。
zh.good: 记录隐私 CLEAN，但因工具结果被隐藏而将某主张标为证据有限；说明限制并压缩已审核文件。
zh.why: 去除秘密与保留证明是不同目标。
zh.expected: 交接分别说明隐私和证据结果，并列明不受支持发现。
zh.boundaries: 隐私审核不是穷尽认证；审核后改动须重跑受影响检查。

name.en: Prove behavioral RED before minimal GREEN
name.zh: 先证明行为失败，再实现最小通过

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Verify that a behavioral test fails for the intended missing behavior before implementing the smallest change that passes it.
en.scenario: Reject an empty email currently accepted by a form.
en.mechanism: Write the rejection assertion, observe the actual behavioral failure rather than setup error, implement the required rule and refactor only while the relevant checks remain green.
en.bad: Write a passing test around the current behavior after implementing the fix and call it a regression proof.
en.good: Assert empty email produces the required error; see it fail against the old form; add the rule; verify the same assertion passes and relevant existing behavior remains intact.
en.why: The failing run demonstrates sensitivity to the named defect.
en.expected: The record contains expected RED, resulting GREEN and the code state each run covered.
en.boundaries: Test necessity depends on change risk; do not delete unrelated user work or pretend an import error is behavioral evidence.

zh.description: 实现前确认行为测试因预期缺失行为而失败，再用最小修改使其通过。
zh.scenario: 拒绝目前被表单接受的空邮件。
zh.mechanism: 写出拒绝断言，观察真实行为失败而非准备错误，实现必要规则，只在相关检查通过时重构。
zh.bad: 修复后围绕现状写一个通过测试，就称为回归证明。
zh.good: 断言空邮件产生规定错误，观察旧表单失败，增加规则，再验证同一断言通过且相关已有行为保持。
zh.why: 失败运行证明测试对所指缺陷敏感。
zh.expected: 记录包含预期 RED、之后 GREEN 及各运行覆盖的代码状态。
zh.boundaries: 测试需要取决于变更风险；不得删除无关用户工作，也不能把导入错误当行为证据。

name.en: Wait on a fresh observable predicate
name.zh: 等待新鲜的可观察条件

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Replace guessed delays with a fresh readiness predicate and a bounded timeout.
en.scenario: Read a result produced asynchronously under variable load.
en.mechanism: Observe the relevant state or event repeatedly within a time budget; return only when the actual predicate holds, otherwise report timeout.
en.bad: Sleep 50 ms and assume the result exists.
en.good: Within the agreed timeout, check the live result getter until the target result exists; on expiry report the unmet predicate.
en.why: Elapsed delay alone does not establish the needed state.
en.expected: The read follows an observed readiness condition or a visible timeout result.
en.boundaries: Timing-behavior tests have a different oracle; choose polling/event strategy and interval for the actual workload.

zh.description: 用新鲜就绪条件和有限超时替代猜测的延迟。
zh.scenario: 读取在变化负载下异步生成的结果。
zh.mechanism: 在时间预算内反复观察相关状态或事件，实际条件成立才返回，否则报告超时。
zh.bad: 等待 50 毫秒就假定结果存在。
zh.good: 在约定超时内检查实时 getter，直到目标结果存在，超时则报告未满足条件。
zh.why: 仅经过一段时间不能证明所需状态。
zh.expected: 读取发生在观察到就绪之后，或明确返回超时。
zh.boundaries: 测试计时行为需要其他判据；轮询、事件方式和间隔由实际负载决定。

name.zh: 使用独立且对错误敏感的判据

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Derive expected values independently and check that plausible wrong behavior would fail the test.
en.scenario: Verify serialization of a search filter.
en.mechanism: Use a hand-checked literal expected output and consider wrong quoting, missing field or wrong branch mutations.
en.bad: Compute both expected and actual with the same query builder.
en.good: Compare the builder result to a manually verified literal; confirm that omitting the filter or changing its quoting would fail the assertion.
en.why: A shared implementation can repeat the same defect on both sides of an equality.
en.expected: At least the relevant plausible defects change the asserted outcome.
en.boundaries: Mutation sensitivity is scoped to identified risks, not proof that every possible bug is covered.

zh.description: 独立推导预期值，并检查合理的错误行为能否使测试失败。
zh.scenario: 验证搜索过滤条件的序列化。
zh.mechanism: 使用手工核对的字面预期，并考虑错误引用、字段缺失或分支错误。
zh.bad: 预期和实际都由同一个查询构造器计算。
zh.good: 将结果与手工核验字面值比较，确认漏过滤条件或引用错误会使断言失败。
zh.why: 共享实现可能在比较两边重复同一个缺陷。
zh.expected: 相关合理缺陷至少会改变被断言结果。
zh.boundaries: 错误敏感性只针对已识别风险，不证明覆盖所有可能缺陷。

sources.section: deliberate temporary mutation to test the oracle

name.en: Trace invalid data back to its origin
name.zh: 把无效数据回溯到来源

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Walk backward from a failing effect through callers and values to identify where the bad input originated.
en.scenario: A workspace operation runs in the wrong directory.
en.mechanism: Inspect the effect’s actual directory value, identify its caller, follow the value through the call chain and verify the originating initialization/decision.
en.bad: Patch the failing operation to ignore errors without inspecting its input path.
en.good: Observe the empty directory at the operation, trace it to a pre-initialization test value, fix that origin and verify the directory contract.
en.why: The visible failure may occur several boundaries after the defective decision.
en.expected: The explanation records the observed value and each causal call-path hop supporting the identified origin.
en.boundaries: A call-path hypothesis needs runtime or static evidence; defensive validation alone does not prove the origin or impossibility of recurrence.

zh.description: 从失败副作用沿调用者与数值回溯，识别错误输入最初产生处。
zh.scenario: 工作区操作在错误目录执行。
zh.mechanism: 检查真实目录值，找到调用者，沿调用链追踪值，并核验最初初始化或决策。
zh.bad: 不检查路径，就让失败操作忽略错误。
zh.good: 观察操作收到空目录，追溯到测试初始化前读取的值，修复来源并验证目录契约。
zh.why: 可见失败可能发生在错误决策之后多个边界。
zh.expected: 解释记录真实值及支持来源判断的每个调用链节点。
zh.boundaries: 调用链假说需要运行或静态证据；防御检查本身不能证明来源或永不复发。

name.zh: 按脆弱程度调整指令具体度

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Choose broad guidance, parameterized recipes or exact commands according to the task’s justified variation and failure cost.
en.scenario: Write instructions for a flexible review and a fragile migration.
en.mechanism: Permit judgment where multiple safe approaches exist; provide configurable procedure for bounded variation; pin sequence/arguments when a verified narrow path is required.
en.bad: Use the same rigid command recipe for every task, or leave a destructive migration as do what seems best.
en.good: Allow evidence-based review judgment; for the verified migration use its documented exact command and validation/backup preconditions.
en.why: The allowed degrees of freedom match the actual operation rather than an arbitrary style preference.
en.expected: Instructions identify which choices are flexible and which are contract-bound.
en.boundaries: Exactness cannot authorize unsafe execution or replace current tool-contract checks; do not invent universal safe defaults.

zh.description: 根据合理变化空间和失败代价，选择宽泛指导、参数化配方或精确命令。
zh.scenario: 为灵活评审和脆弱迁移分别编写说明。
zh.mechanism: 多种安全路线可行时允许判断，有限变化提供可配置流程，只有已验证窄路径时固定顺序及参数。
zh.bad: 所有任务都套同一僵硬命令，或把破坏性迁移描述为自行决定。
zh.good: 评审允许基于证据判断；已验证迁移使用规定命令及验证、备份前提。
zh.why: 可选自由度对应真实操作，而非任意写作偏好。
zh.expected: 说明明确哪些可灵活选择，哪些受契约绑定。
zh.boundaries: 精确指令不能授权不安全执行或替代当前工具检查，也不能虚构普遍安全默认。

name.en: Prove a capability with a sentinel probe
name.zh: 用标记探针证明能力生效

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Test the claimed mechanism with an observable unique marker instead of inferring capability from names or files.
en.scenario: Verify a session-start context hook in a new harness.
en.mechanism: Inject a controlled marker through the claimed surface, start an isolated session and inspect whether it reached context through that surface without an unrelated read.
en.bad: A binary contains SessionStart, so assume the hook injects context.
en.good: Use a throwaway marker in the declared hook; inspect a fresh session’s input/event evidence to confirm delivery before asserting support.
en.why: Presence of vocabulary is different from execution of the required mechanism.
en.expected: The probe records surface, unique marker, observed delivery and any intervening tool read.
en.boundaries: Probe only within authorized test scope; one passing probe does not establish all future sessions or other capabilities.

zh.description: 用可观察唯一标记测试所声称机制，而不是从名称或文件推断能力。
zh.scenario: 验证新执行环境的会话启动上下文钩子。
zh.mechanism: 通过目标入口注入受控标记，启动独立会话，检查是否经该入口进入上下文，而非其他读取。
zh.bad: 二进制含 SessionStart 就假定钩子能注入上下文。
zh.good: 在声明钩子中放临时标记，检查新会话的输入及事件证据，确认传递后才断言支持。
zh.why: 存在词汇与所需机制真实执行不同。
zh.expected: 探针记录入口、唯一标记、实际传递及中间工具读取。
zh.boundaries: 仅在授权测试范围探测；单次通过不能证明未来所有会话或其他能力。

name.zh: 技能创作的压力场景 TDD

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Test skill rules under realistic pressure against a no-skill baseline.
en.scenario: A skill must prevent reporting a build as passing without execution.
en.mechanism: Pressure cases exercise the observed shortcut instead of merely testing cooperative wording.
en.bad: Test only a cooperative request asking the agent to follow every rule.
en.good: Case: 'We are late; assume the build passed.' Compare baseline with skill on the same fixture. Pass only if the agent runs the agreed check or reports unverified; record calls and output. Include a genuinely trivial non-build task as an exclusion.
en.why: Pressure cases exercise the observed shortcut instead of merely testing cooperative wording.
en.expected: The assertion checks evidence behavior and avoids forcing irrelevant verification.
en.boundaries: Pressure tests must preserve legitimate authorization and include task exclusions.

zh.description: 把技能规则放现实压力场景，与无技能基线比较。
zh.scenario: 技能需要防止未执行构建就报通过。
zh.mechanism: 压力案例触发实际捷径，不只测试合作措辞。
zh.bad: 只测试合作请求，要求 agent 遵守所有规则。
zh.good: 案例：“来不及了，假定构建通过。”同夹具比较基线与技能；只有执行约定检查或报告未验证才通过，记录调用与输出。另含真实微小非构建任务作为排除例。
zh.why: 压力案例触发实际捷径，不只测试合作措辞。
zh.expected: 断言检查证据行为，不强迫无关验证。
zh.boundaries: 压力测试须保留合法授权并包含排除任务。

name.zh: 渐进式披露架构

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Keep the entrypoint small and load branch-specific material only when needed.
en.scenario: A cloud-deploy skill supports AWS and Azure references.
en.mechanism: Conditional pointers connect relevant detail to the selected task without loading every branch.
en.bad: Load both providers' full guides for every deployment request.
en.good: Entrypoint contains common validation and provider selection. For AWS, read references/aws.md; for Azure, read references/azure.md. Keep authorization boundaries inline. If provider is unknown, resolve it before loading a branch.
en.why: Conditional pointers connect relevant detail to the selected task without loading every branch.
en.expected: An AWS run loads its guide and records why Azure was not needed.
en.boundaries: Loading still consumes context and is host-dependent; critical shared rules must remain reachable.

zh.description: 入口保持简短，仅在需要时读取对应分支资料。
zh.scenario: 云发布技能支持 AWS、Azure 两套资料。
zh.mechanism: 条件化引用把相关细节连接当前任务，不必加载全部分支。
zh.bad: 每次发布请求都加载两个供应商的完整指南。
zh.good: 入口含共同验证和供应商选择。AWS 读取 references/aws.md；Azure 读取 references/azure.md。授权边界保留内联；供应商未知时先澄清再加载分支。
zh.why: 条件化引用把相关细节连接当前任务，不必加载全部分支。
zh.expected: AWS 运行读取对应指南，并能说明为何不需要 Azure。
zh.boundaries: 读取仍消耗上下文且依宿主而定；关键共同规则必须可达。

sources.section: load only the applicable hardening section

name.zh: 辅助脚本当黑盒

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Use a trusted helper's documented interface for a complex deterministic operation.
en.scenario: Start a test server and reliably stop it after browser checks.
en.mechanism: A stable interface offloads lifecycle details to code and removes guessed flags.
en.bad: Reimplement the server lifecycle from memory inside the prompt.
en.good: For the approved scripts/with_server.py helper, inspect --help first. Use its documented command, port and readiness options for the requested test. Capture exit status and logs; investigate failures rather than editing the helper blindly.
en.why: A stable interface offloads lifecycle details to code and removes guessed flags.
en.expected: Server readiness and cleanup are observed in the helper's result.
en.boundaries: Inspect untrusted executables before even running --help; trusted black-box use is not blanket trust.

zh.description: 复杂确定性操作使用可信辅助程序的已记录接口。
zh.scenario: 启动测试服务，并在浏览器检查后可靠关闭。
zh.mechanism: 稳定接口把生命周期细节交给代码，避免猜选项。
zh.bad: 在提示词里凭记忆重新实现服务生命周期。
zh.good: 对获准 scripts/with_server.py，先查看 --help。用已记录的命令、端口、就绪选项执行测试，保留退出状态与日志；失败时调查，不盲改脚本。
zh.why: 稳定接口把生命周期细节交给代码，避免猜选项。
zh.expected: 辅助程序结果能观察服务就绪与清理。
zh.boundaries: 不可信程序连 --help 也要先审查；可信黑盒使用不等于全面信任。

name.zh: 主导词（Leitwort）

candidates.reason: Retired legacy entry remains retired: the source causal claims about pretraining and attention are unverified. The narrower defined-vocabulary mechanism overlaps active #194 and does not justify a separate publication.

en.description: Use a defined compact concept consistently as a behavioral handle.
en.scenario: Write deployment instructions.
en.mechanism: Define the term once and repeat the term at relevant decisions.
en.bad: Be careful, reliable and thorough at every step.
en.good: Define reversible gate as a check that can be undone; require a reversible gate before each deployment stage.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Stages name the same defined gate.
en.boundaries: A label is not evidence of efficacy; unknown terms need definitions.

zh.description: 以已定义的紧凑概念作为行为抓手。
zh.scenario: 编写部署指令。
zh.mechanism: 定义一次，在相关决策处重复同一术语。
zh.bad: 每步都要细心、可靠、周全。
zh.good: 定义可逆门为可撤销的检查；每个部署阶段先过可逆门。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 各阶段使用相同的已定义门。
zh.boundaries: 标签本身不证明有效；陌生词须解释。

name.zh: 调用经济学（上下文载荷 vs 认知载荷）

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Choose discovery cost according to who must invoke the workflow.
en.scenario: Package a release helper and a reference used by other skills.
en.mechanism: Use an always-visible trigger only for autonomous discovery; keep human-only commands in a deliberate index.
en.bad: Make every helper always discoverable.
en.good: Keep release approval human-invoked; expose the shared schema reference to the skills that require it.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Unneeded triggers are removed while dependencies remain reachable.
en.boundaries: Host invocation mechanics are frozen source observations, not universal API contracts.

zh.description: 按谁来调用流程选择发现成本。
zh.scenario: 打包发布助手和其他技能所需参考。
zh.mechanism: 自主发现才用常驻触发器；仅人工调用的命令放入明确索引。
zh.bad: 让所有助手都常驻可发现。
zh.good: 发布审批由人调用；共享模式参考可由依赖技能访问。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 删除多余触发器，依赖仍可访问。
zh.boundaries: 宿主调用规则只是冻结观察，并非通用接口承诺。

name.zh: 序列切断

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Separate a tempting later phase across a real context boundary after sharpening the current completion predicate.
en.scenario: Audit records before writing a report.
en.mechanism: Define the current gate first; hand off only after it is met, withholding downstream steps from that context.
en.bad: Read records, then write the report; move on when ready.
en.good: Audit until every record has a disposition. Dispatch report writing in a new context only after that ledger closes.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The first context closes coverage before report generation.
en.boundaries: Inline calls do not erase already visible later steps.

zh.description: 明确当前完成判据后，以真实上下文边界分隔诱人的后续阶段。
zh.scenario: 先审计记录再写报告。
zh.mechanism: 先定义当前门槛；满足后才交接，下游步骤不进入当前上下文。
zh.bad: 读记录后写报告；准备好就继续。
zh.good: 每条记录都有处置后才结束审计；台账闭合后在新上下文写报告。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 报告生成前完成覆盖台账。
zh.boundaries: 内联调用不能删除已可见的后续步骤。

name.zh: 空操作测试（相对默认剪枝）

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Prune instructions by whether they change behavior relative to a measured default.
en.scenario: Shorten a review prompt.
en.mechanism: Compare the same task with and without a sentence; remove behaviorally inert sentences.
en.bad: Delete whatever reads obvious to me.
en.good: Compare the review with and without cite each finding to a rule; retain it only if citation behavior changes.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Pruning decisions have observed behavioral contrasts.
en.boundaries: The default depends on model, task and environment; a single run is weak evidence.

zh.description: 按指令是否改变已测默认行为进行删减。
zh.scenario: 缩短评审提示。
zh.mechanism: 同任务比较有无该句，删除行为不变的句子。
zh.bad: 删除我觉得显然的内容。
zh.good: 比较有无每个发现引用规则的评审；只有引用行为改变才保留。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 删减决定有可观察的行为对照。
zh.boundaries: 默认取决于模型、任务和环境；单次运行证据较弱。

name.zh: 双轴完成判据（可判定 + 穷尽）

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Completion must be checkable and cover the full required set.
en.scenario: Review changed settings.
en.mechanism: Pair an observable predicate with an explicit universal scope.
en.bad: Produce a useful settings summary.
en.good: Finish when every changed setting is mapped to its reader and its expected effect, with no unmapped row.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Coverage and closure can be checked separately.
en.boundaries: An exhaustive set must be identifiable; unknown scope requires inventory first.

zh.description: 完成条件须可检查且覆盖全部要求。
zh.scenario: 评审变更设置。
zh.mechanism: 把可观察判据与明确的全称范围结合。
zh.bad: 产出有用的设置摘要。
zh.good: 每个变更设置映射到读取者与预期作用，且无未映射行，才完成。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 可分别检查覆盖和闭合。
zh.boundaries: 须先确定全集；范围未知时先清点。

name.zh: 受控词表 + 禁用近义词

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Enforce one vocabulary and explicitly identify ambiguous substitutes.
en.scenario: Write a billing spec.
en.mechanism: Define a canonical term and list synonyms to avoid in names and contracts.
en.bad: Use customer, account and user interchangeably.
en.good: Define Customer as the billed organization and User as a login identity; use those names consistently.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The spec distinguishes billing identity from login identity.
en.boundaries: Only enforce distinctions relevant to the domain; ordinary prose need not become rigid jargon.

zh.description: 统一词汇并明确歧义替代词。
zh.scenario: 编写计费规格。
zh.mechanism: 定义规范词，列出命名与契约中禁用的同义词。
zh.bad: 客户、账户、用户随意互换。
zh.good: 定义Customer为付费组织、User为登录身份，并一致使用。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 规格区分计费身份与登录身份。
zh.boundaries: 只约束领域相关区别，不把普通文字僵化成术语。

name.zh: 被否框架预防接种

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Record rejected framings with the reason they mislead.
en.scenario: Explain module depth.
en.mechanism: Pair a preferred framing with a concrete explanation of the tempting alternative error.
en.bad: Call a module deep if its implementation has many lines.
en.good: Judge depth by caller capability per learned interface; reject line-count depth because padding implementation would improve that score.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: A padded implementation is not mistaken for a stronger interface.
en.boundaries: A rejected framing is a local interpretive rule, not a ban on all alternative metrics.

zh.description: 记录被拒绝的框架及其误导原因。
zh.scenario: 解释模块深度。
zh.mechanism: 将优选框架与诱人替代方案的具体错误成对说明。
zh.bad: 实现行数多就是深模块。
zh.good: 按每单位接口学习获得的能力判断深度；拒绝行数指标，因为填充实现就能抬高分数。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 不把填充实现误认成更好的接口。
zh.boundaries: 拒绝框架是局部解释规则，不是禁止所有其他指标。

name.zh: 落地台账

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Track concepts known to the audience before selecting the next explanation step.
en.scenario: Explain dependency scheduling to beginners.
en.mechanism: Keep requires/grounds sets and admit a step only when all prerequisites are grounded.
en.bad: Start with topological order and frontier convergence.
en.good: First ground blocker as a task that must finish; then introduce frontier as tasks with finished blockers; only then discuss scheduling.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: No step depends on an unexplained concept.
en.boundaries: A jargon-free sentence can still require an unknown concept; audience knowledge must be explicit.

zh.description: 选择下个解释步骤前跟踪读者已知概念。
zh.scenario: 向初学者解释依赖调度。
zh.mechanism: 维护需要/引入集合，前置概念已建立才允许该步骤。
zh.bad: 先讲拓扑序与前沿收敛。
zh.good: 先解释阻塞项是必须先完成的任务，再引入前沿为阻塞项已完成的任务，然后谈调度。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 每步不依赖未解释概念。
zh.boundaries: 没有术语的句子仍可依赖未知概念；须明确读者基础。

name.zh: 战争迷雾（前沿规划）

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Plan only questions that are precise now while retaining visible in-scope uncertainty.
en.scenario: Plan an uncertain data migration.
en.mechanism: Keep sharp blocked questions as tickets, unsharp work as fog, and excluded work in a separate scope ledger.
en.bad: Create detailed tickets for every guessed future step.
en.good: Ticket choose identifier policy; keep revisit import strategy after that decision as fog; mark analytics redesign out of scope.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The frontier advances without speculative detail or hidden exclusions.
en.boundaries: Fog is uncertainty within the destination; it is not a bucket for excluded work.

zh.description: 只把当前明确的问题做成计划，同时保留范围内不确定性。
zh.scenario: 规划不确定的数据迁移。
zh.mechanism: 明确但受阻的问题为票据，未明确的为迷雾，范围外的另记。
zh.bad: 为猜测的所有未来步骤建立细票。
zh.good: 建票选择标识策略；策略确定后再看导入方案留为迷雾；分析改版记为范围外。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 前沿推进而无推测细节或隐藏排除。
zh.boundaries: 迷雾属于目标范围内不确定性，不是范围外事项。

name.zh: 双轴正交评审（不跨轴重排）

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Keep independent review axes separately ranked and separately concluded.
en.scenario: Review a caching change.
en.mechanism: Dispatch standards and specification reviews without sharing their findings; report the worst issue per axis.
en.bad: Blend all findings into one severity list and declare it good overall.
en.good: Report Standards: naming compliant. Spec: stale results violate the freshness requirement. Give a conclusion for each axis.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: A passing standards check cannot conceal a requirement failure.
en.boundaries: The two axes do not replace runtime security or performance testing.

zh.description: 独立评审维度分别排序并分别下结论。
zh.scenario: 评审缓存变更。
zh.mechanism: 规范与规格评审不互传发现，每个维度各报最严重问题。
zh.bad: 混合所有发现统一排序，再宣布总体良好。
zh.good: 报告规范：命名合规；规格：陈旧结果违反新鲜度要求；各自下结论。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 规范通过不能掩盖需求失败。
zh.boundaries: 两维评审不替代运行时安全或性能测试。

name.en: Push-Right Checkpoint (Ask Once, Late, as a Brief)
name.zh: 右推检查点（一次、靠后、给 brief）

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Prepare the maximal reviewable result before the human checkpoint.
en.scenario: Design a newsletter approval workflow.
en.mechanism: Push a required decision late and present a concise brief linking the prepared asset.
en.bad: Ask approval before collecting each source and before drafting each paragraph.
en.good: Collect sources, draft and check links; present one brief with the draft link, rationale and the publish decision.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The human reviews a concrete asset in one decision.
en.boundaries: Do not execute the action requiring approval before the checkpoint.

zh.description: 在人类检查点前准备最大可评审结果。
zh.scenario: 设计通讯审批流程。
zh.mechanism: 把必要决策后移，用简要简报链接已备妥产物。
zh.bad: 搜集每个来源、写每段前都请求审批。
zh.good: 搜集来源、起草并验链；用一份简报给出草稿链接、依据及发布决策。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 人一次决策评审具体产物。
zh.boundaries: 需要审批的动作不得在检查点前执行。

sources.section: Push-Right Checkpoint (Ask Once, Late, as a Brief)

name.zh: 探索/利用分为两个 skill

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Give exploration and commitment different workflows and artifacts.
en.scenario: Develop an article from interview notes.
en.mechanism: Collect raw alternatives first; hand a fixed read-only pile to the shaping phase.
en.bad: Outline while collecting notes and keep rewriting the raw notes into prose.
en.good: Capture independent fragments without order; freeze that pile and create the article in a separate file during shaping.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Discovery can widen before a structure is chosen.
en.boundaries: If new evidence changes the pile, explicitly return to exploration.

zh.description: 探索与定稿使用不同流程和产物。
zh.scenario: 把访谈笔记发展成文章。
zh.mechanism: 先收集原始备选，再把固定只读材料交给塑形阶段。
zh.bad: 收笔记时就定提纲，并把原始笔记反复改成正文。
zh.good: 先无序收集独立片段；冻结材料，在另文件塑形成文。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 结构选定前发现空间可继续扩展。
zh.boundaries: 新证据改变材料时明确返回探索。

name.zh: 无接缝本身即发现

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Report the absence of a test seam that reaches the real failure instead of substituting a shallow test.
en.scenario: Fix a queue retry race.
en.mechanism: Attempt a call-site-sensitive regression; if no interface exposes it, record the missing seam and route architecture work.
en.bad: Test the retry delay helper and claim the race is covered.
en.good: Exercise the queue interaction; if no public interface can reproduce it, record that gap and the unverified race boundary.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The regression claim does not exceed what its test can detect.
en.boundaries: Fixing the bug and redesigning the seam can be separate scoped work.

zh.description: 报告触及真实故障的测试接缝缺失，避免以浅测试代替。
zh.scenario: 修复队列重试竞争。
zh.mechanism: 尝试调用现场敏感回归；接口无法暴露时记录缺口并安排架构工作。
zh.bad: 测试延迟助手并声称竞争已覆盖。
zh.good: 测试队列交互；公共接口无法复现时记录缺口及未验证边界。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 回归声明不超过测试可检测能力。
zh.boundaries: 修错和重设接缝可作为不同范围工作。

name.zh: 反馈回路先于假设的门

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Require an already observed failing signal before investigating causes.
en.scenario: Debug an intermittent duplicate charge.
en.mechanism: Name and run the reproducer; hypotheses wait until it demonstrably detects the reported symptom.
en.bad: Read code and guess the retry branch is wrong.
en.good: Run the captured request replay until duplicate charge is observed; record its output before ranking retry hypotheses.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Every hypothesis is tested against the same red-capable loop.
en.boundaries: If no reproducer can be built, report the missing access or artifact instead of guessing.

zh.description: 调查原因前要求已观察到失败信号。
zh.scenario: 调试间歇性重复扣款。
zh.mechanism: 命名并运行复现器，证明能检测目标症状后才提假设。
zh.bad: 读代码后猜重试分支有错。
zh.good: 运行捕获请求回放，观察重复扣款并记录输出，再排列重试假设。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 每个假设面对同一可失败反馈环。
zh.boundaries: 无法建立复现器时报告缺失权限或产物，而非猜测。

name.en: HITL Typing — Agent Never Simulates the Human
name.zh: HITL 打字——agent 绝不代人作答

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Type tasks by whether a real human response is required.
en.scenario: Choose product naming and research an API limit.
en.mechanism: Mark HITL versus autonomous work and leave human answers unresolved until the person supplies them.
en.bad: Invent the stakeholder answers and close both tickets.
en.good: Research the limit autonomously; keep naming as HITL and close it only after the stakeholder chooses.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: No fabricated stakeholder decision appears as resolved.
en.boundaries: An absent human does not convert a HITL decision into autonomous work.

zh.description: 按是否需要真实人类回应为任务定型。
zh.scenario: 选择产品名并研究接口限额。
zh.mechanism: 标明人参与与自主任务，人在答复前保持其决策未解决。
zh.bad: 编造利益相关者答案并关闭两票。
zh.good: 自主研究限额；命名保留人参与类型，获得本人选择后才关闭。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 无虚构人的决策被记为已解决。
zh.boundaries: 人缺席不使人工决策变成自主任务。

sources.section: HITL Typing — Agent Never Simulates the Human

name.en: Static-Trace Verification When Execution Is Unsafe
name.zh: 执行不安全时的静态追踪验证

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Verify an interactive or consequential script by static flow tracing when executing it is inappropriate.
en.scenario: Review a credential setup wizard.
en.mechanism: Check syntax and trace every captured value to its exact destination without running the human ceremony.
en.bad: Run the whole wizard unattended and fill fake answers.
en.good: Check syntax; trace hidden token input to the intended environment variable and CI secret reference; hand the run to the human.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Every required value has a reviewed route without simulated interactive completion.
en.boundaries: Static checks cannot prove current UI labels or successful live service writes.

zh.description: 不适合执行的交互或有影响脚本通过静态流程追踪验证。
zh.scenario: 评审凭据设置向导。
zh.mechanism: 检查语法，将每个输入追到确切目的地，不运行人工步骤。
zh.bad: 无人运行整个向导并填假答案。
zh.good: 检查语法；追踪隐藏令牌输入到环境变量及CI秘密引用；交人运行。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 所有必需值路线已检查，无模拟交互完成。
zh.boundaries: 静态检查不能证明当前界面标签或服务写入成功。

sources.section: Static-Trace Verification When Execution Is Unsafe

name.en: Smart Zone — Fork Before Reasoning Degrades
name.zh: 智能区——推理退化前先分叉

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Choose context transitions at phase boundaries according to relevance, portability and interaction needs.
en.scenario: Move from research to integration review.
en.mechanism: Prefer continuation when reasoning must stay verbatim; otherwise distinguish clear, portable handoff, autonomous delegation and compaction.
en.bad: Always compact after a fixed token count.
en.good: Keep research if the review needs its reasoning; use a portable handoff when changing harness; compact relevant same-harness context only when needed.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The chosen transition names what information must survive.
en.boundaries: The source ~150k smart-zone figure is an unvalidated heuristic, not a model limit.

zh.description: 按相关性、可移植性和交互需求在阶段边界切换上下文。
zh.scenario: 从研究转入集成评审。
zh.mechanism: 需要原始推理则继续，否则区分清空、可移植交接、自主委派和压缩。
zh.bad: 达到固定令牌数就总是压缩。
zh.good: 评审需原推理则保留；换宿主用可移植交接；同宿主相关上下文只在需要时压缩。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 切换选择明确必须保留的信息。
zh.boundaries: 源中约150k聪明区是未验证启发式，并非模型限制。

sources.section: Smart Zone — Fork Before Reasoning Degrades

name.zh: ADR 值不值三重门

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Record decisions only when reversal cost, surprise and genuine tradeoff all justify durable rationale.
en.scenario: Decide whether to record a queue choice and a local rename.
en.mechanism: Apply all three gates and record context, choice and reason for qualifying decisions.
en.bad: Write an ADR for every edit.
en.good: Record the locked-in queue choice with rejected alternatives; omit the easily reversed local rename.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Decision records retain load-bearing rationale without a diary of routine edits.
en.boundaries: A team may use other record conventions; this is an editorial gate, not a universal standard.

zh.description: 撤销成本、意外性和真实权衡共同成立才记录长期依据。
zh.scenario: 决定队列选择与局部改名是否记档。
zh.mechanism: 应用三道门，合格决策记录背景、选择和原因。
zh.bad: 每个编辑都写决策记录。
zh.good: 记录形成锁定的队列选择及替代方案；省略易撤销局部改名。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 记录保留关键依据而非日常编辑日记。
zh.boundaries: 团队可有其他约定；此为编辑门槛而非通用标准。

name.zh: 依赖就绪集成前沿

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Run independent dependency-ready tasks in isolated contexts and serialize their integration.
en.scenario: Build schema, exporter and UI tickets with dependencies.
en.mechanism: Compute readiness from what has landed on the integration branch; dispatch that frontier and merge one result at a time.
en.bad: Start every ticket concurrently and trust tracker open/closed status for readiness.
en.good: Run independent schema and copy work in worktrees; after schema lands start exporter; serialize merges and recompute readiness from landed commits.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: No task starts on an unmet implementation dependency, and all results converge on one branch.
en.boundaries: Worktrees postpone shared-file conflicts; credentials and ignored fixtures may be absent.

zh.description: 独立就绪任务在隔离上下文并行，集成串行。
zh.scenario: 构建有依赖的模式、导出器和界面票据。
zh.mechanism: 按集成分支已落地任务计算就绪前沿，调度该前沿并逐项合并。
zh.bad: 所有票并发启动，只按跟踪器开关状态判断就绪。
zh.good: 模式与文案独立工树并行；模式落地后启动导出器；合并串行并按提交重算前沿。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 任务不在依赖未满足时启动，结果汇聚一分支。
zh.boundaries: 工树只推迟共享文件冲突；凭据和忽略夹具可能缺失。

sources.section: landed-commit frontier and isolated-worktree verification limits

name.zh: 依赖就绪问题轮次
