candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Ask only decisions whose prerequisites have already settled, then recompute the next round.
en.scenario: Interview about a notification system.
en.mechanism: Treat answers and factual explorations as prerequisite nodes; unresolved nodes block only their dependents.
en.bad: Ask retention policy, database type and purge schedule all at once.
en.good: First settle legal retention and delivery needs; research provider limits independently; ask purge schedule only after retention is answered.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Later questions do not silently assume answers still pending.
en.boundaries: A question tree can miss a branch; the empty frontier needs explicit scope review.

zh.description: 只问前置已定的决策，随后重算下一轮。
zh.scenario: 访谈通知系统需求。
zh.mechanism: 答案和事实探索均为依赖节点，未定节点仅阻塞下游。
zh.bad: 同时问保留政策、数据库类型和清理周期。
zh.good: 先定法规保留及交付需求；独立研究供应商限额；保留期答后才问清理周期。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 后续问题不暗含尚未得到的答案。
zh.boundaries: 问题树可能漏分支；前沿为空须核对范围。

name.zh: 耐久行为代理契约

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Describe behavior and named interfaces instead of volatile file locations in delayed task handoffs.
en.scenario: Queue a JSON-output fix for next week.
en.mechanism: State current/desired behavior, independently testable acceptance criteria, interface names and exclusions.
en.bad: Edit handler.ts line 80 and add a switch.
en.good: Under --json emit valid JSON for success and errors, preserve exit codes; modify the output interface; exclude other commands.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: A renamed file does not invalidate the task contract.
en.boundaries: Exact paths remain useful for immediate observations; durable handoffs still need version context.

zh.description: 延迟交接用行为和接口名代替易变文件位置。
zh.scenario: 把JSON输出修复排到下周。
zh.mechanism: 明确当前/目标行为、独立可测验收、接口名和排除项。
zh.bad: 编辑handler.ts第80行加switch。
zh.good: --json下成功与错误均为有效JSON，保持退出码；修改输出接口；其他命令不在范围。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 文件改名不使任务契约失效。
zh.boundaries: 即时观察仍可用确切路径；耐久交接仍需版本背景。

name.zh: 概念级拒绝记忆

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Recall substantive rejected concepts without poisoning that memory with already implemented requests.
en.scenario: Triage a night-theme request.
en.mechanism: Match by concept, ask whether rationale still holds, and keep rejections distinct from built features and temporary deferrals.
en.bad: Close it because a vaguely similar issue is closed.
en.good: Find the durable theming rejection, show its rationale and ask whether it still holds; if the feature already exists, link implementation instead.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Repeated concepts reuse reviewed rationale without false rejection inference.
en.boundaries: Similarity is a lead, not authority; maintainers may reconsider or distinguish the request.

zh.description: 回忆实质拒绝概念，不把已实现请求混入拒绝记忆。
zh.scenario: 分诊夜间主题请求。
zh.mechanism: 按概念匹配，复核理由仍成立，并区别已实现与临时推迟。
zh.bad: 相似问题已关闭就关闭新请求。
zh.good: 找到持久主题拒绝，展示依据并复核；若功能已实现则链接实现。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 重复概念复用经审理由，无错误拒绝推断。
zh.boundaries: 相似仅为线索，维护者可重议或认定不同。

name.en: Mechanics to checks, judgment to review
name.zh: 机械规则检查、判断规则评审

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Turn syntactic mistakes into deterministic checks and reserve prose rules for judgment.
en.scenario: Prevent forbidden deep imports.
en.mechanism: Inspect existing checks, repair their wiring first, then encode fixed patterns in the cheapest local guardrail.
en.bad: Add remember not to deep import to the global prompt.
en.good: Wire the existing import checker into CI; add the forbidden-depth rule and verify it rejects a temporary violation.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The recurring violation is caught independently of instruction recall.
en.boundaries: A check must distinguish forbidden from allowed cases; judgment cannot always be reduced to syntax.

zh.description: 语法错误转成确定检查，判断问题留给文字评审规则。
zh.scenario: 防止禁止的深导入。
zh.mechanism: 先检查现有检查并修接线，再用最便宜本地护栏编码固定模式。
zh.bad: 全局提示加入记得不深导入。
zh.good: 把已有导入检查接入CI，加深度规则并验证临时违规会失败。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 重复违规不依赖记住指令即可拦截。
zh.boundaries: 检查须区分允许与禁止；判断不总能化为语法。

sources.section: Mechanics to checks, judgment to review

name.zh: 差异化设计简报

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Generate alternatives under intentionally different constraints instead of multiplying identical proposals.
en.scenario: Design a file-import interface.
en.mechanism: Give each independent designer a different optimization objective, a shared vocabulary and the same required output schema.
en.bad: Ask three agents to design the best interface.
en.good: Ask one to minimize entry points, one to support extensions, one to optimize the common caller; compare invariants, usage and hidden complexity.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Alternatives expose concrete tradeoffs rather than repeated first ideas.
en.boundaries: Independent prompts do not guarantee independent ideas; compare actual differences.

zh.description: 用不同约束生成替代方案，而非倍增相同建议。
zh.scenario: 设计文件导入接口。
zh.mechanism: 独立设计者各有优化目标，共享词汇与输出结构。
zh.bad: 让三个代理各设计最佳接口。
zh.good: 一个最少入口，一个支持扩展，一个优化常见调用者；比较不变量、用法和隐藏复杂度。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 备选揭示权衡而非重复首想法。
zh.boundaries: 独立提示不保证独立思想，须比较实际差异。

name.zh: 问题驱动的一次性实验

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Choose the prototype artifact by the uncertainty it must resolve and expose relevant state.
en.scenario: Test whether undo semantics feel right.
en.mechanism: Distinguish logic/state from visual uncertainty; minimize setup, use scratch state and preserve the question and verdict.
en.bad: Build a polished production-style UI with a real database.
en.good: Make one in-memory interactive state demo, show state after each action, exercise conflicting edits and capture the undo verdict.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The experiment answers the declared question with visible transitions.
en.boundaries: A prototype verdict does not establish production robustness.

zh.description: 按待解不确定性选择原型产物，并暴露相关状态。
zh.scenario: 验证撤销语义是否合适。
zh.mechanism: 区别逻辑状态与视觉问题，最小启动成本，使用临时状态并保存问题和结论。
zh.bad: 构建精致生产界面并连接真实库。
zh.good: 一个内存状态交互演示，每动作展示状态，运行冲突编辑并保存撤销结论。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 实验以可见转移回答声明问题。
zh.boundaries: 原型结论不证明生产稳健性。

name.zh: 消除呈现答案线索

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Keep an assessment from leaking its answer through presentation differences.
en.scenario: Create a retry-policy quiz.
en.mechanism: Make option lengths and formatting comparable, then give feedback based on the tested skill.
en.bad: Make the correct answer the only long, detailed option.
en.good: Use comparably detailed options, avoid unique emphasis and explain the policy only after the learner chooses.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Success is less attributable to option formatting alone.
en.boundaries: Matching length cannot remove semantic clues or prove valid measurement.

zh.description: 避免测评通过呈现差异泄露答案。
zh.scenario: 编写重试策略测验。
zh.mechanism: 选项长度格式可比，再按所测技能提供反馈。
zh.bad: 正确选项是唯一冗长详细项。
zh.good: 选项详细程度相当，无独特强调，选择后才解释策略。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 成功较少仅归因于格式线索。
zh.boundaries: 长度相同不能去掉语义线索或证明测量有效。

name.zh: 护栏反例证明

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Verify a guardrail rejects an intentional violation, then returns to clean success.
en.scenario: Install an import-boundary rule.
en.mechanism: Observe pass on allowed input, fail on a temporary forbidden input, and pass after removal.
en.bad: Check that the configuration file exists.
en.good: Run the clean package, inject a forbidden deep import and observe the named error, remove it and observe success.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The installed rule is demonstrably wired to the actual command.
en.boundaries: One counterexample does not establish complete bypass resistance.

zh.description: 验证护栏会拒绝故意违规，并回到干净成功。
zh.scenario: 安装导入边界规则。
zh.mechanism: 允许输入通过，临时禁止输入失败，移除后再通过。
zh.bad: 检查配置文件存在。
zh.good: 跑干净包，注入深导入并看到指定错误，移除后再看通过。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 已证明规则接入实际命令。
zh.boundaries: 单个反例不证明完全防绕过。

name.en: Reread shared artifacts before incremental writes
name.zh: 增量写入前重读共享产物

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Preserve intervening human edits while materializing agreed work incrementally.
en.scenario: Coauthor an article while the author edits it.
en.mechanism: Read current disk contents before each append or targeted rewrite; keep the input corpus separate.
en.bad: Keep a cached copy and rewrite the entire article after each paragraph.
en.good: Reread the article, append only the agreed paragraph, and apply a requested rewrite to that paragraph without replacing the rest.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The author edits survive subsequent agent writes.
en.boundaries: Rereading is not an atomic concurrency lock; simultaneous writes need stronger coordination.

zh.description: 增量落地共识时保留人类中间修改。
zh.scenario: 作者编辑期间共同写文章。
zh.mechanism: 每次追加或定向改写先重读磁盘；原材料单独保存。
zh.bad: 缓存全文，每段后重写整个文件。
zh.good: 重读文章，只追加已同意段落；指定重写仅改该段，不覆盖其余。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 后续代理写入保留作者修改。
zh.boundaries: 重读不是原子并发锁；同时写入需要更强协调。

sources.section: Reread shared artifacts before incremental writes

name.zh: 证据门控学习记忆

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Store demonstrated knowledge separately from material merely covered.
en.scenario: Choose the next lesson after explaining transaction isolation.
en.mechanism: Record demonstrated use, explicit prior-knowledge depth or corrected misconceptions; supersede contrary records instead of erasing history.
en.bad: Mark isolation mastered because the lesson was displayed.
en.good: Record which anomaly the learner correctly predicts; note the untested cases; supersede that record if later answers show a misconception.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Lesson selection can inspect evidence and its limits.
en.boundaries: Self-reported prior knowledge is a claim with stated depth, not a demonstrated assessment.

zh.description: 将已证明知识与仅已讲过材料分开存储。
zh.scenario: 解释事务隔离后选下节课。
zh.mechanism: 记实际运用、明确先验深度或纠正误解；相反记录以取代标记保留历史。
zh.bad: 展示课程后即记为掌握隔离。
zh.good: 记录学员正确预测的异常及未测情况；后续显示误解则取代此记录。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 课程选择可检查证据及其边界。
zh.boundaries: 自述知识是有深度说明的声明，不是已证明测评。

name.en: Question the knowledge owner through a send brief
name.zh: 通过发送简报询问知识持有者

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Ask the requester who holds missing knowledge and what decision needs it, then target the actual owner.
en.scenario: Resolve a partner retention policy unknown to the developer.
en.mechanism: Interview recipient/context and required return, map every required fact to one fillable question ordered by decision importance.
en.bad: Grill the developer until they guess the partner policy.
en.good: Ask who owns partner policy and which retention decision is blocked; draft focused questions for that person with uncertainty explicitly allowed.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The missing facts are routed to a person able to supply them.
en.boundaries: One recipient may not own all answers; split by actual knowledge ownership.

zh.description: 先问请求者缺失知识归谁及支持何决策，再面向真正持有者。
zh.scenario: 解决开发者不知的伙伴保留政策。
zh.mechanism: 询问接收人背景和所需答复，每个所需事实映射成一个可填问题并按决策重要度排序。
zh.bad: 反复盘问开发者直到猜出伙伴政策。
zh.good: 询问政策归属及受阻决策；为该人写聚焦问题，明确可答未知。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 缺失事实被送到能够提供的人。
zh.boundaries: 单个接收人未必掌握全部，按知识归属拆分。

sources.section: Question the knowledge owner through a send brief

name.zh: 覆盖分支的上下文指针

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: A context pointer names both its target and the distinct conditions that need it.
en.scenario: Route cancellation requests to a refund reference.
en.mechanism: Write one trigger per branch and front-load its recognizable concept; deduplicate synonyms rather than distinct cases.
en.bad: See refunds.md when relevant.
en.good: For full cancellation or partial return, consult refunds.md before calculating the refund; keep order lookup in its own branch.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Each declared refund branch has an explicit reference path.
en.boundaries: Trigger wording must be tested in the real host; descriptions do not guarantee loading.

zh.description: 上下文指针同时说明目标和需要它的不同条件。
zh.scenario: 把取消请求路由到退款参考。
zh.mechanism: 每分支一个触发条件，前置易认概念；去掉同义重述而非不同情形。
zh.bad: 相关时看refunds.md。
zh.good: 完整取消或部分退货时，计算退款前查refunds.md；订单查询另成分支。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 每个退款分支有明确参考路径。
zh.boundaries: 须在真实宿主测试触发措辞；描述不保证载入。

name.zh: 同处组织概念规则与边界

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Keep one concept definition, decision rules and exceptions together after selecting its disclosure tier.
en.scenario: Write a retry-policy runbook.
en.mechanism: Separate ordered steps from reference, disclose branch-specific reference, and group each concept under one heading.
en.bad: Put the definition at the top, exceptions in setup notes and the decision table at the bottom.
en.good: Keep retryable definition, eligibility table and non-idempotent exception in one retry-policy reference linked at the retry decision.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Reading the decision rule also reveals its exception.
en.boundaries: Co-location is not duplication; shared authoritative reference can still live in another file.

zh.description: 选择披露层级后把概念定义、规则和例外放在一起。
zh.scenario: 编写重试操作手册。
zh.mechanism: 区分步骤与参考，分支参考按需披露，每概念同一标题组织。
zh.bad: 定义放开头，例外放设置备注，决策表放末尾。
zh.good: 重试定义、资格表和非幂等例外同处参考，在重试决策处链接。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 读决策规则也能看到例外。
zh.boundaries: 同处不等于重复；共享权威参考仍可在别文件。

name.en: Environment as instruction source of truth
name.zh: 环境作为指令事实源

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Avoid maintaining a stale prose cache of cheap executable environment facts.
en.scenario: Document a project check command.
en.mechanism: Reference inspectable config/help for scripts and paths; document only unwritten conventions or expensive lookups.
en.bad: Copy the package scripts into several agent instruction files.
en.good: Tell the agent to read the check script in package.json; document separately why the integration fixture is required.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Changing the script needs one authoritative edit.
en.boundaries: Cache a lookup when its cost is material, but identify its freshness obligation.

zh.description: 避免以文字维护便宜可查环境事实的陈旧缓存。
zh.scenario: 记录项目检查命令。
zh.mechanism: 脚本路径查配置或帮助，只记录隐含约定或昂贵查询。
zh.bad: 把包脚本复制到多个代理指令文件。
zh.good: 指向package.json中的检查脚本，另记集成夹具为何必需。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 改脚本只需一处权威编辑。
zh.boundaries: 查询昂贵可缓存，但须标明新鲜度责任。

sources.section: Environment as instruction source of truth

name.zh: 按依赖性质校准验证适配器

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Choose verification substitutes according to the dependency controlled by the module.
en.scenario: Test an order module with database and third-party payments.
en.mechanism: Distinguish in-process, local-substitutable, remote-owned and true external dependencies before choosing real stand-ins, ports or mocks.
en.bad: Mock every internal function to make tests fast.
en.good: Use a local database stand-in through the module interface; inject only the external payment port and verify observed outcomes.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The tested boundary reflects ownership and real failure surfaces.
en.boundaries: A stand-in may differ from production; contract/integration checks remain necessary.

zh.description: 按模块控制的依赖选择验证替身。
zh.scenario: 测试有数据库和第三方付款的订单模块。
zh.mechanism: 先区别进程内、本地可替代、远端自有和真正外部，再选真实替身、端口或模拟。
zh.bad: 为速度模拟全部内部函数。
zh.good: 通过模块接口使用本地数据库替身；仅注入外部支付端口，并验证可见结果。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 测试边界反映所有权与真实故障表面。
zh.boundaries: 替身可异于生产，仍需契约或集成检查。

name.zh: 抽象前删除探针

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Challenge an abstraction by predicting where complexity would go if it vanished.
en.scenario: Decide whether to keep a one-method parser wrapper.
en.mechanism: Trace caller obligations after hypothetical deletion; retain hidden reusable behavior and collapse pure pass-through layers.
en.bad: Keep it because extra layers are cleaner.
en.good: Compare callers with and without the wrapper; collapse it if nothing is hidden, retain it if each caller would duplicate validation and ordering rules.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The recommendation cites an actual responsibility rather than layer count.
en.boundaries: Hypothetical deletion is a reasoning aid; dependencies and compatibility still constrain actual removal.

zh.description: 预测抽象消失后复杂度去向以检验抽象。
zh.scenario: 决定是否保留单方法解析包装。
zh.mechanism: 追踪假想删除后的调用责任；保留隐藏的可复用行为，合并纯转发层。
zh.bad: 更多层更整洁，所以保留。
zh.good: 比较有无包装的调用者；无隐藏责任则合并；调用者需重复校验和排序则保留。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 建议引用实际责任而非层数。
zh.boundaries: 假想删除是推理工具；实际删除仍受依赖兼容约束。

name.zh: 保兼容迁移票据

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Use expand/migrate/contract stages when a broad mechanical change cannot land in independent vertical slices.
en.scenario: Rename a shared configuration field across packages.
en.mechanism: Introduce both forms, migrate callers in bounded batches, and remove the old form only after all callers migrate.
en.bad: Rename the field once and let every package ticket fail until integration.
en.good: Add new field alongside old, migrate each package while both work, then remove the old field after a caller inventory reaches zero.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Each staged batch has an explicit compatibility condition.
en.boundaries: If batches cannot pass alone, use a declared integration-only verification gate.

zh.description: 广泛机械变化无法独立垂直落地时采用扩展迁移收缩。
zh.scenario: 跨包改共享配置字段名。
zh.mechanism: 新旧形式并存，分批迁移调用者，全部迁完才删旧形式。
zh.bad: 先统一改名，让每包票据一直失败到集成。
zh.good: 新旧字段并存，各包在两者可用时迁移，调用者清点归零后删除旧字段。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 每批有明确兼容条件。
zh.boundaries: 批次无法独立通过时明确仅集成验证的门槛。

name.en: Compare structural variants in shared context
name.zh: 共享现场比较结构变体

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Compare design alternatives inside the real host context and hold data constant.
en.scenario: Choose a settings-page layout.
en.mechanism: Vary structure through a shareable selector on one route while retaining host navigation, density and read-only data.
en.bad: Show three empty screens with different colors.
en.good: Render different navigation and hierarchy variants on the populated settings route using the same data, and share each variant URL.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: Differences can be attributed to structure within the actual surrounding page.
en.boundaries: Real mutations need stubs; a prototype is not production-quality implementation.

zh.description: 在真实承载现场比较设计，固定数据。
zh.scenario: 选择设置页布局。
zh.mechanism: 同一路由通过可分享选择器变结构，保留导航、密度和只读数据。
zh.bad: 展示三个只换颜色的空页面。
zh.good: 在有数据的设置路由呈现不同导航层级，用同样数据并分享变体链接。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 差异可归因于实际周边中的结构。
zh.boundaries: 真实修改须用桩；原型不等于生产实现。

sources.section: Compare structural variants in shared context

name.en: Explicit partial and invalid fixture intent
name.zh: 明确部分与非法夹具意图

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Distinguish incomplete valid fixtures from intentionally invalid input.
en.scenario: Test request validation and a body-only handler.
en.mechanism: Use explicit fixture constructors for partial, invalid and exact shapes instead of erasing all types with the same cast.
en.bad: Use as unknown as Request in every fixture.
en.good: Label body-only data as partial; label the numeric-id rejection case as intentionally invalid; use exact shape when completeness is what the test asserts.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The fixture communicates which constraint is deliberately relaxed.
en.boundaries: Specific helper API behavior needs version verification; this method concerns test intent, not production type safety.

zh.description: 区分不完整有效夹具与刻意非法输入。
zh.scenario: 测试请求校验和只读body的处理器。
zh.mechanism: 部分、非法和完整形状分别用明确构造器，不统一强制擦除类型。
zh.bad: 全部夹具用as unknown as Request。
zh.good: 只含body标部分；数字id拒绝例标刻意非法；完整性是断言目标时用完整形状。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 夹具说明刻意放宽的约束。
zh.boundaries: 具体助手API须核版本；方法关乎测试意图而非生产类型安全。

sources.section: Explicit partial and invalid fixture intent

name.en: Repair the missing premise before shortening
name.zh: 缩短前修补缺失前提

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Treat comprehension failure as a missing-context problem before optimizing word count.
en.scenario: Explain why a ticket must wait.
en.mechanism: Restate the decision in shared nouns and supply the premise the reader lacks, then trim redundancy.
en.bad: Blocked by dependency.
en.good: The exporter reads the new schema. That schema is not landed, so starting export now would build against the old format.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The reader can explain the dependency rather than receiving only a shorter label.
en.boundaries: Clarity is audience-dependent; ask which premise remains unclear.

zh.description: 先把理解失败视为背景缺失，再优化字数。
zh.scenario: 解释票据为何要等。
zh.mechanism: 用共享名词重述决定，补读者缺失前提，再删冗余。
zh.bad: 被依赖阻塞。
zh.good: 导出器读取新模式；模式未落地，现在开始会按旧格式构建。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 读者可解释依赖，不仅得到更短标签。
zh.boundaries: 清楚程度依赖读者，仍需确认哪项前提不明。

sources.section: Repair the missing premise before shortening

name.zh: 考虑后果的变更证据

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Review a change through observed behavior plus reversibility of its real-world consequences.
en.scenario: Describe a bulk-email rollout.
en.mechanism: Show before/after evidence, name one-way effects and identify affected callers or users.
en.bad: Tests green; rollback is one commit.
en.good: Show the dry-run before/after count; state emails cannot be unsent and list the recipient scope plus rollout guard.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The review distinguishes code rollback from irreversible external effects.
en.boundaries: An author risk classification is a claim for review, not independent proof.

zh.description: 以行为证据及现实后果可逆性评审变更。
zh.scenario: 描述批量邮件上线。
zh.mechanism: 展示前后证据，列不可逆影响及受影响调用者用户。
zh.bad: 测试通过；回滚一个提交即可。
zh.good: 展示演练前后数量；指出邮件不能撤回，并列收件范围及上线门槛。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 评审区分代码回滚与不可逆外部影响。
zh.boundaries: 作者的风险分类是待评审声明，不是独立证明。

name.zh: 捕获观察、凭据留本地

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Separate diagnostic signal from credentials before showing captured material.
en.scenario: Reproduce an authenticated export error.
en.mechanism: Use environment variables for secrets, redact outputs first and capture only observations in the human loop.
en.bad: Paste the full curl command, auth header and HAR into the brief.
en.good: Reference the token via environment variable; show redacted status and the signal-bearing error lines; let the human sign in without captured credentials.
en.why: The contrast changes the decision procedure and makes its result inspectable.
en.expected: The report retains the symptom while omitting the credential.
en.boundaries: Redaction can remove required signal; explicitly request safe additional evidence when needed.

zh.description: 展示捕获材料前分开诊断信号与凭据。
zh.scenario: 复现需认证的导出错误。
zh.mechanism: 秘密使用环境变量，先脱敏输出，人工环只捕获观察。
zh.bad: 把完整curl、认证头和HAR贴进简报。
zh.good: 环境变量引用令牌；仅展示脱敏状态和有效错误行；人自行登录，不捕获凭据。
zh.why: 对照明确改变决策过程，使结果可检查。
zh.expected: 报告保留症状而无凭据。
zh.boundaries: 脱敏可能移除必要信号，需要时明确请求安全补证。

name.zh: 声明推断设计简报

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Make the task interpretation visible before acting on a broad visual request.
en.scenario: Design a calm service landing page.
en.mechanism: Infer surface, audience, existing assets and constraints; state one design read and clarify only a materially diverging branch.
en.bad: Jump directly to a cinematic dark site.
en.good: Reading this as a service page for first-time applicants, using restrained hierarchy and the existing brand; use that interpretation for the build.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: The user can correct a concrete interpretation before it drives implementation.
en.boundaries: Inference is provisional; the one-question rule is a local interaction heuristic.

zh.description: 广泛视觉任务执行前公开解释。
zh.scenario: 设计平静的服务着陆页。
zh.mechanism: 推断表面、受众、资产和约束；声明设计理解，只澄清会明显分岔的条件。
zh.bad: 直接做电影感暗站。
zh.good: 理解为初次申请人的服务页，采用克制层级及现有品牌；据此构建。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 用户可在解释驱动实现前纠正。
zh.boundaries: 推断暂定；一次一问是局部交互启发式。

name.zh: 条件规则优先级

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Gate aesthetic defaults by the task context and preserve explicit brand or user constraints.
en.scenario: Modernize an existing purple-branded site.
en.mechanism: Declare default, triggering condition and override condition together; carry the selected interpretation through the whole artifact.
en.bad: Apply the no-purple aesthetic ban and replace the brand color.
en.good: Keep the supplied purple brand as the explicit override; apply restrained contrast and spacing rules around it.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: The output follows the actual brief rather than a universal recipe.
en.boundaries: Source numeric style dials and subjective bans are unvalidated editorial choices.

zh.description: 以任务背景门控美学默认，保留明确品牌与用户约束。
zh.scenario: 现代化已有紫色品牌站。
zh.mechanism: 默认、触发条件和覆盖条件同处声明，选择贯穿产物。
zh.bad: 套用禁紫规则并替换品牌色。
zh.good: 所给紫色品牌为明确覆盖；周边采用克制对比与间距。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 产物服从简报而非通用配方。
zh.boundaries: 数值风格旋钮与主观禁止为未验证编辑选择。

name.zh: 语义令牌交接契约

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Express design tokens as semantic names, exact values and functional roles.
en.scenario: Hand a palette to an implementation agent.
en.mechanism: Pair a human description with a machine-usable value and where it applies, then use the same vocabulary throughout the handoff.
en.bad: Use dark text and a nice blue.
en.good: Primary ink #18181B for body text; action blue #2563EB for primary buttons and focus indication; preserve these roles across screens.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: The receiver can distinguish identity, value and intended usage.
en.boundaries: Exact values require rendering/contrast checks; a token name alone does not validate usability.

zh.description: 设计令牌写语义名、精确值和功能角色。
zh.scenario: 向实现代理交接调色板。
zh.mechanism: 人类描述配机器可用值及适用处，交接中词汇一致。
zh.bad: 用暗文字和漂亮蓝。
zh.good: 正文主墨#18181B；主按钮与聚焦标识用行动蓝#2563EB；各屏保持角色。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 接收者可区分身份、值和用途。
zh.boundaries: 精确值仍须渲染对比检查，名字不验证可用性。

name.zh: 锁定不变量、变化构图

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Keep shared identity fixed while varying individual artifact purpose and composition.
en.scenario: Generate checkout, receipt and order-detail mockups.
en.mechanism: Write a common design bible before generating the set; distinguish invariant palette/type/navigation from allowed layout and emphasis changes.
en.bad: Choose a fresh palette and navigation for each screen.
en.good: Lock palette, type scale and bottom navigation; vary the checkout form, receipt summary and detail composition according to purpose.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: The set varies without becoming unrelated products.
en.boundaries: An internal bible is a plan; compare actual outputs before claiming consistency.

zh.description: 变化个别产物目的构图时固定共享身份。
zh.scenario: 生成结算、收据、订单详情模型。
zh.mechanism: 生成前写共同设计约定；区别固定颜色字级导航与允许布局重点变化。
zh.bad: 每屏换颜色与导航。
zh.good: 固定颜色、字级和底导航；按用途变化结算表单、收据摘要、详情构图。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 集合有变化但不是不同产品。
zh.boundaries: 内部约定是计划；须比实际产物才能宣称一致。

name.en: Successor screens require an action and carried state
name.zh: 后继屏幕须有动作与传递状态

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Validate a visual sequence as a causal user journey, not just a screen count.
en.scenario: Storyboard cart to payment confirmation.
en.mechanism: For each successor name the preceding action/navigation and the state carried into it.
en.bad: Show attractive cart, login and receipt screens in arbitrary order.
en.good: Map pay on the populated cart to checkout with the same items, then successful payment to a receipt with the same total.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: Every screen transition has a declared cause and state continuity.
en.boundaries: Static images illustrate the intended flow; they do not prove implemented behavior.

zh.description: 以因果旅程验证视觉序列，不只数屏。
zh.scenario: 分镜购物车到付款确认。
zh.mechanism: 每个后继说明前动作或导航及携带状态。
zh.bad: 随意排列漂亮购物车、登录、收据屏。
zh.good: 购物车付款动作进入相同商品结算，付款成功到相同总额收据。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 每次转场有明确原因和连续状态。
zh.boundaries: 静态图说明预期流程，不证明已实现行为。

sources.section: Successor screens require an action and carried state

name.en: Inspect the specimen before translating it
name.zh: 翻译前检查原型样本

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Extract an explicit visual contract before coding from a reference artifact.
en.scenario: Implement a supplied landing-page reference.
en.mechanism: Inspect readable text, relative typography, spacing, colors, components and uncertainties; implement against that extracted contract.
en.bad: Glance at the image and code a familiar card template.
en.good: Record the headline/CTA, two-column ratio, type hierarchy and unknown hover behavior, then build those observed relationships.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: The implementation can be checked against named observations instead of vague inspiration.
en.boundaries: A raster cannot establish hidden behavior or exact font identity; label inference and ask or refine uncertain detail.

zh.description: 从参考产物编码前抽取明确视觉契约。
zh.scenario: 实现给定着陆页参考。
zh.mechanism: 检查可读文字、相对字体、间距、颜色、组件及未知点；按抽取契约实现。
zh.bad: 看一眼图就写熟悉卡片模板。
zh.good: 记录标题CTA、两列比例、字级及未知悬停行为，再构建观察关系。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 可按命名观察检查实现，而非模糊灵感。
zh.boundaries: 栅格不证明隐藏行为或精确字体；标推断并澄清或细化。

sources.section: Inspect the specimen before translating it

name.en: Match reference granularity to inspection needs
name.zh: 按检查需求选择参考粒度

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Break dense references into units that preserve the details needed downstream.
en.scenario: Hand eight page sections to a coding agent.
en.mechanism: Count requested units, give each a readable artifact, and add detail views only where inspection is uncertain.
en.bad: Compress all sections into a tiny collage.
en.good: Provide one readable section view per section, plus a labelled button-detail view where the original is unclear.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: Downstream work can inspect text and spacing without guessing from tiny pixels.
en.boundaries: Fresh generation may change details; the source blanket no-crop preference is not a universal guarantee.

zh.description: 将密集参考拆成可保留下游所需细节的单元。
zh.scenario: 向编码代理交接八个页面章节。
zh.mechanism: 清点所需单元，各有可读产物，不明确处才加细节视图。
zh.bad: 全部压成小拼贴。
zh.good: 每章节一个可读视图，按钮原图不清时加有标记细节视图。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 下游可看文字间距，不须猜小像素。
zh.boundaries: 重新生成可能改细节；源的全面禁裁剪偏好非普遍保证。

sources.section: Match reference granularity to inspection needs

name.zh: 清晰断点续接游标

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Preserve output quality at a generation boundary using an explicit progress count and next unit.
en.scenario: Deliver twelve independent reference sections.
en.mechanism: Stop at a complete structural unit, state completed/total and exact resume point, then resume without repeating prior units.
en.bad: Shrink the final six into a vague summary to fit.
en.good: Finish section six intact; report 6/12 complete, next section seven; resume from seven when continuation is available.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: Missing work remains explicit and subsequent output starts at the right unit.
en.boundaries: This is output continuity, not permission to mark the whole task done or pause autonomously where continuation is available.

zh.description: 生成边界以进度计数及下一单元保留质量。
zh.scenario: 交付十二个独立参考章节。
zh.mechanism: 完整结构单元处停，说明完成/总数及准确续点，随后不重复已完单元。
zh.bad: 为塞进长度把后六节压成模糊摘要。
zh.good: 完整完成第六节，报6/12和下一第七节；可继续时从七续。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 缺失工作明确，后续从正确单元开始。
zh.boundaries: 这是输出续接，不是可用续轮时自主暂停或称整任务完成。

name.en: Separate simulated from observed tool results
name.zh: 分清模拟与观察工具结果

candidates.reason: Observed source flaw enriches the existing provenance mechanism; fake execution is rejected, not adopted.

en.description: Keep tool provenance explicit when using generated or deterministic selections.
en.scenario: Choose a layout using a seeded selection.
en.mechanism: State whether computation ran, was simulated or is only a proposed procedure; never label a mock output executed evidence.
en.bad: Print mock Python output and call it true random execution.
en.good: Either run the seeded selector and record its actual seed/result, or label the choice as a hand-selected proposal with no execution claim.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: The reader can distinguish computation evidence from illustrative text.
en.boundaries: The observed source requests simulated RNG; this candidate is a corrective editorial contrast, not proof that the source enforces it.

zh.description: 使用生成或确定选择时明确工具来源。
zh.scenario: 以种子选择布局。
zh.mechanism: 说明计算已运行、模拟或仅拟议，不把假输出标执行证据。
zh.bad: 打印假Python输出并称真正随机执行。
zh.good: 实际运行并记种子结果，或标为人工选择提案且不声称运行。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 读者可分计算证据与示意文字。
zh.boundaries: 源要求模拟随机；此是纠错教学对照，不证明源已实施。

sources.section: Separate simulated from observed tool results
Static instruction markers are not engagement receipts

name.zh: 标注实现近似来源

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Distinguish an official implementation from an inspired approximation.
en.scenario: Build a web surface inspired by a native material.
en.mechanism: Use authoritative packages when required; otherwise label the visual inspiration and approximation without claiming official API status.
en.bad: Call custom CSS the official native material package.
en.good: Describe the effect as a web approximation inspired by the native material and cite the platform documentation separately from the implementation.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: The receiver knows what is official evidence and what the project constructed.
en.boundaries: The source particular platform/package claims are frozen observations; verify them before relying on present API availability.

zh.description: 区分官方实现与灵感近似。
zh.scenario: 构建受原生材料启发的网页。
zh.mechanism: 要求官方实现时用权威包，否则标明灵感和近似，不声称官方接口。
zh.bad: 自写CSS称官方原生材料包。
zh.good: 描述为受原生材料启发的网页近似，平台文档与自写实现分别引用。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 接收者知道哪些官方证据，哪些项目构造。
zh.boundaries: 源中平台包具体声明是冻结观察，依赖当前可用性前须核查。

name.zh: 貌似精确样例内容的来源

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Require a source or visible mock status for factual-looking metrics and specifications.
en.scenario: Mock up an analytics homepage.
en.mechanism: Inspect every displayed number; retain sourced values, label samples and remove invented precision presented as fact.
en.bad: Invent 47.2% growth to make it look real.
en.good: Use the provided growth figure, or display Sample data beside 47.2%; keep unsupported performance claims out of the published copy.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: Realism does not silently convert invented content into evidence.
en.boundaries: Comments alone may not be visible to the audience; choose disclosure appropriate to the artifact.

zh.description: 貌似事实的指标规格要求来源或可见样例标记。
zh.scenario: 模拟分析首页。
zh.mechanism: 检查每个数字，有源保留，样例标注，去除以事实呈现的虚构精度。
zh.bad: 编47.2%增长让它逼真。
zh.good: 使用提供的增长数，或在47.2%旁显示样例数据；公开文案不含无依据表现声明。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 逼真感不暗中把虚构转成证据。
zh.boundaries: 注释可能不可见；按受众选择产物披露方式。

name.zh: 审计并保留改版契约

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Classify redesign intent and inventory nonvisual contracts before changing presentation.
en.scenario: Modernize a working checkout page.
en.mechanism: Detect preserve versus overhaul, record brand/content/routes/tracking/accessibility, then apply focused visual changes within that contract.
en.bad: Replace the layout, field names and route slugs while restyling.
en.good: Audit checkout routes, event names, field identity and focus behavior; restyle spacing and typography while preserving those contracts.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: Visual changes can be reviewed separately from accidental behavior/identity drift.
en.boundaries: Explicitly authorized structural changes require their own migration and verification, not blanket preservation.

zh.description: 改视觉前分类改版意图并清点非视觉契约。
zh.scenario: 现代化可用结算页。
zh.mechanism: 区别保留与大改，记录品牌内容路由跟踪可访问，再在契约内做聚焦视觉变化。
zh.bad: 重设样式时替换布局字段名与路由。
zh.good: 审计结算路由、事件名、字段身份、聚焦行为；调整间距字体并保留契约。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 可分别评审视觉改动与意外行为身份漂移。
zh.boundaries: 明确授权结构变化需要自身迁移验证，而非一概保留。

name.zh: 添加效果前的行为动机门

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Add an effect only after naming its communicative job.
en.scenario: Add motion to a saved-item interaction.
en.mechanism: Require a reason tied to hierarchy, narrative, feedback or state change; omit effects with only decorative rationale.
en.bad: Animate every component because an animation library is available.
en.good: Animate the saved-item state transition so its new position is clear; keep the informational heading still.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: Each selected effect has a reviewable purpose.
en.boundaries: A stated purpose does not prove the effect works; render it and inspect reduced-motion behavior.

zh.description: 添加效果前说明传播作用。
zh.scenario: 给保存条目交互加动画。
zh.mechanism: 理由关联层级、叙事、反馈或状态变化，纯装饰理由则省略。
zh.bad: 有动画库所以全部组件动。
zh.good: 动画表现保存后新位置；信息标题静止。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 每个选中效果有可评审用途。
zh.boundaries: 说明用途不证明有效；渲染并检查减弱动作状态。

name.en: Distinguish artifact capability from implementation intent
name.zh: 区分产物能力与实现意图

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Mark behavior descriptions as future implementation intent when the produced artifact cannot execute them.
en.scenario: Hand a static dashboard mockup to a developer.
en.mechanism: Separate what a static artifact shows from the motion/interaction contract a later coding phase must implement and verify.
en.bad: Claim the exported image has working animated status updates.
en.good: Label status pulse as code-phase intent; state the current deliverable is static and hand off the required behavior separately.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: The artifact does not inherit capabilities from its prose description.
en.boundaries: Actual host capability must be verified in the target environment; this is a contract distinction.

zh.description: 产物不能执行的行为描述标为后续实现意图。
zh.scenario: 向开发者交接静态仪表板模型。
zh.mechanism: 区分静态产物所示与后续编码须实现验证的动作交互契约。
zh.bad: 称导出图片有可工作的动态状态更新。
zh.good: 状态脉冲标代码阶段意图；当前交付静态，单独交接所需行为。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 产物不从文字描述继承能力。
zh.boundaries: 目标环境须核真实宿主能力；此仅契约区分。

sources.section: Distinguish artifact capability from implementation intent

name.zh: 无依据懒惰效能解释

candidates.reason: Quantitative causal efficacy claims lack directly locatable primary citations and reproducible evaluation details; not admitted.

en.description: The source presents quantitative prompting and seasonal claims without directly locatable primary study evidence.
en.scenario: Describe whether a tipping phrase improves task completion.
en.mechanism: Require identified primary experiments, population, intervention, metric and comparison before admitting an efficacy claim.
en.bad: Repeat a 45% improvement and seasonal causal story as established.
en.good: State that this corpus asserts those effects but does not supply an auditable primary experiment; withhold efficacy language.
en.why: The stated contract changes what the agent selects, preserves or verifies, and makes the difference inspectable.
en.expected: The claim is rejected pending support rather than laundering a percentage through a skills repo.
en.boundaries: This audit does not establish the opposite causal claim either.

zh.description: 源无可定位原始研究证据却给出数值提示和季节声明。
zh.scenario: 解释给小费措辞是否改善任务完成。
zh.mechanism: 有效性声明需明确原始实验、群体、干预、指标与对照。
zh.bad: 把45%改善及季节因果当确定事实复述。
zh.good: 说明该库声称效果但未供可审原始实验，暂不采用效能措辞。
zh.why: 明确契约改变代理选择、保留或验证的内容，使差别可检查。
zh.expected: 不给技能库百分数包装成证据，待支持前拒绝。
zh.boundaries: 此审计也不证明相反因果。

name.zh: 有归属的负路由对照

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: A negative routing example must route to its intended owner, not merely avoid one wrong skill.
en.scenario: Test review-versus-test routing.
en.mechanism: Name the correct neighboring skill and require it to outrank the rejected candidate with nonzero match.
en.bad: Pass write a regression test because the review skill scores zero, even though every skill scores zero.
en.good: Require test-driven-development to outrank code-review on write a regression test; fail the case if neither matches.
en.why: The comparison measures the intended behavioral distinction and prevents a structurally plausible but irrelevant pass.
en.expected: Negative precision cannot pass through an unmatched prompt.
en.boundaries: This runner is a lexical approximation; actual host routing needs separate behavioral runs.

zh.description: 负路由例须转到正确归属，不只避开一个错技能。
zh.scenario: 测试评审与测试的路由。
zh.mechanism: 命名正确相邻技能，并要求非零匹配且排序高于被拒候选。
zh.bad: 写回归测试在评审得零分即通过，虽然全部技能零分。
zh.good: 要求测试技能在写回归测试上高于评审；两者均不匹配则失败。
zh.why: 对照测量目标行为区别，避免结构合理但无关的通过。
zh.expected: 负精度不靠无匹配提示空过。
zh.boundaries: 此运行器仅词汇近似，实际宿主路由须另做行为运行。

name.zh: 按声明的产物类型评分

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Choose the grading evidence according to whether the promised artifact is execution or conversation.
en.scenario: Evaluate a bug-fix skill and a requirements interview.
en.mechanism: Execution cases require real fixture work and tool traces; dialogue cases grade conversational turns only when that is the actual deliverable.
en.bad: Grade both from the assistant final claim that it followed the process.
en.good: For the fix inspect failing-test/edit/run events; for the interview inspect its questions and wait behavior, without inventing a code-edit requirement.
en.why: The comparison measures the intended behavioral distinction and prevents a structurally plausible but irrelevant pass.
en.expected: A narrated implementation is distinguishable from performed work.
en.boundaries: Artifact-kind exemptions must be reviewed; source dialogue cases that expect file installation can blur this distinction.

zh.description: 按承诺产物是执行还是对话选择证据。
zh.scenario: 评估修错技能与需求访谈。
zh.mechanism: 执行例需真实夹具与工具轨迹；仅真正对话交付才按轮次评分。
zh.bad: 两者都只看代理最终称遵守流程。
zh.good: 修错检查失败测试、编辑、运行事件；访谈看提问等待，不虚加代码编辑要求。
zh.why: 对照测量目标行为区别，避免结构合理但无关的通过。
zh.expected: 可区分叙述实施与实际工作。
zh.boundaries: 类型豁免须复核；源中对话例若期望文件安装会模糊区别。

name.en: Bind grader results to the full expectation set
name.zh: 评分结果绑定完整期望集

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Validate grade identities and reconstruct totals from the declared expectation set.
en.scenario: Grade five bug-fix expectations.
en.mechanism: Require one unique result per canonical expectation ID, retain canonical text and derive counts; reject missing/duplicate IDs or inconsistent integer summaries.
en.bad: Accept a fluent report with four results and a summary claiming five passed.
en.good: Require IDs1–5 exactly once; compute passed/failed from their booleans; reject a missing result before reporting success.
en.why: The comparison measures the intended behavioral distinction and prevents a structurally plausible but irrelevant pass.
en.expected: Coverage and arithmetic cannot be invented by the grader summary.
en.boundaries: Identity/schema checks do not establish the truth of the grader evidence or semantic judgment.

zh.description: 验证评分身份，按声明期望集重建总数。
zh.scenario: 给五项修错期望评分。
zh.mechanism: 每规范ID一个唯一结果，保留规范文字并派生计数，拒缺失重复ID或冲突整数摘要。
zh.bad: 接收四项流畅结果及称五项通过的摘要。
zh.good: 要求1至5各一次，按布尔结果算通过失败；报成功前拒缺项。
zh.why: 对照测量目标行为区别，避免结构合理但无关的通过。
zh.expected: 评分摘要不能编覆盖与算术。
zh.boundaries: 身份模式检查不证明证据或语义判断真实。

sources.section: Bind grader results to the full expectation set

name.en: Separate activation indicators from outcome scores
name.zh: 分开激活指示与结果评分

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: A skill firing is an activation observation, not itself proof of useful behavior.
en.scenario: Evaluate a review skill on a planted boundary bug.
en.mechanism: Keep invocation indicator separate from substantive outcome graders and compare equivalent with/without-skill runs under pinned conditions.
en.bad: Give success credit only because Skill was invoked.
en.good: Record invocation separately; score whether the boundary bug was found in both skill and baseline arms using the same case and rubric.
en.why: The comparison measures the intended behavioral distinction and prevents a structurally plausible but irrelevant pass.
en.expected: The measured difference concerns the delivered review rather than merely loading a skill.
en.boundaries: Source reported run counts are attributed observations, not established efficacy; model/CLI/version changes confound comparison.

zh.description: 技能触发是激活观察，本身不证明有用行为。
zh.scenario: 用植入边界缺陷评估评审技能。
zh.mechanism: 调用指示与实质结果评分分开，固定条件比较有无技能的等价运行。
zh.bad: 只因调用Skill即给成功分。
zh.good: 调用单记，技能与基准两臂同用案例量规，评分是否发现边界缺陷。
zh.why: 对照测量目标行为区别，避免结构合理但无关的通过。
zh.expected: 测差关乎交付评审，不仅载入技能。
zh.boundaries: 源运行次数是归属观察非确定效能；模型CLI版本变化干扰比较。
