name.zh: 有序协调评审发现

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Treat reviewer output as hypotheses and classify against the actual artifact before acting.
en.scenario: Review a cache that intentionally returns stale data under a stated tolerance.
en.mechanism: Check contract misread first, then actionable defect, accepted tradeoff and context-caused noise; fix the contract before repeating review when it caused the error.
en.bad: Fix every reviewer complaint or dismiss all disagreement as noise.
en.good: Re-read each finding: clarify the missing tolerance first; fix a real unbounded-staleness path; record an accepted latency tradeoff separately.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: The artifact changes only for validated actionable findings, with contract failures distinguished.
en.boundaries: Classification is an editorial judgment; a reviewer disagreement alone proves neither author nor reviewer correct.

zh.description: 将评审输出视为假设，行动前按实际产物分类。
zh.scenario: 评审明确容忍一定陈旧的数据缓存。
zh.mechanism: 先查契约误读，再查可行动缺陷、接受权衡、背景噪声；契约致误则先修契约再评审。
zh.bad: 每条意见都修，或全当噪声。
zh.good: 逐条复读：先补缺失容忍；修真正无界陈旧路径；单独记可接受延迟权衡。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 只为已验证可行动发现改产物，区分契约缺陷。
zh.boundaries: 分类是编辑判断；分歧本身不证明作者或评审者正确。

name.zh: 资源新鲜度与解读相关性

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: A fresh resource validator does not make a previously transformed answer relevant to a different question.
en.scenario: Reuse documentation first read for an API signature while researching its error semantics.
en.mechanism: Record both source version and transformation question; reuse a derived reading only when it covers the new task, otherwise refetch or rederive from raw content.
en.bad: Origin says 304, so the old signature-only summary answers the error question.
en.good: Check the original extraction prompt; if it only requested signatures, fetch the missing error section or rederive from the unchanged raw page.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: Unchanged source content is not mistaken for complete coverage of the new question.
en.boundaries: The observed hook is URL-only and leaves relevance judgment to the agent; it does not enforce this invariant automatically.

zh.description: 源验证器确认新鲜，不使旧变换答案适合另一问题。
zh.scenario: 错误语义研究复用之前只读接口签名的文档。
zh.mechanism: 同时记录来源版本与变换问题；派生解读覆盖新任务才复用，否则重取或按原文重新解读。
zh.bad: 来源304，所以旧签名摘要能答错误问题。
zh.good: 检查原提取提示；只问签名则取缺失错误章节，或按未变原页面重推。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 不把来源未变误作新问题已完整覆盖。
zh.boundaries: 观察到的钩子只以URL为键，把相关性留给代理判断，并不自动强制不变量。

name.en: Bind a derived artifact to its actual input revision
name.zh: 将派生产物绑定实际输入修订

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Validate derivation order so a later source revision cannot be attached to an earlier derived body.
en.scenario: Cache a model extraction of a changing documentation page.
en.mechanism: Capture content and its validator from the same fetch, or re-fetch when a later validation may refer to another revision.
en.bad: Extract revision A, then issue HEAD after revision B appears and tag the A summary with B ETag.
en.good: Store the response validator that accompanied A; if only a later HEAD is available, verify the body again before binding that validator.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: A later 304 cannot falsely certify an older derived summary.
en.boundaries: This is a static source-race inference; the audit did not execute or reproduce it against a live server.

zh.description: 核对派生顺序，避免将后来的来源版本贴到早期派生正文。
zh.scenario: 缓存变化文档页的模型摘要。
zh.mechanism: 同次获取正文与验证器；后验证可能属别版本时重取。
zh.bad: 提取A后页面变B，再HEAD并用B的ETag标A摘要。
zh.good: 存伴随A响应的验证器；仅有后HEAD时，绑定前重新核正文。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 后来的304不误认证更旧摘要。
zh.boundaries: 这是静态来源竞争推断，本审计未运行或向服务复现。

sources.section: Bind a derived artifact to its actual input revision

name.en: Pass review artifacts through inert input channels
name.zh: 通过惰性输入通道传评审产物

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Preserve artifact text as data when invoking an external reviewer.
en.scenario: Review code containing backticks and command-substitution syntax.
en.mechanism: Write the full artifact/contract prompt to a file and feed stdin; verify the tool and use a read-only execution boundary.
en.bad: Interpolate the source directly into a shell command argument.
en.good: Write the exact prompt to a file, pass the file on stdin to the verified read-only reviewer, and retain the invocation/result provenance.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: Shell metacharacters in the artifact do not become shell instructions.
en.boundaries: A read-only wrapper limits filesystem effects, not all prompt-injection or external-data risk; host flags must be verified.

zh.description: 调用外部评审时保持产物文本为数据。
zh.scenario: 评审含反引号与命令替换语法的代码。
zh.mechanism: 完整产物契约提示写文件，经标准输入传递；验证工具并用只读边界。
zh.bad: 源内容直接插入shell命令参数。
zh.good: 确切提示写文件，标准输入传给已验证只读评审，保留调用结果来源。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 产物元字符不成为shell指令。
zh.boundaries: 只读包装限制文件影响，非所有提示注入和外部数据风险；宿主标志须核。

sources.section: Pass review artifacts through inert input channels

name.zh: 按反馈成本安排检查

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Keep fast feedback near edits and place expensive checks at explicit later gates.
en.scenario: Verify a frontend change with types, browser accessibility and mutation checks.
en.mechanism: Name each check target, lifecycle phase and cost budget; reuse existing evidence rather than running the same unchanged suite twice.
en.bad: Run every full-repository check after every keystroke.
en.good: Run affected types/lint after edits, related tests at task end and costly browser/mutation checks at preview or CI, each with its declared result.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: Fast iteration retains an inspectable final quality gate.
en.boundaries: Cost estimates and source tool commands need local measurement/version verification; moving a check must not silently remove it.

zh.description: 快速反馈近编辑，昂贵检查在明确后门。
zh.scenario: 以类型、浏览器可访问和突变检查验证界面变化。
zh.mechanism: 为每检查命名目标、阶段和成本，复用已有证据，不重复跑未变整套。
zh.bad: 每敲字都运行所有整库检查。
zh.good: 编辑后跑受影响类型lint，任务末跑相关测试，浏览器突变检查在预览或CI，均明确结果。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 快速迭代仍有可审最终质量门。
zh.boundaries: 成本命令须本地测量核版本；后移检查不可暗删。

name.en: Review changes to the quality bar itself
name.zh: 评审质量门槛自身变化

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Review the validator as well as the implementation so green cannot be bought by weakening the contract.
en.scenario: Fix a failing coverage gate.
en.mechanism: Compare baseline thresholds, skipped/deleted tests, removed assertions, suppressions, stubs and new exceptions; require explained scoped exceptions.
en.bad: Lower the required coverage and skip a failing test, then report green.
en.good: Compare the gate against the branch baseline; keep its threshold, fix the uncovered behavior or record an owned expiring exception for review.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: A successful verdict retains the originally accepted bar.
en.boundaries: A shallow diff guard can false-flag legitimate rewrites and miss semantic weakening; findings require review.

zh.description: 评审验证器与实现，防止削弱契约换绿。
zh.scenario: 修复失败覆盖门。
zh.mechanism: 比较基准阈值、跳过删除测试、移除断言、抑制、桩和新例外，例外须解释且限定。
zh.bad: 降低覆盖要求并跳过失败测试，再报绿。
zh.good: 对照分支基准，保持阈值，修未覆行为或提交有负责人到期的例外待评审。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 成功结论保留原接受门槛。
zh.boundaries: 浅层diff护栏可误报合法改写，漏语义削弱；须复核发现。

sources.section: Review changes to the quality bar itself

name.zh: 测量基准棘轮

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Adopt a measured nonregression direction when an arbitrary target would fail the inherited baseline.
en.scenario: Set a quality gate on a legacy project.
en.mechanism: Record metric value, measurement conditions, allowed direction and tolerance; compare equivalent runs and update improved baselines.
en.bad: Demand an invented80% threshold the inherited project cannot pass.
en.good: Measure the current changed-line coverage, record the baseline/command and require no comparable regression; define separate improvement work.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: The gate detects deterioration without pretending the inherited state is already ideal.
en.boundaries: Changing denominator/workload can invalidate comparison; a ratchet is not proof of sufficient absolute quality.

zh.description: 任意目标使继承基准必败时采用实测不退步方向。
zh.scenario: 为遗留项目设质量门。
zh.mechanism: 记录值、条件、允许方向及容差，比较等价运行，改善时更新基准。
zh.bad: 强设继承项目无法达的80%。
zh.good: 测当前覆盖，记录基准与命令，要求可比条件下不退步；改善另立工作。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 门能检退化而不假装继承状态已理想。
zh.boundaries: 分母或负载变化使比较失效；棘轮不证明绝对质量足够。

name.en: Distinguish check violation from inability to run
name.zh: 区分检查违规与无法运行

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Keep clean, violation and unavailable-check outcomes distinct.
en.scenario: Run a diff guard in a shallow checkout without its base ref.
en.mechanism: Return separate statuses and forbid inability-to-run from being reported as a clean result.
en.bad: Map every nonfatal guard exit to passed.
en.good: Report unable to run because merge base is missing; restore the baseline or leave the gate unresolved, separate from a detected violation.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: No unchecked change is certified by a missing-check path.
en.boundaries: Exit conventions are local contracts; the invoking wrapper must preserve their meanings.

zh.description: 分清干净、违规和检查不可用。
zh.scenario: 浅克隆缺基准引用时跑差异护栏。
zh.mechanism: 返回不同状态，禁止无法运行被报干净。
zh.bad: 所有非致命退出都映成通过。
zh.good: 报缺合并基准无法运行；补基准或保留门未解决，与发现违规分开。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 检查缺失不认证未检变更。
zh.boundaries: 退出约定属局部契约，调用包装须保留语义。

sources.section: Distinguish check violation from inability to run
Static instruction markers are not engagement receipts

name.en: Reuse verification until its assumptions change
name.zh: 假设变更前复用验证

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Repeat a successful check only when relevant code or baseline assumptions have changed.
en.scenario: Finish a tested parser change while editing its README.
en.mechanism: Record command, artifact revision and scope; invalidate evidence on an edit affecting that check, not on nervousness alone.
en.bad: Re-run the identical full build repeatedly on unchanged code.
en.good: Retain the parser test result for its unchanged revision; run documentation checks for the README edit; rerun parser tests only if parser input or code changes.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: Verification effort follows an explicit evidence invalidation rule.
en.boundaries: External dependencies, nondeterminism or changed fixtures may invalidate results even without source edits.

zh.description: 仅相关代码或基准假设变更时重复成功检查。
zh.scenario: 已测解析器变化完成时改README。
zh.mechanism: 记录命令、产物修订和范围；影响检查的编辑使证据失效，而非仅因不安。
zh.bad: 不变代码反复跑相同整构建。
zh.good: 保留不变解析器修订的测试结果；文档改动跑文档检查；代码或输入变后才再测解析器。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 验证成本遵循明确证据失效规则。
zh.boundaries: 外部依赖、不确定性或夹具变更可在无源编辑时使结果失效。

sources.section: Reuse verification until its assumptions change

name.zh: 考虑噪声的干预比较

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Compare one change under equivalent measurement conditions and require signal beyond normal variance.
en.scenario: Evaluate a parser optimization.
en.mechanism: Keep command, workload and budget constant; repeat measurements, preserve correctness gates and decide against the observed noise range.
en.bad: Compare a cold baseline once with a warm optimized run and call a small delta a win.
en.good: Run both revisions on the same workload and cache conditions; compare repeated timings and retain the change only if the effect exceeds normal variation while correctness holds.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: The measured effect is attributable to the tested intervention.
en.boundaries: Variance estimates depend on sample quality; changes with intentional nonperformance benefits need a separate benefit contract.

zh.description: 在等价测量条件比较单个变化，并要求超过正常波动。
zh.scenario: 评估解析器优化。
zh.mechanism: 固定命令负载预算，重复测量，保留正确性门，再按噪声范围决定。
zh.bad: 一次冷基准对一次暖优化，小差就称赢。
zh.good: 相同负载缓存条件测两修订，比较重复计时，仅差异超过正常波动且正确性保持才留。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 测量效果可归因于所试干预。
zh.boundaries: 方差估计依赖样本质量；另有明确非性能收益的变化需要另立收益契约。

name.zh: 保留被拒实验依据

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Preserve attempted ideas and their rejection evidence even when the implementation is reverted.
en.scenario: Optimize a slow list rendering path.
en.mechanism: Record idea, baseline/result, verdict and reason; consult that ledger before retrying the same proposal.
en.bad: Delete the reverted memoization attempt and propose it again next session.
en.good: Record memoization unchanged within noise, with workload and result; test virtualization next and link its accepted evidence.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: A later agent can distinguish unexplored ideas from already rejected ones.
en.boundaries: New workloads or code may justify repeating an old idea; qualify the recorded context rather than treating rejection as permanent truth.

zh.description: 实现被撤回时仍保留尝试与拒绝依据。
zh.scenario: 优化慢列表渲染。
zh.mechanism: 记录想法、基准结果、结论理由，下次相同提案先查台账。
zh.bad: 删除无效memo尝试，下轮再提。
zh.good: 记memo在噪声内无变化及负载结果；再测虚拟列表并链接接受证据。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 后代理可区分未探索与已拒想法。
zh.boundaries: 新负载代码可使旧想法值得重试；限定记录背景，不把拒绝视永久真理。

name.zh: 缓存键包含改变响应的输入

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Derive a cache key from every input that affects the visible response.
en.scenario: Cache a localized per-tenant report.
en.mechanism: Inventory tenant, viewer permissions, locale and feature state; state staleness/invalidation explicitly and reject reuse across unmatched response contexts.
en.bad: Key only by the report URL and serve the first cached user result to everyone.
en.good: Key by report version, tenant, locale and authorization context; require a stated freshness policy before reusing a response.
en.why: The contract names which evidence may be reused and which decision remains unresolved, so the result can be checked.
en.expected: A speed improvement does not erase response identity or confidentiality boundaries.
en.boundaries: A complete key can be expensive or unstable; verify the actual dependency set and avoid caching freshness-critical data.

zh.description: 以所有影响可见响应的输入导出缓存键。
zh.scenario: 缓存每租户本地化报告。
zh.mechanism: 清点租户、查看者权限、地区及功能状态，明确陈旧失效策略，不跨不匹配背景复用。
zh.bad: 仅用URL，把首用户缓存给所有人。
zh.good: 报告版本租户地区授权背景为键，明确新鲜策略后才复用。
zh.why: 契约明确哪些证据可复用、哪些决定仍未解决，从而可检查结果。
zh.expected: 性能改善不抹去响应身份与保密边界。
zh.boundaries: 完整键可能昂贵易变；须核实际依赖集，不缓存必须即时新鲜数据。

name.zh: 意图稳定的重试身份

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Identify one intended action independently from its delivery attempts.
en.scenario: Retry an asset-upload job after a timeout.
en.mechanism: Generate an identity once at the initiating intent and reuse it across retries; distinct intents get distinct identities.
en.bad: Create a new UUID on every retry.
en.good: Assign the upload intent its key once, retain that key in the task ledger and reuse it on all attempts; a new upload receives a new key.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Retries can be recognized without collapsing distinct actions.
en.boundaries: The receiver must honor the identity; a header alone does not make side effects idempotent.

zh.description: 将一次预期动作的身份与送达尝试分离。
zh.scenario: 资产上传超时后重试。
zh.mechanism: 在意图发起处生成一次身份并重试复用，不同意图不同身份。
zh.bad: 每次重试生成新UUID。
zh.good: 上传意图只赋一次键，保留在台账并每次复用；新上传用新键。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 可识别重试而不合并不同动作。
zh.boundaries: 接收方须落实身份，只有请求头不能使副作用幂等。

name.zh: 原子认领与载荷绑定

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Claim an action in one operation and bind its identity to the original payload.
en.scenario: Two workers receive the same publish request.
en.mechanism: Use an atomic uniqueness gate before execution; reject a reused key whose canonical payload differs, and define in-flight duplicate behavior.
en.bad: Both check not seen, publish, then record the key.
en.good: One unique claim wins before publishing; the duplicate waits or returns pending; a changed article under the same key is rejected.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Concurrent delivery does not bypass the same-intent guard.
en.boundaries: An atomic local claim cannot prove an external effect completed; crash recovery still needs the unknown-outcome protocol.

zh.description: 以单操作认领动作，并将身份绑定原载荷。
zh.scenario: 两工作者收到同一发布请求。
zh.mechanism: 执行前原子唯一门控；同键规范载荷不同则拒绝，明确运行中重复行为。
zh.bad: 都先查未见，再发布后记键。
zh.good: 发布前唯一认领一方获胜；重复等待或返回处理中；同键不同文章拒绝。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 并发送达不绕过同意图门。
zh.boundaries: 本地原子认领不证明外部效果完成，崩溃仍需未知结果恢复。

name.zh: 保留未知副作用结果

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: A timeout is an unknown effect outcome, not evidence that the action failed.
en.scenario: A remote issue-creation call times out.
en.mechanism: Record intent before the external call, preserve pending/unknown state and reconcile the effect before blindly repeating it; retain identity through the longest redelivery path.
en.bad: Treat timeout as failure and create the issue again with a new key.
en.good: Keep the recorded request as unknown, check the remote request/result identity, and only retry through the same guarded intent after reconciliation.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: An uncertain acknowledgment does not silently duplicate an external action.
en.boundaries: Recovery depends on destination lookup/idempotency support; report unresolved uncertainty when it cannot be reconciled.

zh.description: 超时是效果未知，不是动作失败的证据。
zh.scenario: 远端建问题调用超时。
zh.mechanism: 外部调用前记意图，保留待定未知，盲重做前协调效果；身份覆盖最长重投路径。
zh.bad: 当失败处理，用新键再建问题。
zh.good: 已记请求留未知，查远端请求结果身份，协调后仅经同一门控意图重试。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 不确定确认不暗中复制外部动作。
zh.boundaries: 恢复依赖目的地查询或幂等支持，无法协调须报告未定。

name.zh: 问题到信号的可观测性

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Choose instrumentation from the questions an operator must answer.
en.scenario: Instrument a background import workflow.
en.mechanism: Name diagnostic questions first, then map each to an event, aggregate or path trace; omit signals with no declared use.
en.bad: Dump every payload and add counters without a question.
en.good: Ask which imports fail, where time is spent and whether retries duplicate work; emit bounded status events, duration metrics and linked run traces.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Each signal has a concrete decision or investigation it supports.
en.boundaries: The source logs/metrics/traces mnemonic is a heuristic; verify that actual data answers the question.

zh.description: 按操作人必须回答的问题选择仪表。
zh.scenario: 给后台导入流程加观测。
zh.mechanism: 先命名诊断问题，再映事件、聚合或路径轨迹，无用途信号省略。
zh.bad: 倾倒所有载荷，随意加计数。
zh.good: 问哪些失败、耗时在哪、重试是否重复；输出有界状态事件、时长指标和关联轨迹。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 每信号支持具体决策或调查。
zh.boundaries: 日志指标轨迹口诀是启发式，须验证真实数据能答问题。

name.zh: 验证证据通道自身

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Check the telemetry path by generating a known signal and finding it through the intended channel.
en.scenario: Add monitoring for an import failure.
en.mechanism: Use an authorized isolated test to induce an error/event, trace its identifier and verify structured fields, labels, propagation and alert delivery.
en.bad: Declare monitoring ready because the logging code exists.
en.good: Induce one test import failure, find its run ID in the aggregator, follow its trace and verify the test alert points to the right runbook.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Instrumentation availability is distinguished from a working evidence path.
en.boundaries: Induced failures and notifications must stay within authorized test scope; this audit did not fire any alerts.

zh.description: 生成已知信号并从预期通道找回，以核对遥测路径。
zh.scenario: 添加导入失败监控。
zh.mechanism: 在已授权隔离测试诱发错误事件，追身份并核结构字段标签传播与报警送达。
zh.bad: 有日志代码就称监控就绪。
zh.good: 诱发一次测试失败，在聚合器找运行ID、追轨迹，并核测试报警指向正确手册。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 区分仪表存在与证据路径工作。
zh.boundaries: 诱错与通知须限授权测试，本审计未触发任何报警。

name.zh: 保留测量来源类型

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Separate static potential-impact findings from lab, field and trace measurements.
en.scenario: Audit a web page from source and a Lighthouse report.
en.mechanism: Select mode from available artifacts, label every populated value with its source kind, and leave unmeasured fields explicitly unmeasured.
en.bad: Invent a real-user p75 from a static scan or relabel the lab result as field data.
en.good: Mark static findings potential impact; show the report value as Lab with its conditions, and keep Field p75 not measured.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Numbers retain the meaning and limitations of their source.
en.boundaries: A source label does not validate the artifact or make different populations/runs comparable. A static or heuristic scanner result is separate from observed live-browser behavior; label the method actually used.

zh.description: 区分静态潜在影响与实验室、真实用户、轨迹测量。
zh.scenario: 凭源码和Lighthouse报告审网页。
zh.mechanism: 按可用产物选模式，各值标来源类型，未测字段明确未测。
zh.bad: 静态扫描编真实用户p75，或把实验室结果改称用户数据。
zh.good: 静态发现标潜在影响，报告值标实验室及条件，用户p75留未测。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 数字保留来源含义边界。
zh.boundaries: 来源标签不验证产物，也不使不同群体运行可比。 静态或启发式扫描结果应与实际浏览器观察分开，标明实际使用的方法。

name.en: Separate workflow, perspective and entry point
name.zh: 分离流程、视角与入口

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Keep domain work in leaf roles and orchestration at the entry point that owns the decision.
en.scenario: Review a release for code and security concerns.
en.mechanism: Distinguish reusable process, reviewer perspective and user-facing command; choose direct invocation for one lens and flat fan-out plus main merge for independent lenses.
en.bad: Add coordinator personas that delegate through several paraphrasing layers.
en.good: Have the release entry point dispatch two independent leaf reports and reconcile them directly against the release contract.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Routing depth and decision ownership are explicit.
en.boundaries: Flat independent reports fit known-artifact verdicts; shared hypothesis investigation may require interaction instead.

zh.description: 领域工作留叶角色，编排由拥有决策的入口承担。
zh.scenario: 评审发布的代码与安全。
zh.mechanism: 区别可复用流程、评审视角、面向用户命令；单视角直调，多独立视角扁平分发主合并。
zh.bad: 多层协调人格经反复转述再委派。
zh.good: 发布入口分发两个独立叶报告，并直接按发布契约协调。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 路由深度与决策归属明确。
zh.boundaries: 扁平独立报告适于已知产物判断，假设调查可能需交互。

sources.section: Separate workflow, perspective and entry point

name.zh: 按调查形状选择交互

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Choose independent reports for a known artifact and interacting investigators for competing causal hypotheses.
en.scenario: Investigate an intermittent queue stall.
en.mechanism: Ask whether the artifact is known or must be found; preserve independent judgments for verdicts, and require falsifiable evidence exchange before investigative convergence.
en.bad: Run three isolated reviewers and count which theory receives two votes.
en.good: Assign distinct stall hypotheses, let investigators exchange discriminating observations, and verify the surviving prediction with a focused replay before convergence.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Consensus is tied to disproof evidence rather than opinion count.
en.boundaries: Messaging or two-agent agreement alone does not establish a root cause; source host restrictions and efficacy claims are unverified.

zh.description: 已知产物用独立报告，竞争因果假设用交互调查。
zh.scenario: 调查间歇队列停顿。
zh.mechanism: 先问产物已知还是待找；判断保留独立性，调查收敛前交换可证伪证据。
zh.bad: 三个隔离评审，哪个理论两票就定。
zh.good: 分配不同停顿假设，交换区分性观察，收敛前以聚焦回放验证存活预测。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 共识联系反证，不是意见计票。
zh.boundaries: 互发消息或两人同意不证明根因，宿主限制效能声明未验证。

name.zh: 任务验收与常设就绪门

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Require the requested behavior and the standing project readiness bar separately.
en.scenario: Add an export button to a production page.
en.mechanism: Keep per-task acceptance distinct from reusable quality/integration/operational gates and check both before completion.
en.bad: Declare done because the button downloads one file.
en.good: Confirm the requested export behavior, then check the accepted project bar for errors, accessibility, integration and required release evidence.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: A happy-path feature result does not conceal unmet readiness conditions.
en.boundaries: Tailor the standing bar to the actual project and authorized scope; this is different from #193 checkable-plus-exhaustive criteria.

zh.description: 分别要求所需行为与项目常设就绪门。
zh.scenario: 给生产页加导出按钮。
zh.mechanism: 每任务验收与可复用质量集成运维门分开，完成前两者都核。
zh.bad: 按钮下载一次文件就宣称完成。
zh.good: 先确认导出所需行为，再核已接受项目门中的错误、可访问、集成、发布证据。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 功能快乐路径不掩盖未满足就绪条件。
zh.boundaries: 常设门按实际项目授权范围定，此不同于193可检查且穷尽。

name.zh: 一个有效路由权威

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Avoid stacking a full meta-router on top of a host that already selects the same skills natively.
en.scenario: Configure a host with native skill discovery.
en.mechanism: Detect the actual host discovery capability and choose one active routing authority; keep reusable skills available on demand.
en.bad: Preload two full lifecycle routers and let both dispatch the task.
en.good: Use the native router with the installed skill descriptions; load the meta-router only where the host lacks that capability.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: The same task does not receive competing dispatch protocols.
en.boundaries: Verify effective runtime discovery; installation or metadata alone is not proof that native routing works.

zh.description: 避免原生已选相同技能时再常驻完整元路由。
zh.scenario: 配置有原生技能发现的宿主。
zh.mechanism: 检测真实发现能力，只选一个有效路由权威，技能按需可用。
zh.bad: 常驻两个全生命周期路由让二者都分发。
zh.good: 使用原生路由和已装描述；仅宿主无该能力时载元路由。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 同任务不承受竞争分发协议。
zh.boundaries: 须验证有效运行发现，安装或元数据不证明原生路由工作。

name.en: Capability verbs over private tool workarounds
name.zh: 能力动词替代私有工具补丁

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Express a reusable procedure through required capabilities instead of one model private tool spelling.
en.scenario: Write a portable test workflow.
en.mechanism: State the observable action and evidence, and isolate exact runtime tool mappings in adapters.
en.bad: Call run_command with the exact serialization one model needed last week.
en.good: Run the repository focused-test command and retain the red output; let the host adapter select its execution tool.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: The procedure retains its goal across different tool surfaces.
en.boundaries: Fragile operations may need precise instructions; model-neutral wording is not permission to omit load-bearing constraints.

zh.description: 可复用流程写所需能力，不依赖单模型私有工具拼写。
zh.scenario: 编可移植测试流程。
zh.mechanism: 说明可见动作证据，具体运行映射隔离到适配器。
zh.bad: 按上周某模型补丁，固定run_command序列化。
zh.good: 运行仓库聚焦测试命令并保留失败输出；宿主适配器选执行工具。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 流程在不同工具表面保留目标。
zh.boundaries: 脆弱操作仍可能需精准步骤，中立措辞不可省关键约束。

sources.section: Capability verbs over private tool workarounds

name.en: Reference closure in the received artifact
name.zh: 接收产物中的参考闭包

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Verify referenced material in the receiver installed layout rather than only the author repository.
en.scenario: Hand one skill directory to another agent.
en.mechanism: List mandatory references and resolve them from the containing artifact under the shipped/handed-off layout; package or remap missing dependencies.
en.bad: Copy the body while leaving its ../../references targets only in the author checkout.
en.good: Include the required references inside the handed-off package and validate their relative links from the received skill before use.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: A context pointer remains reachable where the work actually runs.
en.boundaries: Existing-file checks do not prove licensing, contents or current semantics; optional references need explicit fallback.

zh.description: 在接收安装布局核参考，而不只作者仓库。
zh.scenario: 把一个技能目录交给另一代理。
zh.mechanism: 清点必需参考，从所在产物在交付布局解析；缺依赖则打包或改映射。
zh.bad: 只复制正文，../../references仍在作者签出。
zh.good: 交付包包含所需参考，使用前从接收技能核相对链接。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 上下文指针在实际工作处仍可达。
zh.boundaries: 存在检查不证明许可内容或当前语义，可选参考须明确回退。

sources.section: Reference closure in the received artifact

name.zh: 验证消费者解释

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: A local lenient reader passing is not proof that the real consumer accepts the same artifact.
en.scenario: Publish skill frontmatter containing a colon-space description.
en.mechanism: Test the serialized artifact against the consumer grammar or a strict reference parser; retain accepted/rejected controls and explicit unsupported boundaries.
en.bad: Accept it because a local split-on-first-colon helper reads a string.
en.good: Validate the full frontmatter with the target grammar; quote the scalar and test valid and invalid neighbors rather than trusting the helper parse.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Producer validation matches the receiver parsing requirement.
en.boundaries: The observed checker implements only a narrow set of failure shapes, not full YAML conformance or all host behavior.

zh.description: 本地宽松读取通过不证明真实消费者接受同产物。
zh.scenario: 发布描述含冒号空格的前言。
zh.mechanism: 按消费者语法或严格参考解析器验序列化产物，保留合法非法对照及未支持边界。
zh.bad: 本地首冒号切分读出字符串就通过。
zh.good: 按目标语法验完整前言，给标量加引号，并测合法非法邻例，不仅信助手解析。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 生产端验证吻合接收端要求。
zh.boundaries: 观察检查器仅实现窄失败形状，不是完整YAML或所有宿主一致。

name.en: Exemption authority outside the constrained unit
name.zh: 豁免权在受约束单元之外

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: A unit under validation cannot grant itself an exemption from that validation.
en.scenario: Validate required sections of a submitted skill.
en.mechanism: Keep reviewed exemption policy outside the unit, require an owned reason and use exact own-membership checks rather than inherited object keys.
en.bad: Let the skill declare exempt: sections or qualify through a constructor prototype key.
en.good: Consult the validator-owned reviewed exemption list; reject a self-declared exemption and require a documented policy change for a real exception.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: The input cannot silently authorize its own bypass.
en.boundaries: The policy repository must itself be review-protected; moving a list alone is not an authorization boundary.

zh.description: 被验证单元不能给自身验证豁免。
zh.scenario: 验证提交技能的必需章节。
zh.mechanism: 经审豁免政策在单元外，须负责人理由，用确切自有成员而非继承对象键。
zh.bad: 让技能自写exempt，或constructor原型键获得豁免。
zh.good: 查验证器持有的经审豁免表，自述豁免拒绝，真实例外须有记录政策变更。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 输入不暗中授权自身绕过。
zh.boundaries: 政策仓库本身须保护评审，移个表不构成授权边界。

sources.section: Exemption authority outside the constrained unit

name.en: Resolve confinement and ownership before destruction
name.zh: 破坏动作前解析范围与所有权

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: A well-formed derived path is a candidate target, not permission to delete it.
en.scenario: Clean up a job directory named in a process argument.
en.mechanism: Resolve symlinks, require a strict descendant of an allowed root and prior authenticated ownership evidence; refuse without broader fallback and address check/use races.
en.bad: Trust the OS-delivered path shape and delete it or fall back to the parent root.
en.good: Resolve the candidate under the job root, verify it is below that root and owned by the authorized job, then operate under an immutable hierarchy or safe descriptor.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Misderived or attacker-written target data does not enlarge cleanup scope.
en.boundaries: A writable marker is self-attestation; protect its integrity and bind expected owner to authenticated state.

zh.description: 格式正确派生路径只是目标候选，不是删除许可。
zh.scenario: 清理由进程参数命名的工作目录。
zh.mechanism: 解符号链接，要求允许根的严格后代与事先认证所有权，拒绝且不扩大回退，并处理检查使用竞争。
zh.bad: 信OS传来路径形状并删除，或回退父根。
zh.good: 在工作根下解析，核严格下层与授权工作所有权，再在不变层级或安全描述符操作。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 派生错误或攻击者写目标不扩大清理范围。
zh.boundaries: 可写标记只是自述，须保护完整性并绑定认证期望身份。

sources.section: Resolve confinement and ownership before destruction

name.en: Review installation scripts before first execution
name.zh: 首次执行前审安装脚本

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Inspect dependency execution at the actual installation boundary before running an ordinary install.
en.scenario: Initialize an unfamiliar workspace for an audit.
en.mechanism: Corroborate workspace manager/lockfile/CI, bootstrap with scripts disabled, review exact versioned scripts and record only required approvals before frozen verification.
en.bad: Run the default install to discover which lifecycle scripts exist.
en.good: Identify the workspace lockfile and pinned manager; install with scripts disabled, inspect pending scripts, approve narrowly and verify the resulting frozen install policy.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Unreviewed dependency code is not executed as discovery.
en.boundaries: Native flags/defaults are version-sensitive; this corpus matrix is a snapshot, not current verified command advice.

zh.description: 在真实安装边界、普通安装前检查依赖执行。
zh.scenario: 为审计初始化陌生工作区。
zh.mechanism: 核工作区管理器锁文件CI，禁脚本引导，审确切版本脚本，只记录必要批准再冻结验证。
zh.bad: 默认安装后再发现有哪些生命周期脚本。
zh.good: 确定工作区锁与管理器固定版本，禁脚本安装，审待执行脚本、窄授权并核冻结政策。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 不以执行未经审依赖代码来发现它。
zh.boundaries: 原生标志默认随版本变化，该矩阵是快照，非当前核实命令建议。

name.en: Abuse cases beside intended use cases
name.zh: 滥用例与预期用例并列

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Derive negative scenarios from each trust boundary before selecting controls.
en.scenario: Design an import-from-URL workflow.
en.mechanism: Name writer, asset and boundary; ask how the intended action can be misused and turn that into a testable failure scenario.
en.bad: Validate only a successful public HTTPS import.
en.good: Alongside success, test a redirect toward an internal address, oversized content and a caller lacking import rights; choose controls for those declared abuses.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: Controls are justified by named misuse paths rather than a generic checklist alone.
en.boundaries: These are scoped test scenarios, not permission to probe arbitrary live systems.

zh.description: 每信任边界先导负场景再选控制。
zh.scenario: 设计URL导入流程。
zh.mechanism: 说明写者资产边界，问预期动作如何被滥用，再变成可测失败场景。
zh.bad: 只验成功公网HTTPS导入。
zh.good: 成功旁测向内网重定向、超大内容、调用者无导入权；为这些滥用选控制。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 控制有命名滥用途径依据，不仅通用清单。
zh.boundaries: 这些为范围内测试例，不授权探任意真实系统。

sources.section: Abuse cases beside intended use cases

name.en: Validate kill assumptions before secondary preferences
name.zh: 先验证致命假设再看次要偏好

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Classify assumptions by what their failure would do to the proposed direction.
en.scenario: Plan a tool importing partner data.
en.mechanism: Validate dealbreakers before implementation, important adjustable bets next and secondary optimizations after the core is supported.
en.bad: Spend the first experiment choosing button colors while assuming the partner will supply a usable feed.
en.good: First test whether the partner can and will provide the required feed; next test the update model; defer cosmetic preferences until that core assumption holds.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: The first experiment can falsify the direction before costly construction.
en.boundaries: Assumption importance depends on the actual goal; source market hierarchies and numeric heuristics are not measured efficacy.

zh.description: 按失败对方向的影响给假设分级。
zh.scenario: 规划导入伙伴数据的工具。
zh.mechanism: 实施前验致命点，再验可调重要赌注，核心有支持后才次要优化。
zh.bad: 首实验选按钮色，默认伙伴能给可用数据。
zh.good: 先验伙伴能否且愿否提供所需数据，再验更新模型，核心成立后再看外观偏好。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 首实验可在昂贵构建前否证方向。
zh.boundaries: 重要度依实际目标，市场层级和数字启发式非实测效能。

sources.section: Validate kill assumptions before secondary preferences

name.en: Protected content through an editable projection
name.zh: 通过可编辑投影保护内容

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Keep protected content in an authoritative store while the editing view contains explicit opaque references.
en.scenario: Refactor a file containing a fixed vendor block.
en.mechanism: Preserve original bytes and identity, edit only the intended projection, then reconstruct and verify protected content and changed surroundings before applying.
en.bad: Show all bytes with a vague do-not-edit warning, or compile a working file after replacing its logic with comments.
en.good: Use a separate editing view with stable vendor-block sentinel, retain the original, reconstruct the patch and verify the protected block digest before applying it.
en.why: The procedure preserves the stated identity or evidence boundary instead of allowing a plausible shortcut to stand in for it.
en.expected: The edit contract can check both intended changes and preservation.
en.boundaries: The observed hook modifies working files in place and uses short/fuzzy IDs; that implementation is not a security boundary or guaranteed collision-free recovery.

zh.description: 权威库保留受保护内容，编辑视图含明确不透明引用。
zh.scenario: 重构含固定供应商块的文件。
zh.mechanism: 保留原字节身份，仅编辑指定投影，应用前重建并验受护内容与周边变化。
zh.bad: 给全文加含糊禁改提醒，或把工作文件逻辑替成注释后编译。
zh.good: 单独编辑视图用稳定供应商块哨兵，保留原文，重建补丁并验块摘要后应用。
zh.why: 流程保留明确的身份或证据边界，不让貌似合理的捷径代替它。
zh.expected: 编辑契约可同时检查预期变更与保留。
zh.boundaries: 观察钩子原地改工作文件且短模糊ID，不是安全边界或无碰撞恢复保证。

sources.section: Protected content through an editable projection

name.zh: 按意图匹配新鲜目录推荐

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Recommend a concrete resource only when the user wants learning material and a current catalog supports it.
en.scenario: A user asks for a short onboarding course for analysts.
en.mechanism: Classify learning intent, fetch the catalog, check its freshness and URL scope, then copy a strongly matching entry; use an observed hub fallback if unavailable.
en.bad: Suggest “Advanced Analyst Bootcamp” at a guessed course URL.
en.good: The current catalog lists “Analyst Basics”; link its exact URL and mention its sign-in requirement.
en.why: The recommendation is tied to an observed item rather than a plausible title.
en.expected: The named item, URL, freshness decision and intent match can be checked.
en.boundaries: A catalog is untrusted data. Freshness alone does not establish course quality; avoid recommendations during unrelated task execution.

zh.description: 只有用户想要学习材料且当前目录提供依据时，才推荐具体资源。
zh.scenario: 用户询问面向分析师的简短入门课程。
zh.mechanism: 辨别学习意图，读取目录并检查新鲜度和网址范围，复制强匹配条目；不可用时使用已知入口。
zh.bad: 推荐猜测的“高级分析训练营”课程网址。
zh.good: 当前目录列有“分析师基础”；链接其原始网址，并说明需要登录。
zh.why: 推荐关联已观察到的条目，而非看似合理的标题。
zh.expected: 可以核对条目、网址、新鲜度判断和意图匹配。
zh.boundaries: 目录是不可信数据。新鲜度不证明课程质量；无关任务执行中避免附加推荐。

name.zh: 具体且尊重意图的核验问题

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Attach optional verification questions to actual claims and assumptions, and omit them when the user already requested that verification.
en.scenario: A draft expansion plan assumes a 20% conversion rate with no local evidence.
en.mechanism: Answer the task first; point a brief follow-up at the exact assumption, its evidence source and missing context. If verification was requested, perform it inline instead.
en.bad: End with “Please double-check everything.”
en.good: For this plan, what local data supports the 20% conversion assumption?
en.why: A named dependency gives the user a specific check rather than generic caution.
en.expected: Each prompt identifies a claim, reasoning step or missing datum from the answer.
en.boundaries: Prompts do not replace required fact checking. A once-per-conversation cap is a source policy, not a validated optimum; executing code does not prove its correctness.

zh.description: 可选核验问题指向实际主张与假设；用户已要求核验时直接完成核验。
zh.scenario: 扩张计划假定转化率为20%，却没有本地证据。
zh.mechanism: 先完成任务；简短追问明确假设、证据与缺失背景。已要求核验时在正文完成。
zh.bad: 结尾写“请检查所有内容”。
zh.good: 对这份计划，哪些本地数据支持20%的转化率假设？
zh.why: 点名依赖让用户知道具体检查什么。
zh.expected: 每个问题都能关联回答中的主张、推理步骤或缺失数据。
zh.boundaries: 追问不替代应做的事实核验。每次对话一次是源策略，非已验证最优值；运行代码不证明其正确。

name.zh: 仅给文档的读者测试

candidates.reason: Exact document-only, fresh-reader method enriches existing reader testing; earliest origin remains unknown.

en.description: Test whether a document answers reader questions without the author’s conversation context.
en.scenario: A deployment guide was written in a long chat that resolved several prerequisites.
en.mechanism: Give a fresh reader only the guide and a realistic question; compare its answer with the intended result, record ambiguity and revise the responsible section.
en.bad: Ask the same authoring chat whether its guide is clear.
en.good: Give a fresh reader the guide and ask how to recover a failed release; add the missing rollback prerequisite it could not find.
en.why: Removing conversation context exposes undocumented assumptions.
en.expected: The reader’s answer and the text supporting it can be compared.
en.boundaries: A model reader is a proxy, not representative-user validation. Check facts independently and do not equate repeated model agreement with truth.

zh.description: 检查文档能否在没有作者对话背景的情况下回答读者问题。
zh.scenario: 部署指南在长对话中编写，几个前提已在对话里解决。
zh.mechanism: 给新读者仅提供指南和真实问题；比较答案与预期，记录歧义并修改对应章节。
zh.bad: 问原写作对话“这份指南是否清晰”。
zh.good: 给新读者指南并问失败发布如何恢复；补上其找不到的回滚前提。
zh.why: 去掉对话背景可暴露未写入文档的假设。
zh.expected: 可以比较读者答案与支持它的文字。
zh.boundaries: 模型读者只是代理，非真实用户验证。事实应独立核验，重复一致不等于真实。

name.en: Preserve coordinate units through tool handoffs
name.zh: 工具交接保留坐标单位

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Carry units, dimensions and origin with positions; normalize mixed coordinate sources before a downstream operation.
en.scenario: A form combines rectangles found in PDF points and regions estimated from a raster preview.
en.mechanism: Record page identity, source dimensions, units and origin; convert pixel coordinates to the common page system, then apply the consumer’s origin transform and inspect the result.
en.bad: Combine pixel and point rectangles in one field list as if their numbers mean the same thing.
en.good: Scale the image rectangle by page/image dimensions, label all rectangles as top-origin points, then convert once for the annotation writer.
en.why: Numeric shape agreement does not imply coordinate meaning agreement.
en.expected: The unit conversions, page mapping and rendered placement can be checked.
en.boundaries: Rotation, cropping, nonzero page origins and inaccurate detection need additional handling. The source checker compares font points with raw image units and does not validate every geometry invariant.

zh.description: 位置数据需携带单位、尺寸与原点；下游操作前统一混合来源坐标。
zh.scenario: 表单把PDF点单位的矩形与截图估算区域合并。
zh.mechanism: 记录页身份、来源尺寸、单位和原点；先把像素转换为统一页坐标，再按消费者原点转换并检查结果。
zh.bad: 把像素与点坐标放在同一字段列表，视为含义相同。
zh.good: 按页面与图片尺寸比例缩放截图矩形，将所有矩形标为上原点点坐标，再为注释写入器转换一次。
zh.why: 数字形状一致不代表坐标含义一致。
zh.expected: 可核对单位转换、页面映射和渲染位置。
zh.boundaries: 旋转、裁剪、非零页原点和误检需要额外处理。源检查器将字体点大小与原始图片单位比较，且未验证所有几何约束。

name.zh: 盲 A/B 对比

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Compare outputs on matched tasks while hiding version identity from the evaluator.
en.scenario: Evaluate two revisions of an incident-summary skill.
en.mechanism: Matched inputs and blinded labels reduce direct expectation cues.
en.bad: Show the evaluator which output is improved and ask whether it is better.
en.good: Run both versions on the same frozen incidents. Randomize output labels, conceal version identity and score factual preservation with one rubric. Allow ties; store judgments before decoding labels and repeat cases.
en.why: Matched inputs and blinded labels reduce direct expectation cues.
en.expected: The result includes per-case judgments, label mapping and repeated-run variation.
en.boundaries: Blinding removes version cues, not all evaluator bias; report variation and ties.

zh.description: 在匹配任务上比较输出，并向评估者隐藏版本身份。
zh.scenario: 评估事故摘要技能的两个版本。
zh.mechanism: 相同输入和隐藏标签减少直接的预期暗示。
zh.bad: 告诉评估者哪个输出是改进版，再问是否更好。
zh.good: 两版使用同一冻结事故集；随机标输出标签、隐藏版本身份，以同一量规评估事实保留。允许平局；解码标签前保存判断，并重复案例。
zh.why: 相同输入和隐藏标签减少直接的预期暗示。
zh.expected: 结果包含逐案例判断、标签映射与多次运行差异。
zh.boundaries: 隐藏标签去掉版本暗示，但不能消除全部偏差；报告差异和平局。

name.zh: 评测驱动的技能改进循环

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Improve a skill against preserved tasks, baselines and observable assertions.
en.scenario: Shorten a review skill without losing required evidence fields.
en.mechanism: A preserved suite tests behavioral change rather than the author's impression.
en.bad: Rewrite it elegantly, try one happy-path request and declare improvement.
en.good: Freeze baseline and cases covering complete, missing and ambiguous inputs. Assert every finding has trigger and location. Run both versions, compare failures and inspect output samples; revise and rerun any affected cases.
en.why: A preserved suite tests behavioral change rather than the author's impression.
en.expected: The report includes baseline/candidate failures and remaining uncertainty.
en.boundaries: Control runtime and inputs; limited cases establish only limited evidence, not universal efficacy.

zh.description: 用保留任务、基线及可观察断言改进技能。
zh.scenario: 缩短评审技能，但保留必要证据字段。
zh.mechanism: 保留的案例集检查行为变化，不依作者印象。
zh.bad: 优雅重写，试一次正常请求就宣布改进。
zh.good: 冻结基线和覆盖完整、缺失、歧义输入的案例。断言每条发现都有触发与位置。运行两版，比较失败并检查输出；修订后重跑受影响案例。
zh.why: 保留的案例集检查行为变化，不依作者印象。
zh.expected: 报告含基线、候选失败与剩余不确定性。
zh.boundaries: 控制运行时与输入；有限案例只提供有限证据，不证明通用效果。

name.zh: 用错误产物挑战断言

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Audit whether a passing assertion distinguishes task success from a concrete wrong output.
en.scenario: An extraction benchmark only checks that a CSV contains a customer name.
en.mechanism: Construct a plausible incorrect output that passes; strengthen the assertion to compare the relevant values and relationship against the input, then inspect per-case results.
en.bad: Pass a CSV because it contains “Mina”, even though that name is in a footer and the customer record is wrong.
en.good: Require Mina’s customer row to contain the input phone number and status; reject the footer-only counterexample.
en.why: The check measures the intended outcome rather than a coincidental token.
en.expected: A named wrong output passes the weak check and fails the corrected check.
en.boundaries: Improving an assertion may overfit to one failure. Maintain independent cases; a model grader’s evidence and accuracy still need calibration.

zh.description: 审查通过断言能否区分任务成功与具体错误产物。
zh.scenario: 提取基准只检查CSV包含客户姓名。
zh.mechanism: 构造能通过的合理错误产物；加强断言，按输入核对相关值与关系，再查看各案例结果。
zh.bad: CSV页脚出现“Mina”就通过，客户记录却错误。
zh.good: 要求Mina客户行包含输入中的电话和状态；拒绝仅页脚出现姓名的反例。
zh.why: 检查测量目标结果，而非偶然出现的词。
zh.expected: 指定错误产物通过弱检查，却不能通过修正后的检查。
zh.boundaries: 加强断言也可能对单一失败过拟合。保留独立案例，并校准模型评分证据和准确性。

name.en: Keep selection feedback out of revision prompts
name.zh: 修订提示隔离选择反馈

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Keep withheld-case results out of the prompt that proposes revisions, and name the resulting selection set accurately.
en.scenario: A router description is revised from labeled training failures while candidate versions are compared on reserved queries.
en.mechanism: Pass only training cases and history to the reviser; use the reserved results for candidate selection, label that set validation, and reserve a fresh final test for an unbiased final estimate.
en.bad: Feed the reserved failures back into every rewrite and call the best reserved score an untouched test result.
en.good: Hide reserved fields from revision history; select the description on validation and report final performance on new cases.
en.why: Separating feedback channels makes direct case leakage visible and avoids mislabeling adaptive selection as final testing.
en.expected: The revision prompt excludes reserved records; selection and final-test identities are recorded.
en.boundaries: The source implements withheld revision fields but selects repeatedly on its “test” set, so its score is validation, not an independent final estimate. Split ratios and repeat counts require task-specific calibration. Static stored thresholds and baseline scores are recorded artifacts, not fresh evaluation results. Held-out examples must not become revision feedback, and a provisional gate remains provisional when independent human judgment is missing.

zh.description: 不把保留案例结果传给提出修订的模型，并准确命名用于选择的数据集。
zh.scenario: 路由描述按训练失败修订，候选版本在预留查询上比较。
zh.mechanism: 修订器只接收训练案例与历史；预留结果用于候选选择，标为验证集，再留新的最终测试。
zh.bad: 每次改写都提供预留失败，却称最佳预留分数是未触碰的测试结果。
zh.good: 修订历史隐藏预留字段；验证集选描述，新案例报告最终表现。
zh.why: 分离反馈通道可观察直接泄漏，并避免把自适应选择称为最终测试。
zh.expected: 修订提示不含预留记录，且选择与最终测试身份有记录。
zh.boundaries: 源代码隔离修订字段，却反复用“测试”集选择，所以这是验证分数，非独立最终估计。比例和重复次数需按任务校准。 静态阈值与已存基线分数属于记录产物，不是新执行的评估结果。保留用例不能变成修订反馈；缺少独立人工判断时，暂定门槛仍是暂定。

sources.section: Generalize intent instead of enumerating cases
