name.zh: 可编辑产物保留计算关系

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Preserve computations when the recipient needs an artifact that updates with inputs.
en.scenario: Build an editable order workbook with quantity, price and total.
en.mechanism: A formula encodes the relationship that a hardcoded result loses.
en.bad: A2=10; B2=15; C2=150. Ship it as an editable total.
en.good: A2=10; B2=15; C2=SUM(A2*B2). Recalculate with the target engine. Change A2 to 12 in a verification copy and confirm C2 becomes 180.
en.why: A formula encodes the relationship that a hardcoded result loses.
en.expected: Changing quantity changes the computed total without rewriting the result.
en.boundaries: Use formulas for editable models; a requested immutable snapshot can legitimately contain values.

zh.description: 接收者需要随输入更新的产物时，保留计算关系。
zh.scenario: 制作可编辑订单工作簿，含数量、价格和总额。
zh.mechanism: 公式保留硬编码结果会丢失的关系。
zh.bad: A2=10；B2=15；C2=150，作为可编辑总额交付。
zh.good: A2=10；B2=15；C2=SUM(A2*B2)。用目标引擎重新计算；验证副本中 A2 改为 12，确认 C2 变 180。
zh.why: 公式保留硬编码结果会丢失的关系。
zh.expected: 更改数量会更新总额，无需手改结果。
zh.boundaries: 可编辑模型使用公式；用户要求的不可变快照可合理保留数值。

name.en: Evaluate the real application entry point
name.zh: 评估真实应用入口

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Exercise the application path that assembles context, routes tools and handles retries, rather than recreating its final model request.
en.scenario: Compare two support-agent prompts before rollout.
en.mechanism: Call the actual test-mode entry point; mock only unsafe external dependencies, preserve context/retry/tool wiring, and record the served configuration and a complete pilot result.
en.bad: Send the copied system prompt directly to a model and report that the support application improved.
en.good: Call the support handler with a disposable account; retain its retrieval and tools, stub outgoing messages, and inspect one full trace before the larger run.
en.why: A reconstructed request can bypass the behavior whose quality the task asks about.
en.expected: The exercised entry point, substituted dependencies and actual trace are inspectable.
en.boundaries: Test-mode parity must be checked; a reported model ID may not expose every provider substitution. Live side effects require the applicable authorization.

zh.description: 执行负责组装上下文、路由工具和重试的应用路径，而非重建其最后一次模型请求。
zh.scenario: 上线前比较两个客服代理提示。
zh.mechanism: 调用真实测试入口，只替换不安全外部依赖，保留上下文、重试和工具接线，记录实际配置和完整试点结果。
zh.bad: 把复制的系统提示直接发给模型，就称客服应用改善。
zh.good: 用一次性账户调用客服处理器，保留检索和工具，替换外发消息，并在扩大运行前检查完整轨迹。
zh.why: 重建请求可能绕过任务要测量的行为。
zh.expected: 可以检查执行入口、替换依赖与实际轨迹。
zh.boundaries: 需要核对测试模式与生产的一致性；模型标识未必暴露所有替换。实际副作用需相应授权。

sources.section: Real path and complete pilot record

name.en: Record the origin of evaluation references
name.zh: 记录评估参考答案来源

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Record whether reference answers are independently verified or generated by a system under comparison.
en.scenario: Compare a new summarizer with an incumbent whose outputs became the answer key.
en.mechanism: Label reference origin, verify factual criteria independently, and choose rubric or blind comparison when multiple valid outputs exist.
en.bad: Mark every stylistic departure from the incumbent summary wrong because its text is the gold answer.
en.good: Check both summaries against the source facts and an independently reviewed rubric; retain the incumbent text as a comparison artifact with its origin labeled.
en.why: Imitation of one candidate is separated from correctness on the task.
en.expected: Reference provenance and the independently checked criteria are recorded.
en.boundaries: Human verification can also be wrong. A rubric or pairwise judge still requires calibration and bias checks.

zh.description: 记录参考答案是否独立核验，或由正在比较的系统生成。
zh.scenario: 比较新摘要器与旧系统，旧输出已成为答案键。
zh.mechanism: 标明参考来源，独立核验事实标准；有多个正确输出时使用量规或盲比较。
zh.bad: 任何与旧摘要风格不同的输出都按答案文本判错。
zh.good: 按原文事实和独立审查的量规检查两个摘要；旧文本作为标注来源的比较产物保留。
zh.why: 把模仿某个候选与任务正确性分开。
zh.expected: 参考来源和独立核验标准有记录。
zh.boundaries: 人工核验也会出错；量规与成对评分仍需校准和偏差检查。

name.en: Grade the environment left by an agent
name.zh: 评分代理留下的环境

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: For an agent that changes an environment, score the resulting state and use transcripts for explicit process constraints.
en.scenario: Evaluate a repository bug-fix agent.
en.mechanism: Start each trial in an isolated fixture, run hidden behavioral checks on the resulting diff and state, detect no-op success claims, and inspect process evidence only for declared constraints.
en.bad: Pass the run because its transcript says the bug was fixed and tests passed.
en.good: Run the hidden boundary test on its final checkout, inspect the allowed-file diff, and fail a claimed fix that left the workspace unchanged.
en.why: Narrated success is separated from the observable result.
en.expected: The resulting files, tests, effects and prohibited changes can be checked.
en.boundaries: A state oracle covers only its invariants; hidden tests and isolated environments can be incomplete. Taste dimensions may need independent human or judge review.

zh.description: 改变环境的代理按最终状态评分，轨迹用于明确的过程约束。
zh.scenario: 评估代码库修错代理。
zh.mechanism: 每次从隔离夹具开始，对最终差异和状态做隐藏行为检查，检测空操作成功声明，仅对规定过程约束查看轨迹。
zh.bad: 轨迹称缺陷已修、测试通过就判通过。
zh.good: 在最终检出运行隐藏边界测试，检查允许文件差异；声称修复但工作区未变则失败。
zh.why: 把叙述成功与可观察结果分开。
zh.expected: 可以核对文件、测试、副作用和越界修改。
zh.boundaries: 状态判定只覆盖已写不变量；隐藏测试和隔离环境也可能不完整。审美维度需独立人工或模型评审。

name.en: Keep attempts, grades and traces coherent
name.zh: 保持尝试、评分与轨迹一致

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Distinguish a scorable result from an attempt failure and keep each result’s grade, trace and usage bound to the same invocation.
en.scenario: A resumable extraction evaluation crashes after several completed cases.
en.mechanism: Key durable results by case and repetition; checkpoint completed invocations, record failed attempts separately with class and usage, and resume only missing scorable results.
en.bad: Write a timeout as a negative answer in the result slot, then skip it forever on resume.
en.good: Record the timeout in the attempt ledger, keep the result slot open, and bind a later valid answer’s grade and trace to that later invocation.
en.why: Infrastructure failure cannot masquerade as a task answer or block honest recovery.
en.expected: Result identities, attempt history and same-call evidence can be reconciled.
en.boundaries: Retries may still repeat side effects; isolate or make them idempotent. Checkpoint ordering and concurrent writes need implementation-level consistency. Report exclusions and failure rates alongside conditional scores.

zh.description: 区分可评分结果与尝试失败，把评分、轨迹和用量绑定同一次调用。
zh.scenario: 可续跑提取评估在完成若干案例后崩溃。
zh.mechanism: 按案例与重复次数保存结果；完成调用及时落盘，失败尝试另记类别与用量，只补跑缺少可评分结果的槽位。
zh.bad: 把超时写成否定答案，占住结果槽，续跑永远跳过。
zh.good: 超时写入尝试台账，结果槽保持空缺；后续有效答案的评分与轨迹绑定后续调用。
zh.why: 基础设施失败不能伪装成任务答案，也不能阻止正确恢复。
zh.expected: 可以对账结果身份、尝试历史和同次调用证据。
zh.boundaries: 重试仍可能重复副作用，需隔离或幂等。落盘顺序和并发写入需实现层一致性；条件评分应同时报告排除与失败率。

sources.section: No answer is not negative answer
Resolved run scope, canary and complete result record

name.zh: 跨轮次冻结比较参考

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Compare iterative candidates with the same saved reference artifacts and retain older references when adding a harder comparison.
en.scenario: Optimize a report-writing skill over several rounds.
en.mechanism: Save the baseline output for each case once; compare every candidate against those files, track judge and case versions, and add a second reference if the first saturates.
en.bad: Regenerate the baseline every round and compare each win rate as though the opponent stayed fixed.
en.good: Compare v1 and v2 against the same saved baseline; when both saturate, add the v2 reference as a separate column and keep the original column.
en.why: The meaning of a reported win rate stays stable across rounds.
en.expected: The reference hashes and per-case comparison identities can be inspected.
en.boundaries: Frozen references can become stale and judges can drift. A fixed comparison does not establish broad superiority or detect cross-case mode collapse.

zh.description: 迭代候选使用同一保存参考产物，增加更难比较时仍保留旧参考。
zh.scenario: 多轮优化报告写作技能。
zh.mechanism: 每个案例保存基线输出一次；所有候选与这些文件比较，跟踪评分器与案例版本；旧参考饱和时增加第二参考。
zh.bad: 每轮重新生成基线，却把胜率当作对手固定来比较。
zh.good: v1与v2使用同一保存基线；均饱和后另加v2参考列，同时保留原列。
zh.why: 报告胜率的含义跨轮保持稳定。
zh.expected: 可以检查参考哈希与各案例比较身份。
zh.boundaries: 冻结参考会过时，评分器会漂移。固定比较不证明普遍优势，也不能发现跨案例风格坍缩。

name.en: Use a deadline independent of stream activity
name.zh: 截止时间独立于流活动

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Use a total operation deadline as well as inactivity detection so keepalives cannot occupy a worker indefinitely.
en.scenario: A streamed evaluation call keeps sending heartbeat events without finishing.
en.mechanism: Start a non-resetting wall-clock budget for the case; classify expiry as a timeout, release local capacity, cap retries, and retain the underlying-operation identity.
en.bad: Reset the only timeout after each heartbeat and wait forever.
en.good: Stop local waiting after the case deadline despite fresh heartbeats; record the timeout and handle any still-running request separately.
en.why: Liveness of a connection is separated from completion of the task.
en.expected: The elapsed deadline, released slot and timeout record are observable.
en.boundaries: Stopping local waiting does not necessarily cancel the remote request or its side effects. Budget and retry policy depend on the task and service.

zh.description: 除静默检测外，还设置总操作截止时间，避免心跳无限占用工作槽。
zh.scenario: 流式评估调用持续发送心跳却不完成。
zh.mechanism: 案例开始时设置不重置的时间预算；到期标为超时，释放本地容量，限制重试并保留远程操作身份。
zh.bad: 每个心跳都重置唯一超时，永远等待。
zh.good: 即使心跳新鲜也在案例截止时间停止本地等待，记录超时，并另行处理可能仍运行的请求。
zh.why: 连接活性与任务完成被分开。
zh.expected: 可以观察耗时截止、释放槽位和超时记录。
zh.boundaries: 停止本地等待未必取消远程请求或其副作用。预算与重试策略取决于任务和服务。

name.en: Keep answer keys outside agent reach
name.zh: 答案键置于代理不可达范围

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Make evaluation answers structurally unavailable to the system being tested, including history and earlier-trial artifacts.
en.scenario: An agent is evaluated on diagnosing a fault in a repository fixture.
en.mechanism: Give it the realistic symptom and allowed fixture; keep gold labels and grader data outside its accessible environment, remove leftover trial state, and check its actual access paths.
en.bad: Store gold.json in the agent checkout and merely instruct it not to read the answer key.
en.good: Keep the gold file in the grader process outside the agent workspace; expose the same user-visible symptom as production.
en.why: A verbal prohibition cannot establish a hidden-answer boundary.
en.expected: Accessible files, history, tools and trial leftovers can be inspected.
en.boundaries: Isolation depends on the actual sandbox and credentials; model memory or public copies may still reveal answers. A case testing retrieval needs enough obscurity to require that work.

zh.description: 让答案结构上对被测系统不可达，包括历史和前次试验产物。
zh.scenario: 评估代理诊断仓库夹具故障。
zh.mechanism: 只给真实症状和允许夹具；答案标签与评分数据放在可访问环境外，清理前次状态，检查实际访问路径。
zh.bad: 把gold.json放在代理检出目录，只提示不要读答案。
zh.good: 答案文件留在工作区外的评分进程，代理只看到与生产相同的用户症状。
zh.why: 口头禁止不能建立隐藏答案边界。
zh.expected: 可以检查可访问文件、历史、工具与前次残留。
zh.boundaries: 隔离取决于实际沙箱和凭据；模型记忆或公开副本仍可能泄漏答案。检索案例需足够陌生才要求真实检索。

name.en: Promote opaque actions to typed control points
name.zh: 把不透明动作提升为类型化控制点

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Expose an action as a typed tool when the harness needs to gate, render, audit or schedule that action specifically.
en.scenario: An invoice assistant can use a shell, but sending an invoice requires a recipient-specific approval check.
en.mechanism: Define a send-invoice operation with typed recipient and invoice identity; let the harness validate scope and perform its approval and audit checks before executing the effect.
en.bad: Hide invoice sending in a shell string that the harness classifies only as generic command execution.
en.good: Call the typed send-invoice tool; the harness shows the exact recipient and invoice and applies its documented approval rule.
en.why: The harness can reason about a declared action and its arguments without inferring intent from arbitrary command text.
en.expected: The action schema, approval check and executed effect can be inspected.
en.boundaries: A typed tool is not authorization by itself. A shell-aware harness may also enforce effects; the source claim that bash cannot enforce invariants is too broad. This differs from portable host-adapter capability verbs.

zh.description: 当宿主需要专门控制、展示、审计或调度某个动作时，把它暴露为类型化工具。
zh.scenario: 发票助手可用Shell，但发送发票须按收件人审批。
zh.mechanism: 定义包含收件人与发票身份的发送操作；副作用执行前由宿主验证范围并执行审批和审计。
zh.bad: 把发送藏在Shell字符串里，宿主只能按通用命令执行分类。
zh.good: 调用类型化发送工具，宿主展示确切收件人与发票，并应用已记录审批规则。
zh.why: 宿主可处理声明动作与参数，无需从任意命令文本推断意图。
zh.expected: 可以检查动作模式、审批检查与实际副作用。
zh.boundaries: 类型化工具本身不是授权。感知Shell效果的宿主也能强制约束，源中“bash不能强制不变量”过于绝对。此方法区别于可移植宿主适配能力动词。

name.zh: 按稳定性组装缓存前缀

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: For a host with a verified prefix-cache contract, place stable inputs before volatile inputs and check the rendered overlapping prefix when reuse regresses.
en.scenario: Repeated analysis requests share a policy and document, but a request ID is inserted ahead of both.
en.mechanism: Trace every assembly input; order stable global, session and turn content according to the host contract, place the cache boundary before the unique tail, and compare real payloads plus cache metrics.
en.bad: Put a fresh UUID at the beginning of every request and assume adding a cache marker guarantees reuse.
en.good: Keep the shared policy and document byte-stable, put the UUID and question after them, then check whether a second eligible request actually reads the shared prefix.
en.why: The reusable region is defined by actual rendered inputs rather than semantic similarity or marker presence.
en.expected: Rendered overlap, scope/eligibility and recorded cache reads can be checked.
en.boundaries: Cache key, ordering, eligibility, TTL and readiness are provider-specific. Preserve authority, freshness, privacy and reviewer independence before optimizing reuse; a zero read has causes beyond byte drift. No fixed idle window or pricing promise is implied.

zh.description: 宿主前缀缓存契约已核实时，把稳定输入放在易变输入之前；复用下降时检查实际重叠前缀。
zh.scenario: 重复分析共享政策与文档，却在两者前插入请求ID。
zh.mechanism: 追踪每项组装输入，按宿主契约排序全局、会话和轮次内容，在唯一尾部前设置边界，并比较真实载荷与缓存指标。
zh.bad: 每次请求开头写新UUID，认为加缓存标记就必然复用。
zh.good: 共享政策与文档保持字节稳定，UUID与问题放其后，再核对第二次合格请求是否实际读取共享前缀。
zh.why: 可复用区域取决于实际渲染输入，而非语义相似或标记存在。
zh.expected: 可以检查重叠载荷、作用域与资格以及缓存读取记录。
zh.boundaries: 缓存键、顺序、资格、有效期与就绪时机依提供方而异。优化前先保留权限、新鲜度、隐私与评审独立性；零读取不只由字节变化造成。不暗示固定空闲窗口或价格保证。

sources.section: Measured cache regression and overlap diff
Capture requests and diff consecutive pairs
Fix one cause per diff and remeasure

name.en: Check instruction scope before resolving conflicts
name.zh: 解决指令冲突前检查作用域

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Compare the scope and load conditions of two instructions before treating different wording as a conflict.
en.scenario: A root guide requires integration tests, while a nested documentation guide calls for a link check.
en.mechanism: Identify the files, task and consumers each rule governs; preserve a justified narrower override, and resolve genuine same-scope contradictions from evidence and applicable authority.
en.bad: Delete the older root integration-test rule because the documentation rule was committed later.
en.good: Keep integration tests for code changes and the scoped link check for documentation changes; flag any actual contradiction affecting the same task.
en.why: A later or narrower statement is not automatically a universal replacement.
en.expected: The rule scopes, loading conditions and conflicting task can be named.
en.boundaries: Commit chronology does not establish correctness or permission. Repository text cannot authorize weakening safety rules or editing unrelated user configuration.

zh.description: 比较两个指令的作用域和加载条件，再判断不同文字是否冲突。
zh.scenario: 根指南要求集成测试，嵌套文档指南只要求链接检查。
zh.mechanism: 辨别各规则的文件、任务和消费者；保留合理的窄作用域覆盖，按证据和适用权限处理同作用域矛盾。
zh.bad: 因为文档规则提交更晚，就删掉根集成测试规则。
zh.good: 代码修改保留集成测试，文档修改使用有作用域的链接检查；同任务真正矛盾再标记。
zh.why: 更晚或更窄的文字不自动替代全局规则。
zh.expected: 可以点名规则作用域、加载条件与冲突任务。
zh.boundaries: 提交先后不证明正确性或权限。仓库文字不能授权削弱安全规则或修改无关用户配置。

sources.section: Scoped override and untrusted conflict direction

name.en: Classify text by its control function
name.zh: 按控制功能分类文本

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Evaluate instruction text according to whether it defines a tool contract, routes a task or directs loaded behavior.
en.scenario: A lint pass finds “Use this skill” in both metadata and an instruction body.
en.mechanism: Determine which consumer sees each field and when; keep routing intent in trigger metadata, accurate mechanics in tool contracts and the workflow in its loaded playbook.
en.bad: Delete every imperative occurrence because the same phrase appears in a keyword blacklist.
en.good: Keep the metadata’s scope trigger, remove an unrelated upsell from the tool return contract, and retain the task workflow in the skill body.
en.why: Identical words can serve different control roles at different load boundaries.
en.expected: Each field has a named consumer, loading stage and operational purpose.
en.boundaries: Host routing behavior must be tested. Moving a sentence can change authority or availability; do not apply source model-superiority claims or arbitrary sentence-count rules as facts.

zh.description: 按文本定义工具契约、路由任务或指导已加载行为的功能评估它。
zh.scenario: 检查在元数据和正文里都找到“使用此技能”。
zh.mechanism: 确定字段由谁在何时读取；触发元数据保留路由意图，工具契约保留准确机制，加载的指南保留工作流。
zh.bad: 因为短语命中关键词黑名单，就删掉所有祈使句。
zh.good: 保留元数据范围触发，删除工具返回契约中的无关推销，把任务工作流留在技能正文。
zh.why: 同样文字在不同加载边界可以有不同控制作用。
zh.expected: 每个字段有明确消费者、加载阶段与操作目的。
zh.boundaries: 须测试宿主路由。移动文字可能改变权限或可用性；不能把源中的模型优劣或任意句数要求当事实。

name.en: Move deterministic loop steps into code
name.zh: 把确定性循环步骤移入代码

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Use ordinary code for steps fully determined by their inputs and retain model judgment for the ambiguous remainder.
en.scenario: An agent repeatedly normalizes invoice currencies, totals rows and classifies unclear descriptions.
en.mechanism: Map call sites to responsibilities; implement fixed normalization and arithmetic in code, then send only ambiguous descriptions and needed context to the judgment step.
en.bad: Ask a model to repeat the same normalization and sum instructions separately for every row.
en.good: Normalize and sum in one deterministic pass; ask the model to classify the three ambiguous descriptions with their relevant evidence.
en.why: Mechanical invariants become inspectable while the actual judgment remains explicit.
en.expected: The call-site map, deterministic outputs and remaining judgment inputs can be checked.
en.boundaries: A step is deterministic only if its policy and inputs are complete. Do not remove model judgment merely because inputs are structured; preserve error handling and source provenance.

zh.description: 输入完全决定的步骤用普通代码，模型判断留给有歧义的剩余部分。
zh.scenario: 代理重复归一发票币种、汇总行，并分类不清楚的描述。
zh.mechanism: 逐个调用点映射职责；代码实现固定归一与算术，只把有歧义描述和所需上下文交给判断步骤。
zh.bad: 每行都让模型重复相同归一与求和指令。
zh.good: 确定性遍历归一并求和，只让模型结合证据分类三个有歧义描述。
zh.why: 机械不变量可以检查，实际判断也保持明确。
zh.expected: 可以核对调用点映射、确定性输出和剩余判断输入。
zh.boundaries: 政策与输入完整才是确定性步骤。不能只因输入结构化就删除模型判断；须保留错误处理与来源。

sources.section: Mechanical work and retained adaptive judgment

name.en: Validate the whole streamed turn before acting
name.zh: 行动前验证完整流式轮次

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Gate client-side tool execution on completed generation, strict input parsing and the tool’s validation contract.
en.scenario: A streaming file-write call returns a parsed object while generation stopped at the output limit.
en.mechanism: Accumulate the complete turn, inspect its termination state, reject refusal or cutoff, strictly parse available raw input, validate the contract, then apply the authorized effect.
en.bad: Write the parsed file body immediately because the object has the required path and contents fields.
en.good: When the turn ended by cutoff, keep the destination unchanged, record incomplete generation, and retry under a bounded policy before any write.
en.why: A tolerant parse can produce a plausible object without proving the intended input was complete.
en.expected: The final stop state, validation result and absence of premature effects can be checked.
en.boundaries: Schema validity alone cannot detect every truncated-but-valid string. SDK parsing and streaming contracts vary; client gates cannot undo server-side effects already performed.

zh.description: 客户端工具执行须通过生成完成、严格解析和工具契约验证。
zh.scenario: 流式写文件调用返回可解析对象，但生成因输出上限停止。
zh.mechanism: 收集完整轮次，检查终止状态，拒绝拒绝响应或截断，严格解析可得原始输入并验证契约，再执行已授权副作用。
zh.bad: 对象包含path与contents字段就立刻写入。
zh.good: 轮次因截断结束时保持目标不变，记录未完成生成，并在任何写入前按有界策略重试。
zh.why: 宽容解析可产生合理对象，却不证明原本输入完整。
zh.expected: 可以检查终止状态、验证结果和无过早副作用。
zh.boundaries: 模式正确无法发现所有截短但仍合法的字符串。SDK解析和流契约不同；客户端门禁不能撤销已发生的服务器副作用。

sources.section: Tolerant parser and final stop guard

name.en: Retain full validation beside a compatible schema
name.zh: 兼容模式旁保留完整验证

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Keep the full business validation contract when a host accepts only a reduced schema representation.
en.scenario: A structured-output host accepts number types but does not enforce the owner’s nonnegative-price constraint.
en.mechanism: Maintain the original validator, derive a compatible wire schema, and validate the returned data against every removed constraint before downstream use.
en.bad: Trust the host’s strict-schema label after dropping the minimum-price constraint.
en.good: Send the supported schema projection, then reject a negative price with the original validator before creating the quote.
en.why: Transport compatibility does not imply the full policy was enforced.
en.expected: The original constraints, omitted wire facets and final validation result can be compared.
en.boundaries: The host’s actual supported subset must be verified. Full schema validation still does not prove source truth, authorization or semantic suitability.

zh.description: 宿主仅接受缩减模式时，仍保留完整业务验证契约。
zh.scenario: 结构化输出宿主接受数字类型，却不执行非负价格约束。
zh.mechanism: 保留原验证器，派生兼容传输模式；下游使用前核验被移除的每项约束。
zh.bad: 删掉最低价格约束后，仍信任宿主严格模式标签。
zh.good: 发送支持的模式投影，报价创建前由原验证器拒绝负价格。
zh.why: 传输兼容不代表完整政策已经执行。
zh.expected: 可以比较原约束、传输遗漏部分与最终验证结果。
zh.boundaries: 需核实宿主实际支持子集。完整模式验证仍不证明来源真实、已授权或语义适合。

name.zh: 保留完整协议封套

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Retain structured response state for continuation and derive human-readable text as a separate view.
en.scenario: An agent response contains readable text, a tool-call identity and an opaque continuation block.
en.mechanism: Store the full envelope with typed blocks and matching identities; extract text for display while returning the unchanged required state on continuation.
en.bad: Save only the first text block and rebuild the next request from its prose summary.
en.good: Display the text, but retain the raw tool and opaque blocks and bind the tool result to the original call identity.
en.why: Display text is not the complete operational state of a protocol.
en.expected: The stored envelope, typed dispatch and result-to-call identity can be checked.
en.boundaries: Retention, replay and signature rules are host-specific. Do not fabricate or decrypt opaque fields; apply data-handling rules and verify which transformations are allowed.

zh.description: 续跑保留结构化响应状态，供人阅读文字另作视图。
zh.scenario: 代理响应含可读文字、工具调用身份与不透明续跑块。
zh.mechanism: 完整保存类型化块和匹配身份；显示时抽取文字，续跑时按契约返回未修改的必要状态。
zh.bad: 只保存首个文字块，再用摘要重建下个请求。
zh.good: 展示文字，但保留原工具块和不透明块，并把工具结果绑定原调用身份。
zh.why: 显示文字不是协议的完整操作状态。
zh.expected: 可以检查保存封套、类型分派和结果对应调用身份。
zh.boundaries: 保留、重放和签名规则依宿主而异。不可伪造或解密不透明字段；遵守数据处理规则并核实允许的变换。

name.zh: 类型化错误指导恢复

candidates.reason: Same error-class-directed recovery as the completed Composio method; exact SDK exception names remain frozen observations, not current API guarantees.

en.description: Treat authorization, invalid input, throttling and empty data as different outcomes.
en.scenario: A contact lookup returns HTTP 403.
en.mechanism: Inspect service error details; repair credentials/permissions for auth failures, arguments for validation, backoff for throttling, and accept documented empty results.
en.bad: Retry the identical 403 request ten times.
en.good: Read the access error; stop retries; identify missing permission and resume only after credentials are repaired.
en.why: Retries do not repair deterministic configuration errors.
en.expected: The recovery action matches the recorded error class.
en.boundaries: Status codes alone may be ambiguous; use service error details and bounded retries.

zh.description: 将授权、参数错误、限流与空数据分开处理。
zh.scenario: 联系人查询返回 HTTP 403。
zh.mechanism: 结合服务错误详情判断：授权问题修凭据，参数问题修输入，限流退避，规定的空结果正常处理。
zh.bad: 连续重试十次相同的 403 请求。
zh.good: 读取访问错误，停止重试，明确缺失权限，修复凭据后再继续。
zh.why: 重复请求不能修复确定性的配置错误。
zh.expected: 恢复动作与记录的失败类别一致。
zh.boundaries: 仅凭状态码可能有歧义；需结合详情并限制重试次数。

name.en: Separate build variance from scoring variance
name.zh: 区分构建变异与评分变异

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: When a prompt builds an artifact that is later evaluated, measure build variability separately from repeated scoring of one artifact.
en.scenario: A prompt generates a retrieval index, and several query repetitions score that single generated index.
en.mechanism: Rebuild the unchanged baseline independently, score each build with the same query design, and preserve build identity in candidate comparisons; estimate uncertainty at the levels where randomness occurs.
en.bad: Rescore one baseline index many times and treat its tight score spread as the uncertainty of changing the index-building prompt.
en.good: Build several baseline indexes with the same prompt, score each, and compare candidate builds while keeping between-build and within-build variation visible.
en.why: Repeated scoring of one build cannot reveal variability from the generation step that was sampled only once.
en.expected: Build identities, unchanged-prompt replicas and scores grouped by build can be inspected.
en.boundaries: Replicas must actually be independent at the intended level; shared caches or fixtures can couple them. The source’s example percentages and fixed replication counts are not verified guarantees.

zh.description: 提示先构建产物再评估时，构建变异应与同一产物重复评分的变异分开。
zh.scenario: 提示生成检索索引，多个查询重复都评分这一个索引。
zh.mechanism: 独立重建未改动基线，对每次构建使用相同查询设计，候选比较保留构建身份；在随机性实际发生的层级估计不确定性。
zh.bad: 把一个基线索引重评分多次，将很小的评分波动当成修改构建提示的全部不确定性。
zh.good: 同一提示生成多个基线索引，各自评分；比较候选构建时同时展示构建间与构建内变异。
zh.why: 重复评分单次构建无法暴露只采样一次的生成步骤变异。
zh.expected: 可以检查构建身份、未变提示副本以及按构建分组的分数。
zh.boundaries: 副本需在所需层级真正独立；共享缓存或夹具可能关联它们。源示例百分比与固定重复次数不是已核验保证。

sources.section: Stochastic artifact build and propagated control

name.en: Regrade all variants after a criterion change
name.zh: 评分标准变化后重评所有变体

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: When a metric or grader changes, apply it consistently to stored outputs from every compared variant before recommending a winner.
en.scenario: A review benchmark adds an omitted factual-accuracy criterion after several rounds.
en.mechanism: Version the new criterion, regrade frozen outputs for baseline and all candidates, retain old-versus-new comparisons, and reconsider the winner if rankings change.
en.bad: Score only the latest candidate with the new criterion and compare it to the old baseline number.
en.good: Regrade the same saved outputs from every round with the new criterion, publish both grading versions, and reassess the earlier recommendation.
en.why: A change in measurement is separated from a change in the generated artifact.
en.expected: Criterion versions, fixed output identities and ranking changes can be checked.
en.boundaries: Stored outputs may omit required evidence. Model judges add variance and cost; if the original search optimized the wrong signal, regrading alone does not undo that selection history.

zh.description: 指标或评分器变化时，推荐赢家前统一重评所有已比较变体的保存输出。
zh.scenario: 评审基准运行数轮后，新增此前遗漏的事实准确性标准。
zh.mechanism: 版本化新标准，对基线和全部候选的冻结输出重评，保留新旧比较；排名变化时重新考虑赢家。
zh.bad: 只用新标准评最新候选，却与旧基线数值比较。
zh.good: 新标准重评每轮相同保存输出，公开两版评分，并重新评估先前建议。
zh.why: 把测量方式变化与生成产物变化分开。
zh.expected: 可以核对标准版本、固定输出身份及排名变化。
zh.boundaries: 保存输出可能缺少所需证据。模型评分增加变异和费用；原搜索若优化错误信号，重评本身不能撤销选择历史。

name.en: Use fresh no-change controls after drift
name.zh: 条件漂移后使用新无改动对照

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: When execution conditions change, compare a candidate against a contemporaneous unchanged control rather than only an old baseline number.
en.scenario: A prompt candidate is evaluated a week after the baseline, after the serving environment changed.
en.mechanism: Record the environment and artifact fingerprints; rerun the unchanged control under current conditions, rebuilding any stochastic intermediate artifact, then compare the candidate in that same setting.
en.bad: Attribute the difference from last week’s baseline entirely to the prompt edit.
en.good: Run the unchanged prompt and candidate in the current environment on the same case design; retain the old score as historical evidence.
en.why: Environmental movement is not silently attributed to the candidate change.
en.expected: Fingerprints, no-change runs and contemporaneous comparisons are recorded.
en.boundaries: A fingerprint cannot capture every hidden provider change. Controls need comparable cache/state conditions and appropriate replication; they do not alone prove causation.

zh.description: 执行条件变化时，用同时期未改动对照比较候选，而非只依赖旧基线数值。
zh.scenario: 提示候选在基线一周后评估，服务环境已经改变。
zh.mechanism: 记录环境和产物指纹；在当前条件重跑未改动对照，重建随机中间产物，再在相同设置比较候选。
zh.bad: 把与上周基线的差异全部归因于提示修改。
zh.good: 当前环境下使用相同案例设计运行原提示与候选，旧分数保留作历史证据。
zh.why: 环境变化不会默默归因于候选修改。
zh.expected: 指纹、无改动运行与同时期比较有记录。
zh.boundaries: 指纹无法覆盖所有隐藏提供方变化。对照需可比缓存与状态和适当重复；本身不证明因果。

name.en: Classify the failing layer when optimization stalls
name.zh: 优化停滞时分类失败层

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: When repeated edits fail to move an evaluation, classify remaining failures by the layer that could explain them before adding more instructions.
en.scenario: A retrieval-agent benchmark stays flat after several prompt reminders to use search.
en.mechanism: Read representative traces and artifacts; separate missing knowledge, wrong grading, unavailable wiring, unreachable content and ordinary variability, then target the evidenced layer.
en.bad: Add another stronger “always search” instruction after every flat round.
en.good: If traces show search was never registered, repair the harness; if it ran correctly but the grader rejects valid citations, revise and regrade the criterion.
en.why: The tuned prompt is not assumed to be the bottleneck for every failure.
en.expected: Each failure bucket has concrete case evidence and a layer-specific next action.
en.boundaries: The taxonomy is a diagnostic aid, not proof of root cause. Cases can cross layers; validate the proposed explanation with a controlled probe and preserve unknowns.

zh.description: 连续编辑无法改变评估结果时，先按可能解释剩余失败的层级分类，再增加指令。
zh.scenario: 多轮提醒使用搜索后，检索代理基准仍持平。
zh.mechanism: 读取代表轨迹和产物，区分知识缺失、评分错误、接线不可用、内容不可达与普通变异，再针对有证据的层。
zh.bad: 每轮持平后再加更强“始终搜索”指令。
zh.good: 轨迹显示搜索未注册就修宿主；若已正确搜索却拒绝有效引用，就修标准并重评。
zh.why: 不假定每个失败的瓶颈都是正在调整的提示。
zh.expected: 每个失败类别有具体案例证据与层级对应行动。
zh.boundaries: 分类是诊断辅助，不证明根因。案例可跨层，需对照探测解释并保留未知。

sources.section: Artifact, grader, harness, structure and variance

name.en: Confirm the selected configuration as a whole
name.zh: 整体确认选定配置

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: After selecting interacting settings in separate stages, evaluate the final combination on fresh runs against criteria fixed before confirmation.
en.scenario: A search selects a model, revises its prompt and lowers its reasoning setting in three separate stages.
en.mechanism: Freeze the complete selected tuple and the comparison basis; confirm quality, cost and required behavioral conditions together rather than adding the favorable stage results.
en.bad: Add each stage’s best saving and quality gain and publish the sum as the final configuration’s performance.
en.good: Run the final model/prompt/setting tuple on the confirmation cases with fixed quality and cost criteria; report those results and any failed criterion.
en.why: Individually selected components can interact and favorable selection runs are not a joint observation.
en.expected: The final configuration identity, predeclared criteria and confirmation records can be checked.
en.boundaries: Fresh runs of reused selection cases are not an untouched test set. Confirmation requires adequate replication and comparable state; a predicted mechanism does not by itself prove production robustness.

zh.description: 分阶段选择相互作用的设置后，对最终组合做新运行，并按确认前固定的标准评估。
zh.scenario: 搜索先选模型，再修提示，最后降低推理设置。
zh.mechanism: 冻结完整配置与比较依据，同时确认质量、成本和所需行为，不把各阶段有利结果相加。
zh.bad: 把各阶段最佳节省与质量提升相加，称为最终配置表现。
zh.good: 最终模型、提示、设置组合在确认案例上运行，使用固定质量和成本标准，报告结果与未通过条件。
zh.why: 分别选择的组成部分可能相互作用，最佳选择运行也不是整体观察。
zh.expected: 可以检查最终配置身份、预先标准和确认记录。
zh.boundaries: 重复选择案例的新运行不等于未触碰测试集。确认需充分重复与可比状态；预测机制本身不证明生产稳健性。

name.en: Keep pruning assumptions and deferred choices
name.zh: 保留剪枝假设与暂缓选项

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Record the assumptions behind a search exclusion and retain the candidate so it can be reopened when evidence or prerequisites change.
en.scenario: A cost search skips a configuration using a measured profile from a different setting, then revises the prompt.
en.mechanism: Store the profile and context identity behind the decision, name the ordering assumptions, keep uncertain candidates deferred, and re-probe affected choices after recalibration or prompt changes.
en.bad: Permanently discard the configuration because one mismatched cost projection looked unfavorable.
en.good: Mark it deferred with the projection basis; after the prompt changes, use a matching profile and a bounded re-probe before ruling it out.
en.why: A contextual estimate is not a timeless verdict about an unmeasured candidate.
en.expected: The deferred list, decision prerequisites and reopening trigger are inspectable.
en.boundaries: Pruning can still miss a winner if ordering or projection assumptions fail. The source’s model/effort monotonicity and numeric error bands are unverified workload claims; this method does not guarantee a globally cheapest choice.

zh.description: 记录搜索排除背后的假设，保留候选，以便证据或前提变化时重新打开。
zh.scenario: 成本搜索按另一设置的测量剖面跳过某配置，随后又修改提示。
zh.mechanism: 保存决定依据的剖面与上下文身份，点名排序假设，不确定候选暂缓；校准或提示变化后重探受影响选择。
zh.bad: 一次不匹配成本预测不利，就永久丢弃配置。
zh.good: 标记暂缓并记录预测依据；提示变化后使用匹配剖面并做有界重探，再决定排除。
zh.why: 情境估计不是对未测候选的永久判决。
zh.expected: 可以检查暂缓列表、决定前提与重新打开触发条件。
zh.boundaries: 排序或预测假设失效仍会漏掉赢家。源模型与推理设置单调性及数字误差带是未核验任务主张；此方法不保证全局最低成本。

sources.section: Earlier verdict expires after context change

name.zh: 不可信内容当作标记转义

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Encode untrusted text for the exact output context that receives it.
en.scenario: Embed a fetched PR title into a generated HTML page.
en.mechanism: Encoding follows the receiving parser; different contexts require different protections.
en.bad:
html = '

' + title + '

'; also interpolate title into a script string.
en.good: For visible text, assign textContent or use HTML text escaping. For JSON state, serialize safely and neutralize script termination through the renderer's supported helper. Do not reuse HTML escaping as JavaScript-string escaping.
en.why: Encoding follows the receiving parser; different contexts require different protections.
en.expected: A title containing </script> displays as data and never executes markup.
en.boundaries: Use vetted framework encoders and test actual insertion contexts; sanitization is not a universal function.

zh.description: 按接收内容的准确输出上下文编码不可信文本。
zh.scenario: 将抓取 PR 标题嵌入生成 HTML。
zh.mechanism: 编码依接收解析器而定，不同上下文需要不同保护。
zh.bad:
html = '

' + title + '

'；另将 title 插入脚本字符串。
zh.good: 可见文本用 textContent 或 HTML 文本转义；JSON 状态安全序列化，并用渲染器支持的 helper 处理脚本终止。不把 HTML 转义当 JavaScript 字符串转义。
zh.why: 编码依接收解析器而定，不同上下文需要不同保护。
zh.expected: 含 </script> 的标题作为数据显示，不执行标记。
zh.boundaries: 使用成熟框架编码器，并测试实际插入上下文；不存在通用净化函数。

sources.section: Context-specific escaping, inert markup and confined local refs

name.zh: 分开定义版本与运行实例

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Reuse a versioned agent definition while giving each execution its own run identity.
en.scenario: A service launches several jobs with one reviewed agent configuration.
en.mechanism: Create or update the definition in setup, persist its identity and version, and create runs that explicitly reference the approved version; treat live-run overrides separately.
en.bad: Create a fresh untracked definition for every job and refer to latest without recording which configuration ran.
en.good: Persist definition v3 once; launch each job with a distinct run ID pinned to v3 and record any run-specific override.
en.why: Definition changes and execution history remain distinguishable.
en.expected: Definition/version/run relationships and configuration changes can be checked.
en.boundaries: The host must actually support the declared versioning contract. A pinned definition does not freeze external tools, credentials, data or dependencies.

zh.description: 复用有版本的代理定义，每次执行仍有独立运行身份。
zh.scenario: 服务用同一已审查代理配置启动多个作业。
zh.mechanism: 设置阶段创建或更新定义，保存身份与版本；运行明确引用获批版本，实时运行覆盖另行记录。
zh.bad: 每个作业创建无追踪新定义，只引用latest而不记录执行配置。
zh.good: 一次保存定义v3，每个作业用独立运行ID固定到v3，并记录运行特有覆盖。
zh.why: 可以区分定义修改与执行历史。
zh.expected: 可核对定义、版本、运行关系与配置修改。
zh.boundaries: 宿主必须实际支持该版本契约。固定定义不会冻结外部工具、凭据、数据或依赖。

sources.section: Versioned reusable definition and per-run instances

name.en: Keep tool roots separate from project roots
name.zh: 工具根与项目根分开

candidates.reason: Distinct reusable mechanism with concrete editorial contrast and observable limits.

en.description: Resolve installed helper code from its skill base while resolving project artifacts from the declared project working directory.
en.scenario: A brand helper reads docs/brand-guidelines.md and writes project design tokens.
en.mechanism: Name both roots; invoke the installed helper by its resolved path without changing the project cwd, and resolve its inputs and outputs according to the helper contract.
en.bad: Change into the installed skill directory, then run the helper and accidentally write project files into the package.
en.good: Run the absolute helper path from the project root; verify docs/brand-guidelines.md and generated token files resolve inside that project.
en.why: The location of executable code is separated from the location of task data.
en.expected: The invoked path, cwd and resolved artifact paths can be inspected.
en.boundaries: Some helpers use explicit path arguments or another documented base. Check the actual contract; root separation alone does not enforce path confinement or permission. Keep installed helper roots separate from project-owned outputs; force flags do not authorize replacement of arbitrary project files.

zh.description: 安装的辅助代码按技能根解析，项目产物按声明的项目工作目录解析。
zh.scenario: 品牌辅助工具读取docs/brand-guidelines.md并写入项目设计令牌。
zh.mechanism: 明确两种根；使用解析后的工具绝对路径执行，保持项目cwd，按契约解析输入输出。
zh.bad: 切换到安装技能目录执行工具，误把项目文件写进包内。
zh.good: 从项目根执行工具绝对路径，核对品牌文档和生成令牌都解析到该项目。
zh.why: 把可执行代码位置与任务数据位置分开。
zh.expected: 可以检查调用路径、cwd与产物解析路径。
zh.boundaries: 有些工具使用显式路径参数或其他基准，应检查实际契约。根分离本身不强制路径约束或权限。 区分已安装辅助程序根目录与项目所有输出；force 参数不授权替换任意项目文件。

sources.section: Skill base versus project working directory

name.zh: 可编辑产物保留计算关系

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Preserve computations when the recipient needs an artifact that updates with inputs.
en.scenario: Build an editable order workbook with quantity, price and total.
en.mechanism: A formula encodes the relationship that a hardcoded result loses.
en.bad: A2=10; B2=15; C2=150. Ship it as an editable total.
en.good: A2=10; B2=15; C2=SUM(A2*B2). Recalculate with the target engine. Change A2 to 12 in a verification copy and confirm C2 becomes 180.
en.why: A formula encodes the relationship that a hardcoded result loses.
en.expected: Changing quantity changes the computed total without rewriting the result.
en.boundaries: Use formulas for editable models; a requested immutable snapshot can legitimately contain values.

zh.description: 接收者需要随输入更新的产物时，保留计算关系。
zh.scenario: 制作可编辑订单工作簿，含数量、价格和总额。
zh.mechanism: 公式保留硬编码结果会丢失的关系。
zh.bad: A2=10；B2=15；C2=150，作为可编辑总额交付。
zh.good: A2=10；B2=15；C2=SUM(A2*B2)。用目标引擎重新计算；验证副本中 A2 改为 12，确认 C2 变 180。
zh.why: 公式保留硬编码结果会丢失的关系。
zh.expected: 更改数量会更新总额，无需手改结果。
zh.boundaries: 可编辑模型使用公式；用户要求的不可变快照可合理保留数值。

sources.section: Text-free visual layer and editable HTML copy

name.zh: 能力缺失时的反捏造回退

candidates.reason: Same mechanism as the named existing entry; source evidence enriches it.

en.description: Report a missing capability and take only a documented fallback.
en.scenario: A connector search returns no issue-creation action for the requested service.
en.mechanism: The fallback keeps useful work distinct from fabricated execution.
en.bad: Invent create_issue and report the ticket was created.
en.good: Record that discovery returned no supported create action. Do not call a guessed slug. Prepare a local ticket draft if permitted, label it not submitted, and identify the documented setup or alternative the user can use.
en.why: The fallback keeps useful work distinct from fabricated execution.
en.expected: No external ticket ID is claimed without an actual creation response.
en.boundaries: A frozen repository's availability note is not proof of today's connector capabilities.

zh.description: 报告缺失能力，仅采用有文档的回退。
zh.scenario: 连接器搜索没有返回请求服务的 issue 创建操作。
zh.mechanism: 回退保留有用工作，并与虚构执行区分。
zh.bad: 编造 create_issue 并报告工单已创建。
zh.good: 记录发现未返回受支持创建操作，不调用猜测 slug。获准时准备本地工单草稿，标为未提交，并说明有文档的配置或替代方案。
zh.why: 回退保留有用工作，并与虚构执行区分。
zh.expected: 没有实际创建响应就不声称外部工单 ID。
zh.boundaries: 冻结仓库的可用性说明不能证明今天的连接器能力。

sources.section: Capture gap returns source and pending export

name.zh: 无缺口重连事件流

candidates.reason: Distinct transport-recovery method supported by the frozen shared guide and four language examples; it addresses event-history overlap and terminal detection, not tool-generation completion or worker deadlines.

en.description: Recover a dropped event stream by overlapping live delivery with history and deduplicating by event ID while checking stop conditions independently.
en.scenario: A worker reconnects after a network gap. A history request may include events emitted during the gap while a newly opened live stream is already buffering newer events.
en.mechanism: Open the live stream first, fetch and process available history, then consume the live tail. Gate event side effects on unseen IDs, but evaluate terminal or idle-stop conditions for every live event, including duplicates.
en.bad: Reconnect from now and assume the stream replays the gap, or skip a repeated event with continue before checking whether it marks the session terminal.
en.good: Open the replacement stream, read history and record its IDs, then tail the stream. Ignore duplicate handling while still applying the lifecycle stop check to a repeated terminal event.
en.why: History covers the disconnect interval while the live stream covers events after reconnection; overlap can repeat events. Separate deduplication from lifecycle checks to avoid duplicate side effects without suppressing termination.
en.expected: For history and stream data actually returned, each stable event ID is handled at most once and an observed terminal event can still stop the consumer.
en.boundaries: Confirm history pagination/completeness, retention, ordering, stable IDs and stop semantics for the target API/SDK. This cannot recover events absent from history or establish a delivery guarantee; preserve order if the consumer depends on it.

zh.description: 事件流断线后，用历史记录与新实时流重叠补齐可见区间，按事件ID去重，并独立检查停止条件。
zh.scenario: 任务执行器断网后重连；历史查询可能含有断线期间的事件，新实时流此时也已开始缓冲后续事件。
zh.mechanism: 先打开实时流，再读取并处理可取得的历史记录，最后消费实时尾流。仅让未见过的ID触发副作用；每个实时事件仍要检查终态或空闲停止条件，包括重复事件。
zh.bad: 重连后从“现在”继续并假定流会补发缺口，或遇到重复事件就先 continue，跳过其中的会话终止信号。
zh.good: 先建立新流、再读取历史并记录历史事件ID，随后跟随实时流。重复事件不重复处理，但仍执行生命周期停止检查。
zh.why: 历史覆盖断线区间，实时流覆盖重连之后；两者重叠会产生重复。将副作用去重与生命周期判断分开，才能避免重复操作又不漏掉结束状态。
zh.expected: 对于接口实际返回的历史与流，在事件ID稳定时每个ID最多处理一次；已观察到的终止事件仍能结束消费。
zh.boundaries: 需核实目标API/SDK的历史分页完整性、保留期、排序、ID稳定性及停止语义。历史中不存在的事件无法由此恢复，也不能据此保证投递；若消费端依赖顺序，应保留顺序。

name.en: Verify a retrieved UI recommendation before reuse
name.zh: 复用前验证检索到的界面建议

candidates.reason: Distinct local retrieval contract: route to the smallest mode, verify result applicability, retry once, and never persist unverified/fabricated output. This is neither an external learning-resource catalog recommendation nor a host-level meta-router.

en.description: Treat a retrieved UI suggestion as provisional until its scope and identity fit the request.
en.scenario: Repair a React confirmation dialog that fails to return keyboard focus to its opener after closing.
en.mechanism: Choose the smallest applicable search mode, express one intent with two to five terms, then verify the result's domain/category and top item's identity and applicability. Retry once when needed, label any fallback, and do not persist unverified output.
en.bad: Hypothetical catalog fixture: the same dialog issue yields style-pricing-palette from a broad search. Accept it solely because it mentions React and persist its palette as the fix without checking keyboard behavior.
en.good: Hypothetical catalog fixture: search "dialog keyboard focus" in UX mode. Check that ux-focus-return is accessibility guidance for restoring focus to the opener, with applicable platform scope. Query React implementation separately only if needed. Persist the checked guidance; if the bounded retry finds no suitable match, label fallback and retain no unverified result.
en.why: A concise query can still retrieve the wrong domain; checking both category and item fit catches that error before it becomes durable guidance.
en.expected: The selected mode, query, top result, retry/fallback, and persistence decision can be inspected.
en.boundaries: This does not validate catalog accuracy or guarantee design quality. A failed search is not permission to invent a result; human review may still be needed. The two-to-five-term query and one-retry limit are bounded source-policy examples, not validated universal optima; choose terms and retry behavior by task, catalog, and freshness.

zh.description: 检索到的界面建议在范围与身份符合请求前都只是候选内容。
zh.scenario: 修复一个 React 确认对话框：关闭后键盘焦点没有返回触发按钮。
zh.mechanism: 选择最小适用搜索模式，用2至5个词表达一个意图；随后核对结果的领域/类别以及首条内容的身份和适用性。必要时只重试一次，标明回退结果，并且不保存未经核验的输出。
zh.bad: 假设目录用例：同一对话框问题在宽泛搜索中命中 style-pricing-palette；仅因它提到 React 就接受，将配色保存为修复方案，未检查键盘行为。
zh.good: 假设目录用例：在 UX 模式搜索“对话框 键盘 焦点”，确认 ux-focus-return 是恢复触发按钮焦点的可访问性指导，且平台范围适用。只有需要实现细节时才单独查询 React。保存已核验的指导；若有界重试仍无合适匹配，标明回退，不保留未经核验的结果。
zh.why: 简短查询仍可能命中错误领域；同时核对类别与条目适用性，可在错误变成持久指南前发现问题。
zh.expected: 可以检查所选模式、查询词、首条结果、重试/回退和保存决策。
zh.boundaries: 此契约不验证目录事实准确性，也不保证设计质量。搜索失败不代表可以编造结果；仍可能需要人工复核。 2至5个查询词与只重试一次是该来源给出的有界策略示例，不是经验证的普遍最优值；应结合任务、目录内容与新鲜度判断其适用性。

sources.section: Select smallest search mode and verify query/result fit

name.en: Verify social assets in their target-size render
name.zh: 在目标尺寸渲染中验证社交素材

candidates.reason: Distinct end-to-end method: concept approval, per-platform HTML artifacts, exact-size screenshot export, visual repair and traceable output report; no existing core candidate covers this production loop.

en.description: Produce social-image variants as separate target-sized artifacts, then check rendered exports before delivery.
en.scenario: Create a launch set for square feed posts and vertical story placements across two social platforms.
en.mechanism: Record each platform size, brand and content needs; draft distinct concepts and get approval before pixel work; create a self-contained HTML file for every approved concept and target size; capture each at its exact viewport after fonts and images settle; inspect exports for clipping, safe-zone, contrast and hierarchy issues; fix the HTML, recapture, and report the decisions and output files.
en.bad: Reuse one generic canvas for every platform and deliver source HTML without checking a target-size render, leaving cropped copy and fallback fonts undiscovered.
en.good: Keep separate square and vertical layouts, obtain concept approval, capture at target dimensions, repair a clipped headline, re-export and list each checked file in the report.
en.why: Source markup alone cannot show whether external fonts, viewport sizing or layout cause the exported image to clip or differ from intent.
en.expected: Each approved concept has an export at its declared size, visible rendering issues corrected and decisions/files recorded.
en.boundaries: Source dimensions, concept counts, wait times and text sizes are examples, not permanent platform standards. Recheck specs and asset readiness. Screenshot QA does not prove engagement; video, print, direct posting and AI image generation are outside scope.

zh.description: 将社交图片变体分别制作成目标尺寸的素材，并在交付前检查实际渲染结果。
zh.scenario: 为两个社交平台制作正方形信息流图片和竖版限时动态素材。
zh.mechanism: 记录各平台尺寸、品牌与内容要求；先提出不同创意并取得批准，再进入像素制作；为每个获批创意和目标尺寸建立独立、自包含的 HTML 文件；等待字体与图片就绪后按目标视口截图；检查裁切、安全区域、对比度和层级问题；修复 HTML、重新截图，并在报告中记录决策与输出文件。
zh.bad: 所有平台复用一张通用画布，不检查目标尺寸渲染就交付源 HTML，导致标题裁切、字体回退等问题未被发现。
zh.good: 分别保留正方形和竖版布局，先确认创意，再按目标尺寸截图；修复被裁切的标题，重新导出，并在报告中逐项列出检查过的文件。
zh.why: 只看源标记无法发现外部字体、视口尺寸或布局造成的导出裁切与视觉偏差。
zh.expected: 每个获批创意都有标明目标尺寸的导出图，已修复可见渲染问题，并记录相关决策和文件。
zh.boundaries: 源文档中的平台尺寸、创意数量、等待时间和字号都只是有限示例，不是永久的平台标准。应重新核对规格及素材加载状态。截图检查不能证明互动效果；视频、印刷、直接发布和 AI 图片生成均不属于此方法。

sources.section: Workflow Steps 1–8: plan, approve concepts, design per-size HTML, capture, verify, report and organize

name.en: Persist a master design system with page-specific overrides
name.zh: 持久化全局设计系统与页面级覆盖

candidates.reason: Distinct persistence/retrieval contract: keep shared project rules centrally and store page deviations separately; adjacent to contextual precedence but adds cross-session artifact layout and lookup.

en.description: Keep shared design rules in one project master and persist page-specific deviations separately for later retrieval.
en.scenario: A multi-page product has shared color, typography and spacing rules, while checkout needs a documented exception.
en.mechanism: Generate a project MASTER file for shared rules; create a page-specific file containing only deviations; when implementing a named page, look up that page file first and apply documented overrides, otherwise use the master. Make field-level merge or replacement semantics explicit.
en.bad: Copy the entire master into each page file, then edit copies independently so shared rules drift and no one knows which source wins.
en.good: Teaching fixture: MASTER.md defines button.padding=12 and text.color=#0F172A. pages/checkout.md records only button.padding=16. Declare field-level overlay: named page values override the master, every unmentioned field inherits, and a missing page file uses the master. Load both for checkout and verify padding=16 with the inherited text color.
en.why: Durable shared defaults and local exceptions remain discoverable across sessions without silently conflating precedence.
en.expected: A reviewer can locate the project baseline, page-specific delta and stated precedence used for that page.
en.boundaries: The source proposes page overrides but leaves field-level merge versus replacement underspecified; define semantics before relying on partial files. This pattern does not validate token values or guarantee runtime retrieval.

zh.description: 将共享设计规则保存在项目主文件中，并把页面专属偏差单独持久化以便后续检索。
zh.scenario: 多页面产品已有共享颜色、字体和间距规则，而结账页需要一项明确记录的例外。
zh.mechanism: 为共享规则生成项目 MASTER 文件；另建页面文件，只记录偏差；实现具名页面时先查找该页面文件并应用其中明确说明的覆盖规则，否则使用主文件。明确字段级合并或替换语义。
zh.bad: 把主文件完整复制到每个页面文件后分别修改，使共享规则逐渐漂移，也让执行者无法判断应以哪份规则为准。
zh.good: 教学用例：MASTER.md 定义 button.padding=12、text.color=#0F172A；pages/checkout.md 只记录 button.padding=16。明确字段级覆盖：页面具名值覆盖主文件，未提到的字段继承主文件，没有页面文件时使用主文件。结账页读取两份文件，并核验 padding=16、文字颜色仍继承主文件。
zh.why: 跨会话仍能找到持久化的共享默认规则和局部例外，也不会默默混淆优先级。
zh.expected: 审阅者能定位项目基线、页面专属差异，以及该页面采用的明确优先规则。
zh.boundaries: 源文档提出页面覆盖，但没有充分说明字段级合并还是替换；依赖部分文件前应先定义语义。该模式本身不会验证 token 数值，也不保证运行时一定检索到文件。

sources.section: Persist Design System (Master + Overrides Pattern) and context-aware retrieval
